Abstract摘要

Scaling Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training introduces systems challenges absent in dense models. Because each token activates only a subset of experts, this sparsity allows total parameters to grow much faster than per-token computation, creating coupled constraints across memory, communication, and computation. Optimizing one dimension often shifts pressure to another, demanding co-design across the full system stack.

扩展专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）训练会带来稠密模型所没有的系统挑战。由于每个 token 只激活一部分专家，这种稀疏性让总参数量的增长可以远快于每 token 的计算量，从而在显存、通信与计算之间形成相互耦合的约束。优化其中一维，压力往往就转移到另一维，因此需要在整个系统栈上做协同设计。

We address these challenges for MoE training through integrated optimizations spanning memory (fine-grained recomputation, offloading, etc.), communication (optimized dispatchers, overlapping, etc.), and computation (Grouped GEMM, fusions, CUDA Graphs, etc.). The framework also provides Parallel Folding for flexible multi-dimensional parallelism, low-precision training support for FP8 and NVFP4, and efficient long-context training. On NVIDIA GB300 and GB200, it achieves 1,233/1,048 TFLOPS/GPU for DeepSeek-V3-685B and 974/919 TFLOPS/GPU for Qwen3-235B. As a performant, scalable, and production-ready open-source solution, it has been used across academia and industry for training MoE models ranging from billions to trillions of parameters on clusters scaling up to thousands of GPUs.

我们通过一整套集成优化来应对 MoE 训练的这些挑战，覆盖显存（细粒度重计算、offload 等）、通信（优化后的 dispatcher、重叠等）与计算（Grouped GEMM、算子融合、CUDA Graphs 等）。该框架还提供用于灵活多维并行的 Parallel Folding、面向 FP8 与 NVFP4 的低精度训练支持，以及高效的长上下文训练。在 NVIDIA GB300 与 GB200 上，DeepSeek-V3-685B 达到 1,233/1,048 TFLOPS/GPU，Qwen3-235B 达到 974/919 TFLOPS/GPU。作为一套高性能、可扩展、可直接用于生产环境的开源方案，它已被学术界与工业界用于训练从十亿级到万亿级参数的 MoE 模型，集群规模可扩展至数千块 GPU。

This report explains how these techniques work, their trade-offs, and their interactions at the systems level, providing practical guidance for scaling MoE models with Megatron Core.

本报告解释这些技术的工作原理、各自的取舍，以及它们在系统层面的相互作用，为用 Megatron Core 扩展 MoE 模型提供可落地的实践指导。

1.Introduction引言

Training dense transformers at scale requires computation that grows linearly with model size [39, 33]. Mixture of Experts (MoE) models follow a different scaling pattern: by routing each token to a selected subset of expert networks rather than activating all parameters, per-token computation grows sub-linearly with model size [82, 25]. Recent MoE models have demonstrated order-of-magnitude reductions in training cost relative to quality-matched dense models [38, 19, 8].

大规模训练稠密 Transformer 时，所需计算量随模型规模线性增长 [39, 33]。专家混合（MoE）模型遵循另一种扩展规律：它把每个 token 路由到选定的部分专家网络，而不是激活全部参数，因此每 token 计算量随模型规模亚线性增长 [82, 25]。近期的 MoE 模型在质量对齐的前提下，相对稠密模型把训练成本降低了一个数量级 [38, 19, 8]。

However, training MoE at scale introduces systems challenges that dense-model frameworks were not designed for. This report presents Megatron-Core MoE, the MoE training stack within Megatron-Core [85], covering the architecture, parallelism strategies, and system optimizations required to train trillion-parameter-class MoE models at high throughput.

然而，大规模训练 MoE 会带来稠密模型框架在设计上并未考虑的系统挑战。本报告介绍 Megatron-Core MoE——Megatron-Core 中的 MoE 训练栈 [85]，涵盖以高吞吐训练万亿参数级 MoE 模型所需的架构、并行策略与系统优化。

1.1.Mixture of Experts专家混合（MoE）

A Mixture of Experts (MoE) model augments a standard neural network with a collection of specialized sub-networks called experts, together with a lightweight router (or gating network) that dynamically selects which experts process each input [82, 36, 22]. In the context of Transformer-based language models [90], MoE layers typically replace the dense Feed-Forward Network (FFN) blocks: instead of a single FFN applied to all tokens, an MoE layer contains multiple FFN experts, and each token is routed to a small subset (e.g., top-kk) of these experts based on learned routing weights.

专家混合（MoE）模型在标准神经网络之上增加一组被称为「专家」的专用子网络，以及一个轻量的 router（或称门控网络），由它动态选择哪些专家处理每个输入 [82, 36, 22]。在基于 Transformer 的语言模型 [90] 中，MoE 层通常替换稠密的前馈网络（FFN）块：不再是所有 token 共用同一个 FFN，一个 MoE 层包含多个 FFN 专家，每个 token 依据学到的路由权重被送往其中一小部分（例如 top-k）专家。

Formally, given an input token representation 𝐱\mathbf{x}, the router computes a probability distribution over EE experts:

形式化地，给定输入 token 的表示 x，router 在 E 个专家上计算一个概率分布：

𝐩​(𝐱)=Softmax​(𝐖r​𝐱)\mathbf{p}(\mathbf{x})=\text{Softmax}(\mathbf{W}_{r}\mathbf{x})

The output of the MoE layer is then computed as a weighted combination of the selected experts’ outputs:

MoE 层的输出则是被选中专家输出的加权组合：

MoE​(𝐱)=∑i∈TopK​(𝐩​(𝐱))pi​(𝐱)⋅Ei​(𝐱)\text{MoE}(\mathbf{x})=\sum_{i\in\text{TopK}(\mathbf{p}(\mathbf{x}))}p_{i}(\mathbf{x})\cdot E_{i}(\mathbf{x})

where EiE_{i} denotes the ii-th expert network. This architecture offers three key advantages: model capacity can grow independently of computational cost by adding more experts (scalable capacity); only a fraction of parameters activate per token, reducing FLOPs relative to a dense model of equivalent size (computational efficiency); and different experts can specialize on different input types (specialization). Appendix A provides a notation reference for all symbols and abbreviations used in this report.

其中 E_i 表示第 i 个专家网络。这种架构有三个关键优势：可以通过增加专家来扩大模型容量，而不必同步增加计算开销（容量可扩展）；每个 token 只激活一小部分参数，相对同等规模的稠密模型降低了 FLOPs（计算高效）；不同专家可以针对不同输入类型形成专精（专精性）。附录 A 给出了本报告所用全部符号与缩写的对照表。

While the concept dates back to the early 1990s [36, 22], the integration of MoE with modern Transformers has driven renewed interest. GShard pioneered distributed MoE training at scale, introducing Expert Parallelism and load-balancing auxiliary losses [47]. Switch Transformer demonstrated that MoE could scale to trillion parameters while maintaining training stability [25]. GLaM showed that MoE could match dense model quality at a fraction of the training cost [21]. Frameworks including Tutel [35] and DeepSpeed-MoE [74] further advanced MoE training systems.

这一概念最早可追溯到 1990 年代初 [36, 22]，而 MoE 与现代 Transformer 的结合重新点燃了研究兴趣。GShard 开创了大规模分布式 MoE 训练，提出专家并行（Expert Parallelism）与负载均衡辅助损失 [47]。Switch Transformer 证明 MoE 可以在保持训练稳定的同时扩展到万亿参数 [25]。GLaM 表明 MoE 能以很小一部分训练成本达到稠密模型的质量 [21]。Tutel [35] 与 DeepSpeed-MoE [74] 等框架进一步推进了 MoE 训练系统。

MoE adoption has accelerated across research and industry. Mixtral-8x7B showed that open-weight MoE models can match proprietary dense models while reducing inference cost [38]. DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 extended this with fine-grained expert architectures, using hundreds of small experts to maximize the capacity-to-compute ratio [14, 18, 19]. NVIDIA’s Nemotron-3 family [67] adopts a hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE architecture with LatentMoE [23], trained at scale using Megatron-Core. Scaling law studies confirm that fine-grained MoE achieves favorable compute-optimal trade-offs [44, 56], accelerating this trend—while amplifying the systems challenges it creates.

MoE 在学术界与工业界的采用都在加速。Mixtral-8x7B 表明开放权重的 MoE 模型可以在降低推理成本的同时比肩闭源稠密模型 [38]。DeepSeek-V2 与 DeepSeek-V3 用细粒度专家架构进一步推进：用数百个小专家把容量与计算之比最大化 [14, 18, 19]。NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-3 系列 [67] 采用混合 Mamba-Transformer 的 MoE 架构，配合 LatentMoE [23]，并用 Megatron-Core 大规模训练。缩放律研究确认细粒度 MoE 能取得更优的算力最优权衡 [44, 56]，这加速了上述趋势，同时也放大了它带来的系统挑战。

1.2.Challenges in Training Large-Scale MoE Models大规模 MoE 训练的挑战

As models push toward hundreds of experts with smaller individual capacity, the systems challenges of MoE training grow in proportion. These challenges stem from a single root cause: MoE’s sparsity—which manifests as a Parameter-Compute Mismatch (total parameters far exceeding active computation, this section) and a Dense-Sparse Mismatch (attention and MoE layers requiring conflicting parallelism configurations, Section 3).

当模型朝着「数百个专家、每个专家容量更小」的方向发展时，MoE 训练的系统挑战也随之按比例放大。这些挑战来自同一个根因：MoE 的稀疏性——它表现为两种失配：参数-计算失配（总参数量远超实际参与计算的量，本节讨论）与稠密-稀疏失配（注意力和 MoE 层需要彼此冲突的并行配置，见第 3 节）。

The core asymmetry comes from sparsity. In a dense transformer, every parameter participates in every training step. A model with NtotalN_{\text{total}} parameters requires roughly 6​Ntotal6N_{\text{total}} FLOPs per token (forward and backward combined), so parameters and per-token computation scale in lockstep. Splitting the model across more GPUs usually also splits computation in the same proportion, keeping each GPU busy enough that communication overhead stays small.

这种根本性的不对称源自稀疏性。在稠密 Transformer 中，每个参数都参与每一步训练。一个拥有 N_total 个参数的模型，每 token 约需 6·N_total 次浮点运算（前向与反向合计），因此参数量与每 token 计算量是同步伸缩的。把模型切分到更多 GPU 上，通常也把计算按同样比例切开，于是每块 GPU 都足够忙，通信开销占比很小。

For MoE, sparsity causes this coupling to break: only KK of EE total experts activate per token, so per-token computation is roughly 6​Nactive6N_{\text{active}} rather than 6​Ntotal6N_{\text{total}}, where NactiveN_{\text{active}} scales with KK while NtotalN_{\text{total}} scales with EE, and K≪EK\ll E. This creates a fundamental parameter-compute mismatch: compared with a dense model matched on active parameters per token, an MoE model has far more total parameters, often by an order of magnitude. DeepSeek-V3 illustrates this concretely: 685B total parameters but only 37B active per token, an 18×\times gap.

对 MoE 而言，稀疏性让这种同步关系断裂：每个 token 只激活 E 个专家中的 K 个，因此每 token 计算量约为 6·N_active 而非 6·N_total——N_active 随 K 伸缩，N_total 却随 E 伸缩，而 K ≪ E。这就造成了根本性的参数-计算失配：与「每 token 激活参数量」相当的稠密模型相比，MoE 模型的总参数量要大得多，通常相差一个数量级。DeepSeek-V3 是个具体例子：总参数 685B，每 token 只激活 37B，相差 18 倍。

With so little computation per token, model partitioning requires more care than for dense models—naively sharding expert matrices (as Tensor Parallelism would) fragments already-small computations, making them even less efficient. Because MoE experts are independent networks, the natural strategy is Expert Parallelism (EP): placing different experts on different GPUs, preserving full-size expert GEMMs. EP introduces all-to-all communication to route tokens to their assigned GPUs (Section 3 details why EP is preferred and how Parallel Folding addresses the resulting challenges). This parameter-compute mismatch and EP’s communication demands together create three tightly coupled challenges—the Three Walls—that constrain every MoE training step:

每 token 的计算量如此之少，模型切分就比稠密模型更需谨慎——按张量并行的做法直接切分专家矩阵，会把本就不大的计算切得更碎，效率更低。由于 MoE 的专家是彼此独立的网络，更自然的策略是专家并行（Expert Parallelism, EP）：把不同专家放到不同 GPU 上，让专家 GEMM 保持完整尺寸。EP 需要引入 all-to-all 通信，把 token 送到它被分配到的 GPU（第 3 节详述为什么优先选 EP，以及 Parallel Folding 如何应对随之而来的挑战）。参数-计算失配与 EP 的通信需求共同造成三个紧密耦合的挑战——「三堵墙」——它们约束着 MoE 训练的每一步：

The Memory Wall. All EE experts’ parameters, gradients, and optimizer states must reside in memory during training, even though only KK activate per token. This creates memory pressure far exceeding that of a dense model with comparable per-token compute [25, 8]. Reducing this pressure requires spending elsewhere: distributing parameters across more devices costs communication bandwidth; recomputing activations instead of storing them costs extra computation; offloading to host memory costs PCIe bandwidth. Dynamic routing further complicates matters: uneven token distributions cause unpredictable memory spikes when some experts receive disproportionate load [47, 94].

显存墙。训练期间，全部 E 个专家的参数、梯度与优化器状态都必须驻留显存，尽管每个 token 只激活 K 个。这造成的显存压力远超每 token 计算量相当的稠密模型 [25, 8]。要缓解这份压力，就得在别处付出代价：把参数分散到更多设备上要消耗通信带宽；用重计算代替存储激活要消耗额外算力；offload 到主机内存要消耗 PCIe 带宽。动态路由让问题更复杂：token 分布不均时，某些专家负载畸高，会引发难以预测的显存尖峰 [47, 94]。

The Communication Wall. EP requires all-to-all collectives to dispatch tokens to their assigned experts and collect results [47]. The per-GPU send volume in each all-to-all is approximately T⋅K⋅h⋅E​P−1E​PT\cdot K\cdot h\cdot\frac{EP-1}{EP}, where TT is the local token count, KK the top-kk, and hh the hidden dimension; a full dispatch-and-combine cycle doubles this. As EP grows, this volume saturates but the communication increasingly moves from high-bandwidth intra-node links (e.g., NVLink) to narrower inter-node interconnects, where available bandwidth drops by an order of magnitude [100]. The sparse activation pattern, meanwhile, provides limited computation to overlap with this communication. In architectures like DeepSeek-V3, where experts span multiple nodes, unoptimized all-to-all can consume up to 60% of total training time.

通信墙。EP 依赖 all-to-all 集合通信，把 token 派发到对应专家、再收回结果 [47]。每次 all-to-all 中，单卡发送量约为 T·K·h·(EP−1)/EP，其中 T 是本地 token 数、K 是 top-k、h 是隐藏维；一次完整的 dispatch+combine 会翻倍。随着 EP 增大，这个量会趋于饱和，但通信越来越多地从高带宽的节点内链路（如 NVLink）转移到更窄的节点间互联，可用带宽下降一个数量级 [100]。与此同时，稀疏激活模式能提供用于重叠的计算量很有限。在 DeepSeek-V3 这类专家跨多个节点的架构里，未经优化的 all-to-all 可以吃掉高达 60% 的总训练时间。

The Compute Efficiency Wall. MoE introduces computational inefficiencies absent in dense models:

计算效率墙。MoE 引入了稠密模型没有的计算低效：

  • • Small GEMMs. Fine-grained experts produce many small matrix multiplications that underutilize GPU compute units [27]. In our measurements, GEMMs account for ∼\sim70% of execution time in Llama-3 405B (dense) but under 50% in DeepSeek-V3 (MoE). The remainder is consumed by operations that scale with tensor count rather than FLOP count.小型 GEMM。细粒度专家会产生大量小矩阵乘法，GPU 计算单元利用不足 [27]。在我们的实测中，GEMM 在 Llama-3 405B（稠密）里占执行时间约 70%，在 DeepSeek-V3（MoE）里却不到 50%；其余时间被那些随张量个数而非 FLOP 数增长的操作吃掉。
  • • Routing and permutation overhead. Token routing and permutation, absent in dense models, add ∼\sim9% to layer execution time even after optimization.路由与重排开销。token 路由与重排在稠密模型里并不存在，即便经过优化，仍会给层执行时间增加约 9%。
  • • Load imbalance. Dynamic routing assigns uneven token counts to experts, leaving some overloaded while others sit idle, wasting compute capacity [94].负载不均。动态路由给各专家分配的 token 数不均，一些专家过载、另一些闲置，浪费算力 [94]。
  • • Host overhead. MoE launches more kernels for the same amount of FLOPs because of sparsity and routing, and each launch carries fixed host-side cost, these add up and leave the GPU idle between kernels. In dropless MoE, dynamic tensor shapes further require costly host-device synchronization.主机侧开销。由于稀疏与路由，同样的 FLOPs 下 MoE 要启动更多 kernel，每次启动都有固定的主机侧开销，累加起来就让 GPU 在 kernel 之间空转。在 dropless MoE 中，动态张量形状还要求昂贵的主机-设备同步。

These three walls are tightly coupled: optimizing one often shifts pressure to another. Increasing batch size improves GEMM utilization but amplifies memory pressure and communication volume. CUDA Graphs eliminate host overhead but require static tensor shapes, conflicting with dropless routing. Grouping tokens across experts improves compute efficiency but complicates load balancing. Section 3 provides the detailed parallelism analysis underlying EP and Parallel Folding; Section 4 presents Megatron-Core’s integrated approach to addressing all three walls while managing their interactions.

这三堵墙紧密耦合：优化其中一堵，压力常常转移到另一堵。增大 batch size 能提升 GEMM 利用率，却放大了显存压力与通信量。CUDA Graphs 能消除主机侧开销，但要求静态张量形状，与 dropless 路由冲突。跨专家聚合 token 能提升计算效率，却让负载均衡更难做。第 3 节给出 EP 与 Parallel Folding 背后的详细并行分析；第 4 节介绍 Megatron-Core 如何一体化地处理这三堵墙，并管理它们之间的相互作用。

1.3.Megatron-Core MoEMegatron-Core MoE

Built within Megatron-Core, a PyTorch-based library for large-scale transformer training [85, 69], this MoE training stack tackles all three walls simultaneously:

这套 MoE 训练栈构建在 Megatron-Core 之内——后者是一个基于 PyTorch 的大规模 Transformer 训练库 [85, 69]——它同时应对三堵墙：

Multi-Dimensional Parallelism. Expert Parallelism (EP) integrates with tensor, pipeline, sequence, and data parallelism. MoE Parallel Folding [52] decouples attention and MoE layer configurations, breaking the traditional EP≤DP\text{EP}\leq\text{DP} constraint and enabling configurations tailored to specific model architectures and hardware topologies.

多维并行。专家并行（EP）与张量并行、流水并行、序列并行、数据并行集成在一起。MoE Parallel Folding [52] 把注意力层与 MoE 层的并行配置解耦，打破了传统的 EP ≤ DP 约束，从而可以按具体模型架构与硬件拓扑定制配置。

Memory Optimizations. Fine-grained activation recomputation, memory-efficient permutation, precision-aware optimizers, and activation offloading reduce memory footprint without sacrificing throughput [43, 1]. Comprehensive reduced-precision training (FP8 and FP4) support in expert GEMMs, activations, and communication further reduces activation storage while maintaining convergence through selective precision strategies.

显存优化。细粒度激活重计算、省显存的 permutation、精度感知优化器与激活 offload，在不牺牲吞吐的前提下降低显存占用 [43, 1]。专家 GEMM、激活与通信全面支持低精度训练（FP8 与 FP4），进一步压缩激活存储，并通过选择性精度策略保持收敛。

Communication Optimizations. High-performance token dispatchers (DeepEP, HybridEP) maximize bandwidth utilization. Communication-computation overlap hides all-to-all latency behind expert computation.

通信优化。高性能 token dispatcher（DeepEP、HybridEP）把带宽利用率拉到最高。通信-计算重叠把 all-to-all 的延迟藏到专家计算后面。

Compute Optimizations. Grouped GEMM kernels, kernel fusion, CUDA Graphs, and sync-free execution address the computational fragmentation inherent in fine-grained MoE architectures.

计算优化。Grouped GEMM kernel、算子融合、CUDA Graphs 与无同步执行，针对的是细粒度 MoE 架构固有的计算碎片化。

Production Features. Load balancing strategies, token dropping with capacity control, distributed optimizer and FSDP support, distributed checkpointing with flexible resharding, and upcycling from dense checkpoints enable deployment at scale. The MoE stack’s modular design enables rapid experimentation, while its production-grade optimizations support training from research prototypes to trillion-parameter models [65]. This report explains what the stack provides, why key design decisions were made, and how they address MoE training challenges, with practical guidance for configuration and tuning.

生产特性。负载均衡策略、带容量控制的 token dropping、分布式优化器与 FSDP 支持、可灵活重分片的分布式 checkpoint，以及从稠密 checkpoint 做 upcycling，共同支撑规模化部署。这套 MoE 栈的模块化设计便于快速实验，其生产级优化则支持从研究原型一路训到万亿参数模型 [65]。本报告说明这套栈提供了什么、关键设计决策为何如此，以及它们如何应对 MoE 训练的挑战，并给出配置与调优的实践指导。

1.4.Structure of This Paper本文结构

The remainder of this report follows a progression from architecture to optimization to evaluation:

本报告余下部分按「架构 → 优化 → 评测」的顺序展开：

  • • Section 2: Megatron-Core MoE Architecture. Introduces Megatron-Core MoE’s design in two parts: the internal design of the MoE layer itself (router, token dispatcher, experts) and the four-stage forward pass (route, dispatch, compute, combine), followed by the external design covering integration with the transformer model, parallel process group organization, and optimizer handling for expert parameters.第 2 节：Megatron-Core MoE 架构。分两部分介绍设计：MoE 层自身的内部设计（router、token dispatcher、专家）与四阶段前向（route、dispatch、compute、combine）；随后是外部设计，涵盖与 Transformer 模型的集成、并行进程组的组织，以及专家参数的优化器处理。
  • • Section 3: Scaling MoE with Parallel Folding and Multi-Dimensional Parallelism. Examines how MoE’s sparsity breaks the parallelism assumptions of dense training, why Expert Parallelism (EP) is needed alongside traditional strategies, and how the resulting dense-sparse mismatch between attention and MoE layers is resolved by MoE Parallel Folding, which decouples their parallelism configurations for flexible, efficient mapping at trillion-parameter scale.第 3 节：用 Parallel Folding 与多维并行扩展 MoE。考察 MoE 的稀疏性如何打破稠密训练的并行假设、为什么需要在传统策略之外引入专家并行（EP），以及注意力层与 MoE 层之间的稠密-稀疏失配如何由 MoE Parallel Folding 化解——它把两者的并行配置解耦，从而在万亿参数规模上做灵活高效的映射。
  • • Section 4: Breaking the Memory, Communication, and Compute Efficiency Walls. Presents Megatron-Core MoE’s solutions to the three fundamental barriers: the Memory Wall (activation management, recomputation strategies, offloading, distributed parameter storage), the Communication Wall (optimized dispatchers including DeepEP and HybridEP, communication-computation overlap), and the Compute Efficiency Wall (Grouped GEMM, kernel fusion, CUDA Graphs, sync-free execution for dropless MoE).第 4 节：打破显存墙、通信墙与计算效率墙。给出 Megatron-Core MoE 对三道根本性障碍的解决方案：显存墙（激活管理、重计算策略、offload、分布式参数存储）、通信墙（含 DeepEP 与 HybridEP 的优化 dispatcher、通信-计算重叠）、计算效率墙（Grouped GEMM、算子融合、CUDA Graphs、面向 dropless MoE 的无同步执行）。
  • • Section 5: Reduced-Precision Training in FP8/FP4 for MoE. Covers reduced-precision training as a cross-cutting optimization that simultaneously impacts all three walls by reducing activation memory, halving communication volume, and accelerating Tensor Core GEMMs, while presenting strategies for selective precision to maintain training stability.第 5 节：面向 MoE 的 FP8/FP4 低精度训练。把低精度训练视为一项横切优化：它通过压缩激活显存、把通信量减半、加速 Tensor Core GEMM，同时作用于三堵墙；本节还给出用选择性精度维持训练稳定的策略。
  • • Section 6: Long-Context MoE Training. Examines how long-context scenarios (16K to 64K+ tokens) fundamentally shift the optimization landscape as attention computation dominates, and presents techniques for managing activation memory growth through Context Parallelism and Tensor Parallelism scaling.第 6 节：长上下文 MoE 训练。考察长上下文场景（16K 到 64K+ token）下注意力计算占据主导、优化版图如何根本性改变，并给出通过上下文并行与张量并行扩展来管理激活显存增长的技术。
  • • Section 7: Production Features. Describes operational features for production training: load balancing and token dropping for stable training, distributed checkpointing for parallelism-agnostic resharding, upcycling from dense checkpoints, and integration with multi-token prediction.第 7 节：生产特性。描述生产训练所需的运营特性：用于稳定训练的负载均衡与 token dropping、与并行策略无关的分布式 checkpoint 重分片、从稠密 checkpoint 做 upcycling，以及与多 token 预测（MTP）的集成。
  • • Section 8: Performance Evaluation. Validates the framework’s effectiveness through empirical benchmarks on DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3-235B across GB200 and H100 platforms, demonstrating the impact of the full optimization stack.第 8 节：性能评测。在 GB200 与 H100 平台上对 DeepSeek-V3 与 Qwen3-235B 做实测基准，验证框架的有效性，展示完整优化栈带来的影响。
  • • Section 9: Performance Best Practices with DeepSeek-V3 Case Study. Provides a systematic workflow for identifying optimal parallelism configurations, validated through a detailed DeepSeek-V3 case study that demonstrates how the optimizations work together to achieve state-of-the-art performance.第 9 节：性能最佳实践与 DeepSeek-V3 案例。给出一套系统化的工作流来找出最优并行配置，并通过详细的 DeepSeek-V3 案例验证这些优化如何协同达到当前最佳性能。

2.Megatron-Core MoE ArchitectureMegatron-Core MoE 架构

This section presents Megatron-Core’s MoE implementation architecture in two parts. We first describe the internal design of the MoE layer itself: its modular components (router, token dispatcher, experts) and the four-stage forward pass that transforms input tokens into output representations. We then examine the external design: how parallel process groups are organized to support distributed execution and how the optimizer handles expert parameters differently from dense layers.

本节分两部分介绍 Megatron-Core 的 MoE 实现架构。先讲 MoE 层自身的内部设计：模块化组件（router、token dispatcher、专家）以及把输入 token 变换为输出表示的四阶段前向。再讲外部设计：并行进程组如何组织以支撑分布式执行，以及优化器如何处理专家参数——它与稠密层并不相同。

2.1.MoE Layer Architecture and Forward PassMoE 层架构与前向传播

An MoE layer replaces the dense feed-forward network (FFN) in a transformer block with a collection of expert FFNs, only a subset of which process each token. Megatron-Core implements this through three modular components (a router for token-to-expert assignment, a token dispatcher for cross-GPU communication, and experts for computation) connected through the four-stage forward pass shown in figure 1. This separation of concerns enables independent optimization: the router can be fused into CUDA Graphs without affecting dispatcher logic, dispatchers can be swapped between all-to-all and DeepEP without modifying expert computation, and expert implementations can use different GEMM backends transparently.

MoE 层用一组专家 FFN 替换 Transformer 块里的稠密前馈网络（FFN），每个 token 只由其中一部分专家处理。Megatron-Core 通过三个模块化组件实现：负责 token 到专家分配的 router、负责跨 GPU 通信的 token dispatcher、负责计算的专家；三者由图 1 所示的四阶段前向串联起来。这种关注点分离让各部分可以独立优化：router 可以被融进 CUDA Graphs 而不影响 dispatcher 逻辑；dispatcher 可以在 all-to-all 与 DeepEP 之间切换而无需改动专家计算；专家实现可以透明地更换不同的 GEMM 后端。

2.1.1.Forward Pass: Route, Dispatch, Compute, Combine前向传播：Route、Dispatch、Compute、Combine

The MoE layer processes input tokens through four sequential stages:

MoE 层依次通过四个阶段处理输入 token：

Stage 1: Route. The TopKRouter determines which experts process each token. A learned linear projection maps each token’s hidden state to EE logits (one per expert), a score function (softmax or sigmoid) converts logits to probabilities, and top-kk selection identifies the highest-scoring experts for each token. The router outputs two tensors: probs containing the routing weights, and routing_map, a boolean mask indicating token-expert assignments. For numerical stability with many experts, the router can operate in FP32 via --moe-router-dtype fp32.

阶段一：Route。TopKRouter 决定每个 token 由哪些专家处理。一个可学习的线性投影把每个 token 的隐状态映射成 E 个 logit（每个专家一个），打分函数（softmax 或 sigmoid）把 logit 转成概率，再用 top-k 选出得分最高的专家。router 输出两个张量：probs 保存路由权重，routing_map 是一个指示 token-专家分配的布尔掩码。专家数很多时，为保证数值稳定，可以用 --moe-router-dtype fp32 让 router 以 FP32 运行。

Stage 2: Dispatch. The token dispatcher prepares tokens for cross-GPU communication. It first permutes tokens so that all tokens destined for the same expert are contiguous; this permutation is essential for efficient dense GEMM on the expert side. The dispatcher then moves tokens to the GPUs hosting their assigned experts using one of three backends: AllGather (simple but memory-intensive), all-to-all (standard NCCL-based), or Flex (supporting optimized backends like DeepEP and HybridEP).

阶段二：Dispatch。token dispatcher 为跨 GPU 通信做准备。它先把 token 重排，使发往同一专家的 token 连续存放；这次 permutation 是专家侧高效执行稠密 GEMM 的前提。随后 dispatcher 用三种后端之一把 token 送到承载对应专家的 GPU：AllGather（简单但吃显存）、all-to-all（标准 NCCL 实现）、Flex（可接入 DeepEP、HybridEP 等优化后端）。

Stage 3: Expert Computation. Each GPU executes its local experts on the received tokens. All local experts run in a single Grouped GEMM call via TEGroupedMLP, maximizing GPU utilization even when individual expert workloads are small.

阶段三：专家计算。每块 GPU 用本地专家处理收到的 token。所有本地专家通过 TEGroupedMLP 在一次 Grouped GEMM 调用中执行，即便单个专家的负载很小，也能把 GPU 利用率拉满。

Stage 4: Combine. The inverse communication returns processed tokens to their original GPUs, followed by unpermutation to restore the original sequence order. If a shared expert is configured, its output (optionally computed in parallel with routed experts) is added at this stage.

阶段四：Combine。反向通信把处理完的 token 送回原 GPU，再通过反重排恢复原始序列顺序。如果配置了共享专家，它的输出（可以选择与路由专家并行计算）在这一阶段相加。

2.1.2.Router: Token-to-Expert AssignmentRouter：token 到专家的分配

The router transforms a global token batch into expert-specific workloads through two operations [82]:

router 通过两个操作把全局 token 批次转换成各专家的工作负载 [82]：

  • 1. Gating: A linear projection 𝐖r∈ℝh×E\mathbf{W}_{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times E} maps each token’s hidden state 𝐱∈ℝh\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{h} to logits 𝐥=𝐖r⊤​𝐱∈ℝE\mathbf{l}=\mathbf{W}_{r}^{\top}\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{E}.1. 门控：线性投影 W_r ∈ ℝ^{h×E} 把每个 token 的隐状态 x ∈ ℝ^h 映射为 logit l = W_rᵀx ∈ ℝ^E。
  • 2. Top-kk Selection: A score function converts logits to probabilities: softmax (pi=eli/∑jeljp_{i}=e^{l_{i}}/\sum_{j}e^{l_{j}}) or sigmoid (pi=σ⁡(li)/∑jσ⁡(lj)p_{i}=\sigma(l_{i})/\sum_{j}\sigma(l_{j}), used by DeepSeek-V3 [19]). The top-kk experts with highest probabilities are selected per token.2. Top-k 选择：打分函数把 logit 转成概率——softmax（p_i = e^{l_i} / Σ_j e^{l_j}）或 sigmoid（p_i = σ(l_i) / Σ_j σ(l_j)，DeepSeek-V3 用的就是后者 [19]）。每个 token 选出概率最高的 top-k 个专家。

Uneven expert utilization degrades both training efficiency and model quality. As shown in figure 2, Megatron-Core supports multiple load balancing strategies; these are discussed in Section 7.

专家利用率不均会同时损害训练效率与模型质量。如图 2 所示，Megatron-Core 支持多种负载均衡策略，详见第 7 节。

2.1.3.Token Dispatcher: Communication AbstractionToken Dispatcher：通信抽象

The dispatcher manages token movement between GPUs through a six-phase pipeline: dispatch_preprocess →\rightarrow token_dispatch →\rightarrow dispatch_postprocess (forward), and combine_preprocess →\rightarrow token_combine →\rightarrow combine_postprocess (backward).

dispatcher 通过六阶段流水线管理 GPU 之间的 token 搬运：前向为 dispatch_preprocess → token_dispatch → dispatch_postprocess，反向为 combine_preprocess → token_combine → combine_postprocess。

Communication Backends. Three dispatcher types are available:

通信后端。可用的 dispatcher 有三种：

  • • AllGather (allgather): Each GPU gathers all tokens and filters for local experts. Simple but memory-intensive; suitable for small EP sizes.AllGather（allgather）：每块 GPU 收集全部 token，再筛出属于本地专家的部分。实现简单但吃显存，适合较小的 EP 规模。
  • • All-To-All (all-to-all): Standard NCCL-based point-to-point communication [47]. Each GPU sends only the tokens needed by each destination. Scales well but incurs synchronization overhead.All-To-All（all-to-all）：基于 NCCL 的标准点对点通信 [47]。每块 GPU 只发送各个目的地所需的 token。扩展性好，但有同步开销。
  • • Flex (flex): Unified design supporting DeepEP (only high-throughput kernels are integrated, hiding NVLink communication latency through overlap) [100] and HybridEP (high-bandwidth MoE communication kernels that deliver better performance on NVLink-rich topologies like NVL72).Flex（flex）：统一设计，支持 DeepEP（只集成高吞吐 kernel，通过重叠把 NVLink 通信延迟藏起来）[100] 与 HybridEP（高带宽 MoE 通信 kernel，在 NVL72 这类 NVLink 资源丰富的拓扑上表现更好）。

2.1.4.Experts: Computation Module专家：计算模块

Each expert is a two-layer MLP with optional gating (for SwiGLU/GeGLU activations [83]). Grouped GEMM enables efficient batching of multiple expert computations [27, 35]. Two implementations are available:

每个专家是一个两层 MLP，可选带门控（用于 SwiGLU/GeGLU 激活 [83]）。Grouped GEMM 让多个专家的计算可以高效地批处理 [27, 35]。有两种实现：

  • • TEGroupedMLP: Transformer Engine [13] optimized implementation supporting FP8 and FP4 quantization.TEGroupedMLP：基于 Transformer Engine [13] 的优化实现，支持 FP8 与 FP4 量化。
  • • SequentialMLP: Executes experts one at a time in a loop. Useful for debugging but significantly slower.SequentialMLP：在循环里逐个执行专家。便于调试，但明显更慢。

Shared Experts. Some architectures (DeepSeek-V2/V3 [18, 19], Qwen [73]) include a shared expert that processes all tokens regardless of routing. Shared expert computation can run in parallel with the dispatch-compute-combine pipeline, hiding its latency. See Section 7 for details.

共享专家。有些架构（DeepSeek-V2/V3 [18, 19]、Qwen [73]）包含一个共享专家，它不理会路由结果、处理所有 token。共享专家的计算可以与 dispatch-compute-combine 流水并行，把延迟藏起来。详见第 7 节。

2.2.System Integration: Parallelism and Optimizer系统集成：并行与优化器

Having described how an MoE layer works internally, we now examine how it integrates into the distributed training system: parallel process groups and optimizer handling.

讲完 MoE 层的内部工作机制，接下来看它如何融入分布式训练系统：并行进程组与优化器处理。

2.2.1.Parallel Group Management并行进程组管理

MoE layers require distinct process groups from dense layers because different components have different communication patterns. Megatron-Core organizes these groups through ProcessGroupCollection:

MoE 层需要与稠密层不同的进程组，因为各组件的通信模式不同。Megatron-Core 通过 ProcessGroupCollection 组织这些进程组：

ProcessGroupCollection
├─ Attention Layer Groups: tp, cp, dp, pp
└─ Expert Layer Groups:    ep, expt_tp, expt_dp, pp

Each MoE component uses specific groups based on its communication requirements:

每个 MoE 组件按自身的通信需求使用特定的进程组：

表 1　MoE 组件与进程组的对应关系。MoE component to process group mapping.
ComponentGroups UsedReason
Routertp, cp, tp_cpWeights duplicated across EP ranks
Token Dispatcherep, tp_epall-to-all across expert ranks
Expertsep, expt_tp, expt_dpSharded across EP; gradients reduced in EDP
Shared ExpertstpSame as dense MLP

This separation enables Parallel Folding (Section 3.3): attention and MoE layers can use different TP/DP configurations. For example, attention layers might use TP=4 while MoE layers use ETP=1 with higher EP, optimizing each layer type independently.

这种分离正是 Parallel Folding（第 3.3 节）的基础：注意力层与 MoE 层可以使用不同的 TP/DP 配置。例如注意力层用 TP=4，而 MoE 层用 ETP=1 配合更高的 EP，从而各自独立优化。

2.2.2.Optimizer and Gradient Handling优化器与梯度处理

Expert parameters require distinct handling in distributed optimization. Megatron-Core uses a ChainedOptimizer that wraps separate optimizers for dense and expert parameters. Three key design decisions support correct MoE optimization:

在分布式优化中，专家参数需要单独处理。Megatron-Core 使用 ChainedOptimizer，把稠密参数与专家参数各自的优化器串起来。三个关键设计决策保证了 MoE 优化的正确性：

  • 1. Parameter Identification. Expert parameters are marked with allreduce=False, distinguishing them from dense parameters that use standard data-parallel gradient reduction.1. 参数识别。专家参数被标记为 allreduce=False，与走标准数据并行梯度归约的稠密参数区分开。
  • 2. Separate Reduction Groups. Dense layers reduce gradients across dp_cp_group (full data parallelism), while experts reduce across expt_dp_group (expert data parallelism). This ensures gradients are averaged over the correct number of replicas.2. 独立归约组。稠密层在 dp_cp_group（完整数据并行）上归约梯度，专家则在 expt_dp_group（专家数据并行）上归约。这样能保证梯度按正确的副本数取平均。
  • 3. Gradient Scaling. Expert gradients are scaled by edp_size / dp_size to account for the different effective batch sizes seen by experts (which process routing-dependent token subsets) versus dense layers.3. 梯度缩放。专家梯度按 edp_size / dp_size 缩放，以补偿专家与稠密层所见有效 batch size 的差异——专家处理的是依赖路由结果的 token 子集。

This design allows ZeRO-style optimizer state sharding [75] to work seamlessly with MoE: optimizer states for expert parameters are sharded across the EP group, while states for dense parameters follow standard DP sharding.

这套设计让 ZeRO 式的优化器状态分片 [75] 与 MoE 无缝配合：专家参数的优化器状态在 EP 组内分片，稠密参数的状态则沿用标准 DP 分片。

With the architecture established, Section 3 addresses how to distribute it across devices, and Section 4 tackles the memory, communication, and compute efficiency challenges that arise at scale.

架构讲清楚了，第 3 节讨论如何在设备间分布它，第 4 节处理规模化之后出现的显存、通信与计算效率挑战。

3.Scaling MoE: Parallel Folding and Multi-Dimensional Parallelism扩展 MoE：Parallel Folding 与多维并行

Section 1.2 established that MoE’s sparsity decouples model size from per-token computation, creating a parameter-compute mismatch that makes Expert Parallelism (EP) necessary but introduces all-to-all communication. This section examines how that mismatch concretely affects parallelism design. We first review the parallelism baseline for dense models and the trade-offs it entails, then show how MoE’s sparsity breaks the assumptions underlying these strategies. Finally, we present MoE Parallel Folding, Megatron-Core’s solution to the resulting dense-sparse mismatch: attention and MoE layers have conflicting optimal parallelism configurations, and Parallel Folding decouples their mappings so each can use its optimal topology.

第 1.2 节已经说明：MoE 的稀疏性把模型规模与每 token 计算量解耦，造成参数-计算失配，使得专家并行（EP）成为必需，但也引入了 all-to-all 通信。本节具体考察这种失配如何影响并行设计。我们先回顾稠密模型的并行基线与随之而来的取舍，再说明 MoE 的稀疏性如何打破这些策略赖以成立的前提。最后介绍 MoE Parallel Folding——Megatron-Core 对稠密-稀疏失配的解法：注意力层与 MoE 层的最优并行配置彼此冲突，Parallel Folding 把两者的映射解耦，让各自都能用上最优拓扑。

3.1.Why Parallelism, and Why MoE is Different为什么要并行，以及 MoE 为何不同

Before examining MoE-specific challenges, we establish the fundamental reasons parallelism is necessary for large model training and the trade-offs it introduces.

在讨论 MoE 特有的挑战之前，先厘清大模型训练为什么必须并行，以及并行带来了哪些取舍。

3.1.1.Why Large Model Training Needs Parallelism大模型训练为什么需要并行

Memory is the fundamental constraint. A single GPU has limited memory, but training a large model requires storing model parameters, optimizer states, gradients, and activations simultaneously [77]. Consider Llama-405B [30, 88, 89] trained with BF16 precision and Adam optimizer:

显存是最根本的约束。单块 GPU 的显存有限，而训练大模型要同时存放模型参数、优化器状态、梯度与激活 [77]。以 BF16 精度加 Adam 优化器训练的 Llama-405B [30, 88, 89] 为例：

ComponentMemory (Llama-405B, BF16)
Model parameters$\sim$810 GB
Optimizer states (Adam)$\sim$4860 GB
Gradients$\sim$1620 GB
Activations (8K sequence)$\sim$5575 GB
Total$\sim$12865 GB

This far exceeds any single GPU’s capacity. Multiple GPUs are not optional; they are required to hold the model.

这远远超出任何单块 GPU 的容量。多卡不是可选项，而是装下模型的必要条件。

Compute throughput is the efficiency reason. Beyond memory, a single GPU has limited compute capacity. Large model training requires astronomical FLOPs; aggregating multiple GPUs increases throughput and reduces wall-clock training time from years to weeks.

算力吞吐是效率层面的原因。除显存之外，单卡的计算能力也有限。大模型训练需要的 FLOPs 是天文数字；把多块 GPU 聚起来才能提高吞吐，把实际训练时间从数年压到数周。

3.1.2.The Trade-off of Parallelism并行的代价

Parallelism is not free. Every parallelism strategy introduces overhead:

并行并非没有代价。每种并行策略都会引入开销：

  • • Communication overhead: Data exchange between GPUs consumes time and bandwidth.通信开销：GPU 之间的数据交换消耗时间与带宽。
  • • Synchronization: Fast GPUs must wait for slow GPUs at synchronization points.同步：在同步点上，快的 GPU 必须等慢的 GPU。
  • • Pipeline bubbles: Pipeline parallelism introduces idle time at pipeline boundaries.流水气泡：流水并行在流水边界引入空闲时间。
  • • Reduced compute intensity: Sharding reduces per-GPU matrix sizes, lowering GEMM efficiency.计算强度下降：切分让单卡上的矩阵变小，GEMM 效率随之降低。

The result: Model FLOP Utilization (MFU) is heavily influenced by parallelism strategy, and effective parallelism design can minimize the gap between ideal and actual MFU.

结果是：模型 FLOP 利用率（MFU）在很大程度上取决于并行策略，而好的并行设计能把理想 MFU 与实际 MFU 之间的差距压到最小。

Key insight for dense models: The “cost” and “benefit” of parallelism scale proportionally. More parameters require more GPUs, but more parameters also mean more computation per forward-backward pass. Because computation grows with model size, communication takes a smaller share of each step, keeping MFU relatively stable as models scale.

稠密模型的关键洞察：并行的「成本」与「收益」是等比伸缩的。参数越多需要越多 GPU，但参数越多也意味着每次前向-反向往回有更多计算。由于计算随模型规模增长，通信在每一步里的占比反而变小，因此模型扩展时 MFU 相对稳定。

MoE’s sparsity disrupts this balance. Because only KK of EE experts activate per token, total parameters scale with EE while per-token compute scales only with KK. More GPUs are needed for memory, but per-token computation does not grow to match, leaving communication overhead exposed. The following section examines how this asymmetry breaks the assumptions underlying traditional parallelism strategies and why a new parallelism dimension is needed.

MoE 的稀疏性打破了这种平衡。由于每个 token 只激活 E 个专家中的 K 个，总参数随 E 伸缩，而每 token 计算只随 K 伸缩。装下模型需要更多 GPU，但每 token 计算量并没有相应增长，通信开销于是暴露出来。下一节考察这种不对称如何打破传统并行策略的前提，以及为什么需要一个新的并行维度。

3.2.The Challenge of MoE ParallelismMoE 并行的挑战

Traditional parallelism strategies were designed for dense Transformers. MoE models have fundamentally different computation patterns that require a new parallelism dimension, Expert Parallelism (EP), and create unique challenges when combining EP with existing strategies.

传统并行策略是为稠密 Transformer 设计的。MoE 模型的计算模式有本质不同，需要一个全新的并行维度——专家并行（EP）；而把 EP 与既有策略组合起来，又会产生独特的挑战。

3.2.1.The Parallelism Paradox of MoEMoE 的并行悖论

Figure 3 illustrates this paradox by plotting total parameters against forward FLOPs per token for major LLMs. Dense models (circles) follow the ≈\approx2N reference line, exhibiting a virtuous cycle as they scale: increasing parameters requires more GPUs for memory, but more parameters also means more computation per token. Because computation grows with model size, communication takes a smaller share of each step, keeping MFU stable.

图 3 把主流大模型的总参数与每 token 前向 FLOPs 画在一起，直观展示了这个悖论。稠密模型（圆点）沿 ≈2N 的参考线分布，扩展时呈现良性循环：参数变多要用更多 GPU 装，但参数变多也意味着每 token 计算量更大。由于计算随模型规模增长，通信在每一步里的占比变小，MFU 保持稳定。

MoE models (triangles) break this cycle. They fall significantly below the 2N line, achieving equivalent capability with far fewer FLOPs per token. Consider the fundamental asymmetry:

MoE 模型（三角）打破了这个循环。它们明显落在 2N 线下方，用远少的每 token FLOPs 达到同等能力。看这种根本性的不对称：

ModelTotal ParamsActive ParamsRatio
Llama-70B (Dense)70B70B1:1
DeepSeek-V3 (MoE)685B37B18:1

Note: DeepSeek-V3 comprises 671B Main Model weights and 14B Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) Module weights (685B total). The table shows the total model parameters including MTP.

注：DeepSeek-V3 由 671B 主模型权重与 14B 多 token 预测（MTP）模块权重组成（合计 685B）。表中显示的是包含 MTP 在内的总参数量。

DeepSeek-V3 has 18×\times more parameters than its active computation suggests, visible in Figure 3 as the gap between DeepSeek-V3’s position and where a dense model of equivalent parameters would lie. This creates a compounding effect:

DeepSeek-V3 的参数总量是「其激活计算量所暗示的规模」的 18 倍，在图 3 中表现为 DeepSeek-V3 的位置与「同等参数量的稠密模型应在的位置」之间的落差。这带来一种叠加效应：

  • 1. Memory grows fast, forcing distribution across many GPUs: All EE experts’ parameters, gradients, and optimizer states must reside in memory, and larger top-kk further increases activation memory through token replication.1. 显存增长快，迫使模型分散到许多 GPU：全部 E 个专家的参数、梯度与优化器状态都必须驻留显存，而 top-k 越大会因 token 复制进一步推高激活显存。
  • 2. More communication: Distributing experts via EP introduces all-to-all traffic whose volume scales with KK (each token is dispatched to KK experts across EP ranks).2. 通信更多：用 EP 分布专家会引入 all-to-all 流量，其规模随 K 增长（每个 token 都要被派发到 EP 各 rank 上的 K 个专家）。
  • 3. But compute stays low: Per-token FLOPs scale only with NactiveN_{\text{active}} (∝K\propto K), not NtotalN_{\text{total}} (∝E\propto E), leaving insufficient computation to overlap with the growing communication.3. 但计算量始终很低：每 token FLOPs 只随 N_active（∝ K）伸缩，而不随 N_total（∝ E）伸缩，因此没有足够的计算去与不断增长的通信重叠。

The consequence: MoE training is fundamentally communication-bound unless parallelism is designed specifically for this asymmetry. This is not a matter of degree; it is a qualitative difference from dense models.

后果是：除非并行方案专门针对这种不对称来设计，否则 MoE 训练从根本上就是通信受限的。这不是程度上的差别，而是与稠密模型之间的性质差异。

3.2.2.Traditional Parallelism Strategies传统并行策略

Dense Transformer training typically combines four parallelism strategies:

稠密 Transformer 训练通常组合四种并行策略：

Tensor Parallelism (TP) shards weight matrices across GPUs along the hidden dimension [85]. Each GPU computes a partial result, then AllGather or ReduceScatter collectives combine results. TP works well when matrices are large enough to offset communication overhead.

张量并行（TP）沿隐藏维把权重矩阵切分到多块 GPU [85]。每块 GPU 算出一部分结果，再用 AllGather 或 ReduceScatter 集合通信合并。当矩阵足够大、能抵消通信开销时，TP 效果很好。

Pipeline Parallelism (PP) splits the model by layers across GPUs [34, 61, 85, 72, 71, 50, 31]. Micro-batches flow through the pipeline, with point-to-point communication between stages. PP introduces pipeline bubbles (idle time at boundaries) and P2P communication overhead, but scales better across nodes than TP.

流水并行（PP）按层把模型切开、分到多块 GPU [34, 61, 85, 72, 71, 50, 31]。micro-batch 在流水线中流动，阶段之间做点对点通信。PP 会带来流水气泡（边界处的空闲时间）与 P2P 通信开销，但跨节点扩展性比 TP 好。

Data Parallelism (DP) replicates the model across GPUs, with each GPU processing different data batches [81, 3]. Gradients are synchronized via AllReduce. DP is simple but requires each GPU to hold the full model.

数据并行（DP）把模型复制到多块 GPU，每块处理不同的数据批次 [81, 3]，梯度通过 AllReduce 同步。DP 简单，但要求每块 GPU 都存下完整模型。

Context Parallelism (CP) [42, 53, 37] partitions the input sequence across GPUs along the sequence dimension. Each GPU processes a contiguous chunk of the sequence, with communication required only for attention computation where tokens must attend across chunk boundaries. CP is essential for long-context training where activation memory scales quadratically with sequence length.

上下文并行（CP）[42, 53, 37] 沿序列维把输入序列切分到多块 GPU。每块 GPU 处理序列中连续的一段，只有注意力计算需要在跨越分块边界处通信。在激活显存随序列长度平方增长的长上下文训练中，CP 不可或缺。

Why traditional parallelism fails for MoE:

传统并行为什么在 MoE 上失效：

  • • TP on MoE experts: Expert hidden dimensions are small; applying TP creates even smaller shards, reducing compute efficiency while increasing communication’s share of total time. High TP can distribute attention efficiently but hurts MoE.对 MoE 专家用 TP：专家的隐藏维本来就小，再用 TP 会切出更小的分片，计算效率下降，通信在总时间里的占比反而上升。高 TP 能高效分发注意力，却会伤害 MoE。
  • • PP with many experts: MoE models have massive parameter counts, requiring many pipeline stages if using PP alone. This creates excessive pipeline bubbles and reduces throughput.用 PP 承载大量专家：MoE 参数量巨大，单靠 PP 需要很多流水阶段，会产生过多气泡、拉低吞吐。
  • • DP alone: DP replicates the full model on each GPU. For a trillion parameter model, this is impossible because DP cannot partition parameters, only data.只用 DP：DP 在每块 GPU 上复制完整模型。对万亿参数模型这不可能，因为 DP 只能切数据、不能切参数。

3.2.3.Expert Parallelism: The Fifth Dimension专家并行：第五个维度

Traditional parallelism partitions layers (PP), weight matrices (TP), sequence (CP), or data (DP). But MoE has a unique structure: experts are independent sub-networks. This enables a fifth parallelism dimension that partitions experts themselves across GPUs.

传统并行切的是层（PP）、权重矩阵（TP）、序列（CP）或数据（DP）。而 MoE 有一个独特结构：专家是彼此独立的子网络。这就允许出现第五个并行维度，把专家本身切分到多块 GPU 上。

Expert Parallelism (EP) distributes experts across GPUs [47]. With EP degree equal to EE, each GPU holds E/EPE/\text{EP} experts. The forward pass proceeds as:

专家并行（EP）把专家分布到多块 GPU [47]。当 EP 度等于 E 时，每块 GPU 持有 E/EP 个专家。前向过程如下：

  • 1. Route: The router selects top-kk experts for each token.1. Route：router 为每个 token 选出 top-k 个专家。
  • 2. Dispatch: all-to-all communication sends tokens to the GPUs holding their assigned experts.2. Dispatch：all-to-all 通信把 token 送到承载对应专家的 GPU。
  • 3. Compute: Each GPU processes tokens using only its local experts.3. Compute：每块 GPU 只用本地专家处理 token。
  • 4. Combine: all-to-all communication returns results to original GPUs.4. Combine：all-to-all 通信把结果送回原 GPU。

EP’s unique trade-off:

EP 独特的取舍：

  • • Communication: all-to-all collectives. Volume scales with token count, not expert count.通信：all-to-all 集合通信。通信量随 token 数增长，而不随专家数增长。
  • • Compute: Each GPU runs fewer experts, but each expert processes its full hidden dimension.计算：每块 GPU 运行的专家更少，但每个专家处理的仍是完整隐藏维。
  • • Memory: Higher EP = fewer experts per GPU = lower memory pressure.显存：EP 越高，每卡专家越少，显存压力越低。

EP provides two key benefits (figure 4). First, grouping tokens from different GPUs to a single expert increases computation intensity, improving GEMM efficiency. Second, all-to-all communication volume remains constant as expert count increases; only the number of GPUs changes.

EP 有两个关键好处（图 4）。第一，把来自不同 GPU 的 token 汇聚到同一个专家，提高了计算强度，GEMM 效率更好。第二，专家数增加时 all-to-all 的通信量保持不变，变的只是 GPU 的数量。

But EP alone is not enough. EP applies only to MoE layers; attention layers have no experts and still require TP, CP, or other strategies. Moreover, both layer types need Pipeline Parallelism to further partition model parameters for large-scale MoE training. This heterogeneity creates the dense-sparse mismatch discussed next.

但只有 EP 还不够。EP 只作用于 MoE 层；注意力层没有专家，仍需 TP、CP 或其他策略。此外，两类层都需要流水并行来进一步切分模型参数，才能撑起大规模 MoE 训练。这种异质性造成了接下来要讨论的稠密-稀疏失配。

3.2.4.The Challenges of Combining EP with Traditional ParallelismEP 与传统并行结合的挑战

A single Transformer block contains two fundamentally different computation patterns [86], summarized in Table 2:

同一个 Transformer 块里包含两种截然不同的计算模式 [86]，表 2 做了归纳：

表 2　同一 Transformer 块内，注意力层与 MoE 层对并行的不同需求。Contrasting parallelism requirements of attention and MoE layers within a single Transformer block.
AspectAttention (Dense)MoE (Sparse)
ComputationEvery token attends to all othersEach token routes to $K$ of $E$ experts
TPLarge QKV matrices benefit from high TPSmall per-expert dimensions make high TP counterproductive
CPLong sequences benefit from high CPNo sequence dependency; CP is irrelevant
EPNot applicable (no experts)Essential for distributing many experts

The Dense-Sparse Mismatch. Traditional frameworks force one parallelism configuration for both layer types, but their optimal configurations conflict directly: high TP benefits attention but fragments expert shards; high CP helps long-context attention but provides no benefit to MoE layers; and high EP is essential for MoE but irrelevant to attention. Like the parameter-compute mismatch (Section 1.2), this stems from MoE’s sparsity, but manifests at the parallelism configuration level: it is a structural mismatch between dense and sparse layers’ needs, not a tuning problem.

稠密-稀疏失配。传统框架强制两类层共用一套并行配置，但它们的最优配置直接冲突：高 TP 有利于注意力，却把专家分片切得更碎；高 CP 有利于长上下文注意力，对 MoE 层却毫无帮助；高 EP 对 MoE 必不可少，对注意力却无关紧要。与参数-计算失配（第 1.2 节）一样，这源自 MoE 的稀疏性，但表现在并行配置层面：这是稠密层与稀疏层需求之间的结构性错配，而不是调参能解决的问题。

Prior MoE frameworks treat EP as a sub-dimension of DP [47, 25]:

此前的 MoE 框架把 EP 当作 DP 的子维度 [47, 25]：

World Size=TP×CP×PP×DP,where EP⊆DP\text{World Size}=\text{TP}\times\text{CP}\times\text{PP}\times\text{DP},\quad\text{where }\text{EP}\subseteq\text{DP}

This constraint exists because frameworks assumed uniform parallelism: attention layers use (TP, CP, PP, DP), and MoE layers simply carve EP out of the DP group. This design creates three critical challenges:

这个约束源于「统一并行」的假设：注意力层使用 (TP, CP, PP, DP)，MoE 层则直接从 DP 组里切出 EP。这种设计带来三个关键问题：

Challenge 1: Multiplicative GPU Requirements. Traditional frameworks require TP×CP×PP×DP\text{TP}\times\text{CP}\times\text{PP}\times\text{DP} GPUs at minimum. Since EP ⊆\subseteq DP, requesting EP=8 forces DP ≥\geq 8. Combined with CP=8 for long sequences, the minimum becomes 1×8×1×8=641\times 8\times 1\times 8=64 GPUs—even if attention and MoE could theoretically share the same 8 GPUs. This inflates the entry barrier for MoE training.

问题一：GPU 需求被乘起来。传统框架至少需要 TP×CP×PP×DP 块 GPU。由于 EP ⊆ DP，要 EP=8 就必须 DP ≥ 8；再叠加长序列所需的 CP=8，最低配置变成 1×8×1×8 = 64 块 GPU——尽管从计算上看，注意力和 MoE 本可以共用这 8 块。这抬高了 MoE 训练的入门门槛。

Challenge 2: Forced Suboptimal Parallelism. Since attention and MoE share the same TP configuration, practitioners must choose between two suboptimal configurations: use high TP (e.g., TP=8) to efficiently shard large attention matrices, which fragments small experts into inefficient shards; or use low TP (e.g., TP=1) to preserve expert computation efficiency, which leaves attention layers underparallelized. Neither option achieves optimal performance for both layer types.

问题二：被迫选次优并行。由于注意力与 MoE 共用同一套 TP 配置，实践者只能在两个次优方案里挑一个：用高 TP（如 TP=8）高效切分注意力的大矩阵，却把小专家切成效率很低的碎片；或者用低 TP（如 TP=1）保住专家计算效率，却让注意力层并行不足。没有哪个方案能让两类层同时达到最优。

Challenge 3: Cross-Node Communication. With EP constrained within DP, high EP often forces all-to-all communication to cross node boundaries, where bandwidth is 5–10×\times lower than NVLink. Meanwhile, CP communication for attention may also span nodes. Without the ability to independently map EP and CP to high-bandwidth domains, communication overhead dominates training time.

问题三：跨节点通信。EP 被限制在 DP 之内时，高 EP 往往迫使 all-to-all 跨越节点边界，那里的带宽比 NVLink 低 5–10 倍。同时，注意力的 CP 通信也可能跨节点。如果无法把 EP 与 CP 各自独立映射到高带宽域，通信开销就会主导训练时间。

These challenges are not independent tuning problems. They stem from the fundamental assumption that all layers must share one parallelism configuration. The question becomes: How do we break these constraints while still allowing each layer type to use its optimal parallelism?

这些挑战不是彼此独立的调参问题，它们源自同一个根本假设：所有层必须共用一套并行配置。于是问题变成：如何在打破这些约束的同时，仍让每类层用上自己的最优并行？

3.3.Megatron-Core’s Solution: Parallel Folding and Multi-Dimensional FrameworkMegatron-Core 的解法：Parallel Folding 与多维并行框架

Parallel Folding is Megatron-Core’s answer to the dense-sparse mismatch. Rather than forcing attention and MoE layers to share the same parallelism configuration, Parallel Folding decouples their parallelism mappings, allowing each layer type to use its optimal topology [52]. This section covers the key concepts and benefits; implementation details such as parallelism transition handling and token dispatch design are described in the companion paper [52].

Parallel Folding 是 Megatron-Core 对稠密-稀疏失配的回答。它不再强迫注意力层与 MoE 层共用同一套并行配置，而是把两者的并行映射解耦，让每类层使用自己的最优拓扑 [52]。本节介绍核心概念与收益；并行切换处理、token dispatch 设计等实现细节见配套论文 [52]。

3.3.1.Decoupled Parallelism Mappings解耦的并行映射

The core idea is simple: do not force attention and MoE to share parallelism. Let each use its optimal configuration independently.

核心思想很简单：不要强迫注意力与 MoE 共用并行方案，让各自独立使用最优配置。

Parallel Folding introduces separate parallelism groups for attention and MoE layers:

Parallel Folding 为注意力层与 MoE 层引入各自独立的并行组：

  • • Attention layers form groups over TP×CP×DP×PP\text{TP}\times\text{CP}\times\text{DP}\times\text{PP}, optimized for sequence-level dense computation.注意力层在 TP×CP×DP×PP 上组网，针对序列级的稠密计算优化。
  • • MoE layers form groups over ETP×EP×EDP×PP\text{ETP}\times\text{EP}\times\text{EDP}\times\text{PP}, where ETP (Expert Tensor Parallelism) and EDP (Expert Data Parallelism) are MoE-specific dimensions.MoE 层在 ETP×EP×EDP×PP 上组网，其中 ETP（专家张量并行）与 EDP（专家数据并行）是 MoE 专属维度。

The sole constraint: Pipeline Parallelism (PP) must remain consistent across both layouts to ensure correct gradient flow through the model.

唯一的约束：流水并行（PP）在两种布局中必须一致，以保证梯度在模型中正确流动。

3.3.2.Complete Multi-Dimensional Parallelism Stack完整的多维并行栈

With Parallel Folding as the foundation, Megatron-Core orchestrates five parallelism dimensions:

以 Parallel Folding 为基础，Megatron-Core 编排五个并行维度：

DimensionApplies ToPurpose
TP (Tensor)AttentionShard large QKV/projection matrices
CP (Context)AttentionDistribute long sequences
DP (Data)AttentionProcess different batches
PP (Pipeline)BothSplit model by layers (must be consistent)
EP (Expert)MoEDistribute experts across GPUs
ETP (Expert Tensor)MoEShard within experts (rarely used)
EDP (Expert Data)MoEReplicate experts for throughput

Key configuration principles:

关键配置原则：

  • • Attention layers: Optimize for large matrices (high TP) and long sequences (high CP).注意力层：面向大矩阵（高 TP）与长序列（高 CP）优化。
  • • MoE layers: Optimize for many small experts (high EP, typically ETP=1).MoE 层：面向「多而小的专家」优化（高 EP，通常 ETP=1）。
  • • PP: Must remain consistent across both to ensure correct data flow.PP：两侧必须保持一致，以保证数据流正确。

Beyond the parallelism strategies described above (figure 6), Megatron-Core’s Parallel Folding framework also integrates Distributed Optimizer and FSDP with EP support to further reduce memory footprint:

除上述并行策略之外（图 6），Megatron-Core 的 Parallel Folding 框架还把分布式优化器与支持 EP 的 FSDP 集成进来，进一步压低显存占用：

Distributed Optimizer + EP. Only weights and gradients for local experts reside on each rank; optimizer states are sharded among replicas of the same expert (via EDP). This removes redundant optimizer memory for non-local experts and confines gradient synchronization to minimal groups.

分布式优化器 + EP。每个 rank 上只保留本地专家的权重与梯度；优化器状态在同一专家的各个副本之间分片（通过 EDP）。这样就去掉了非本地专家那部分冗余的优化器显存，并把梯度同步限制在最小的组内。

FSDP + EP. For even greater memory efficiency, Megatron-Core’s custom FSDP (Megatron-FSDP) fully shards parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across data/expert groups via a dual DeviceMesh architecture, reducing memory footprint while overlapping AllGather and ReduceScatter with computation. It is compatible with TP/EP/CP and mixed precision (BF16, FP8, FP4). See section 4.1.7 for the full design.

FSDP + EP。为进一步提升显存效率，Megatron-Core 自研的 FSDP（Megatron-FSDP）通过双 DeviceMesh 架构，把参数、梯度与优化器状态在数据/专家组之间完全分片，在降低显存占用的同时把 AllGather 与 ReduceScatter 与计算重叠。它兼容 TP/EP/CP 与混合精度（BF16、FP8、FP4）。完整设计见第 4.1.7 节。

3.3.3.Benefits of Parallel FoldingParallel Folding 的收益

As illustrated in figure 5, MoE Parallel Folding eliminates the EP ≤\leq DP limitation by allowing EP to “fold” across arbitrary sub-groups of the attention parallelism configuration. This provides four key advantages:

如图 5 所示，MoE Parallel Folding 让 EP 可以「折叠」到注意力并行配置的任意子组上，从而消除了 EP ≤ DP 的限制。这带来四个关键好处：

  • 1. Breaks the EP ≤\leq DP constraint: EP can now exceed DP by folding across TP×\timesCP groups. Consider attention configured with TP=4, CP=2, DP=8, PP=4 (total 256 GPUs): • Traditional: EP ≤\leq DP = 8, so maximum EP is 8. • With Parallel Folding: MoE uses ETP=1, EP=64, EDP=1 (same PP=4). EP “folds” across the TP×\timesCP×\timesDP groups, enabling 8×\times higher expert parallelism while attention layers maintain their optimal TP=4, CP=2 configuration.1. 打破 EP ≤ DP 约束：EP 现在可以通过跨 TP×CP 组折叠来超过 DP。设想注意力配置为 TP=4、CP=2、DP=8、PP=4（共 256 块 GPU）：传统做法 EP ≤ DP = 8，因此 EP 最大只能取 8；用 Parallel Folding 后，MoE 侧取 ETP=1、EP=64、EDP=1（PP 仍为 4），EP 在 TP×CP×DP 各组之间「折叠」，专家并行度提高 8 倍，而注意力层仍保持最优的 TP=4、CP=2。
  • 2. Reduces minimum GPU requirements: Traditional configurations with CP=8, EP=8 require at least 64 GPUs. With Folding, CP and EP share the same GPU group, requiring only 8 GPUs.2. 降低最低 GPU 需求：CP=8、EP=8 的传统配置至少需要 64 块 GPU；用 Folding 后 CP 与 EP 共用同一组 GPU，只需 8 块。
  • 3. Enables independent optimization: Attention can use high TP for large matrices while MoE uses ETP=1 for full expert width and better GEMM efficiency.3. 支持独立优化：注意力可以用高 TP 处理大矩阵，MoE 则用 ETP=1 保持完整的专家宽度，GEMM 效率更好。
  • 4. Keeps high-bandwidth communication in NVLink domain: Both CP (for attention) and EP (for MoE) all-to-all communication can remain within the NVLink-connected GPU group, avoiding slower cross-node transfers.4. 把高带宽通信留在 NVLink 域内：CP（用于注意力）与 EP（用于 MoE）的 all-to-all 都能留在 NVLink 互联的 GPU 组内，避免走更慢的跨节点传输。

3.3.4.Summary小结

This section addressed the distribution challenge for MoE training. The core problem is the dense-sparse mismatch, rooted in MoE’s sparsity: attention and MoE layers have conflicting optimal parallelism configurations, yet prior frameworks forced them to share one configuration. MoE Parallel Folding solves this by decoupling parallelism mappings, allowing attention to use high TP/CP while MoE uses high EP independently. Together with Distributed Optimizer and FSDP, Megatron-Core orchestrates all parallelism dimensions into a unified framework that scales MoE training to thousands of GPUs.

本节处理 MoE 训练的分布式挑战。核心问题是稠密-稀疏失配，其根源在 MoE 的稀疏性：注意力层与 MoE 层的最优并行配置彼此冲突，而此前的框架强迫它们共用一套配置。MoE Parallel Folding 通过解耦并行映射解决了这个问题，让注意力用高 TP/CP、MoE 独立用高 EP。配合分布式优化器与 FSDP，Megatron-Core 把所有并行维度编排进一个统一框架，把 MoE 训练扩展到数千块 GPU。

However, scalable distribution alone does not guarantee training efficiency. The three fundamental barriers identified in Section 1.2, the Memory, Communication, and Compute Efficiency Walls, must still be addressed. The following section presents Megatron-Core’s solutions to break through these walls.

不过，仅有可扩展的分布并不等于训练高效。第 1.2 节指出的三道根本性障碍——显存墙、通信墙与计算效率墙——仍需逐一攻克。下一节介绍 Megatron-Core 的破墙方案。

4.Scaling MoE: Breaking the Memory, Communication, and Compute Efficiency Walls扩展 MoE：打破显存墙、通信墙与计算效率墙

Section 3 established how to distribute MoE training across thousands of GPUs. This section addresses how to make it efficient. The challenges are significant: Section 1.2 identified three fundamental barriers (the Memory Wall, Communication Wall, and Compute Efficiency Wall) that emerge from MoE’s sparsity-driven parameter-compute mismatch. These walls are not merely inconveniences; without addressing them, training large-scale MoE models is either infeasible (memory) or prohibitively slow (communication, compute).

第 3 节讲清了如何把 MoE 训练铺到数千块 GPU 上，本节讲如何让它跑得高效。挑战不小：第 1.2 节指出了三道根本性障碍——显存墙、通信墙与计算效率墙——它们源自 MoE 稀疏性造成的参数-计算失配。这些墙不只是「有点麻烦」：不解决它们，大规模 MoE 训练要么根本做不了（显存），要么慢到无法承受（通信与计算）。

Why These Three Walls? These barriers emerge from the fundamental resources of GPU-accelerated training: memory stores parameters and activations, interconnects transfer data between devices, and compute units execute operations. Every training system must acquire sufficient memory, move data where it is needed, and perform computations efficiently. Other potential bottlenecks, such as storage I/O for checkpointing or host-side data loading, exist but operate at timescales that allow them to be overlapped with training iterations. The three walls represent the hard constraints on every forward-backward pass.

为什么是这三堵墙？它们对应 GPU 加速训练的三类基础资源：显存存放参数与激活，互联负责在设备间搬运数据，计算单元执行运算。任何训练系统都必须拿到足够的显存、把数据搬到需要的地方、并高效地完成计算。其它瓶颈确实存在，比如 checkpoint 的存储 I/O 或主机侧数据加载，但它们的时间尺度允许与训练迭代重叠。三堵墙则是每次前向-反向往回都必须面对的硬约束。

The Walls Interact. These challenges are not independent; they form a tightly coupled system where fixing one wall can expose or worsen another. Consider a concrete optimization trajectory: A team training a 1000B MoE model first encounters the memory wall: activations alone exceed GPU capacity. They enable activation recomputation (Section 4.1), trading memory for computation by regenerating activations during the backward pass. Memory constraints resolved, profiling reveals that all-to-all communication now dominates; the compute wall was hiding the communication wall. They implement communication-computation overlap (Section 4.2), pipelining all-to-all transfers with expert execution. But fine-grained experts complete faster than communication, limiting overlap effectiveness. They enable reduced-precision training (Section 5) to reduce memory footprint, allowing larger batch sizes that provide more computation to hide communication. This works, but introduces quantization kernels that fragment the execution stream and increase kernel launch overhead. The system becomes host-bound: GPUs idle between kernel launches. They deploy CUDA Graphs (Section 4.3) to reduce launch overhead, but graphs require static tensor shapes, conflicting with dropless routing’s dynamic expert assignments. Each solution ripples through the system, demanding awareness of all three walls simultaneously. Addressing walls in isolation leads to suboptimal solutions; effective optimization requires treating memory, communication, and compute as a unified system.

这些墙彼此牵连。它们不是独立的，而是构成一个紧耦合系统：修好一堵墙，可能让另一堵暴露出来或变得更糟。看一条具体的优化轨迹：一个团队训练 1000B 的 MoE 模型，先撞上显存墙——光激活就超出了 GPU 容量。他们开启激活重计算（第 4.1 节），用计算换显存，在反向时重新生成激活。显存问题解决了，profile 却发现 all-to-all 通信成了主导——原来计算墙一直在遮着通信墙。他们实现通信-计算重叠（第 4.2 节），让 all-to-all 传输与专家执行流水起来。但细粒度专家完成得比通信更快，重叠效果受限。他们又启用低精度训练（第 5 节）压缩显存，从而开大 batch，用更多计算去盖住通信。这招有效，却引入了量化 kernel，把执行流切碎、抬高 kernel 启动开销。系统变成主机受限：GPU 在 kernel 启动之间空转。他们上 CUDA Graphs（第 4.3 节）降低启动开销，可图要求静态张量形状，与 dropless 路由的动态专家分配冲突。每个解法都会在整个系统里激起涟漪，要求同时顾及三堵墙。孤立地处理某一堵墙只会得到次优解；有效优化必须把显存、通信与计算当作一个统一系统。

Megatron-Core addresses these challenges through integrated system design. The remainder of this section presents solutions organized by the wall they primarily address:

Megatron-Core 通过一体化的系统设计来应对这些挑战。本节余下部分按「主要针对哪堵墙」来组织方案：

  • • Section 4.1: Breaking the Memory Wall. How do we fit training within GPU memory constraints? This section covers activation management, recomputation strategies, offloading, and distributed parameter storage.第 4.1 节：打破显存墙。如何把训练塞进 GPU 显存的约束里？覆盖激活管理、重计算策略、offload 与分布式参数存储。
  • • Section 4.2: Breaking the Communication Wall. How do we minimize time lost to inter-device communication? This section covers optimized dispatchers, communication-computation overlap, and pipeline integration.第 4.2 节：打破通信墙。如何把设备间通信损失的时间压到最低？覆盖优化后的 dispatcher、通信-计算重叠与流水集成。
  • • Section 4.3: Breaking the Compute Efficiency Wall. How do we keep GPUs saturated with work? This section covers kernel fusion, CUDA Graphs, and sync-free execution for dropless MoE.第 4.3 节：打破计算效率墙。如何让 GPU 始终吃饱？覆盖算子融合、CUDA Graphs，以及面向 dropless MoE 的无同步执行。

Reduced-precision training in FP8/FP4, which provides benefits across all three walls simultaneously, is covered separately in Section 5. Long-context MoE training, which changes the optimization balance when attention dominates computation, is addressed in Section 6.

FP8/FP4 低精度训练能同时惠及三堵墙，单独放在第 5 节。长上下文 MoE 训练会在注意力主导计算时改变优化平衡，放在第 6 节。

4.1.Breaking the Memory Wall打破显存墙

Memory is the first hard constraint in MoE training: if the combined footprint of parameters, optimizer states, and activations exceeds GPU capacity, training cannot proceed. As model and expert counts grow, memory requirements grow quickly, making memory optimization essential for practical training. Understanding where memory is consumed is essential for effective optimization.

显存是 MoE 训练的第一道硬约束：如果参数、优化器状态与激活的占用之和超出 GPU 容量，训练就无法进行。随着模型与专家数量增长，显存需求上升很快，因此显存优化是实际训练的前提。要让优化真正有效，先得弄清显存花在哪里。

4.1.1.Memory Anatomy: Sources of Memory Consumption显存解剖：消耗来自哪里

MoE models typically consume substantially more memory than equivalent dense models, owing to several distinct sources of overhead. Consider DeepSeek-V3 trained with BF16 precision using a PP​4×VPP​4×EP​64\text{PP}4\times\text{VPP}4\times\text{EP}64 configuration across 256 GPUs. Table 3 presents the per-GPU memory breakdown, revealing a total requirement of 199.5 GB, well beyond the 80 GB capacity of an H100 GPU without optimization.

MoE 模型的显存占用通常明显高于同等规模的稠密模型，开销来自几个不同源头。以 BF16 精度、PP4×VPP4×EP64 配置在 256 块 GPU 上训练 DeepSeek-V3 为例：表 3 给出单卡显存拆解，总需求 199.5 GB——在不做优化的情况下，远超 H100 的 80 GB。

表 3　DeepSeek-V3 以 BF16 训练时（PP4×VPP4×EP64，256 块 GPU）的单卡显存拆解。Memory breakdown per GPU for DeepSeek-V3 with BF16 training ($\text{PP}4\times\text{VPP}4\times\text{EP}64$, 256 GPUs).
ComponentMemory per GPUOptimization Techniques
Weights & Gradients36.4 GBPP, EP, or TP sharding
Main Weights & Optimizer States32.1 GBDistributed optimizer, BF16 moments
Activations131.0 GBLow Precision, Recomputation, Offloading
Total199.5 GB

Three components contribute to this footprint:

这份占用由三部分构成：

Weights and Gradients (36.4 GB). All EE expert parameters must stay in memory even though only KK activate per token. DeepSeek-V3’s 256 experts with top-8 routing illustrate this: 685B parameters but only 37B activated per token, an 18×\times gap.

权重与梯度（36.4 GB）。尽管每个 token 只激活 K 个专家，全部 E 个专家的参数都必须常驻显存。DeepSeek-V3 的 256 个专家、top-8 路由就是例子：685B 参数，每 token 只激活 37B，相差 18 倍。

Optimizer States (32.1 GB). Adam stores momentum and variance per parameter, tripling parameter memory in FP32. Mixed-precision training with BF16 moments reduces this overhead but does not eliminate it.

优化器状态（32.1 GB）。Adam 为每个参数保存动量与方差，在 FP32 下使参数显存变成三倍。用 BF16 保存动量/方差的混合精度训练能减轻这部分开销，但无法消除。

Activations (131.0 GB). The largest memory consumer, exceeding weights and optimizer states combined. MoE activations scale with layer depth, hidden dimension, and top-kk, as well as batch size and sequence length. This makes activations the primary optimization target.

激活（131.0 GB）。这是最大的一块，超过权重与优化器状态之和。MoE 激活随层深、隐藏维、top-k，以及 batch size 与序列长度增长。因此激活是首要的优化目标。

Note Activations dominate memory consumption in large-scale MoE training, often exceeding the combined memory of weights, gradients, and optimizer states. This makes activation memory optimization the highest priority for enabling larger batch sizes or more flexible parallelism configurations.

注：在大规模 MoE 训练中，激活主导显存消耗，常常超过权重、梯度与优化器状态之和。因此，激活显存优化是开大 batch、或采用更灵活并行配置的首要任务。

Additional MoE-specific factors add to memory pressure: dynamic routing can create load imbalance where certain experts temporarily receive too many tokens, and tokens must often be padded to fit efficient computation kernels, consuming memory beyond the actual data. These are activation memory costs that can be reduced through the recomputation techniques discussed below. Load imbalance is further addressed by ECHO (Section 4.3.7), which dynamically clones popular experts to balance token distribution across ranks.

还有一些 MoE 特有的因素在加压：动态路由会造成负载不均，某些专家会临时收到过多 token；而 token 往往要 padding 才能喂给高效的计算 kernel，占用的显存超过真实数据量。这些都是激活显存成本，可以用下文的重计算技术削减。负载不均则由 ECHO（第 4.3.7 节）进一步处理——它动态克隆热门专家，把 token 分布在各 rank 之间摊平。

Model architecture cannot be changed to reduce memory, so optimization must target how data is stored and managed. Four complementary strategies address memory constraints:

不能靠改模型架构来降显存，所以优化必须落在「数据怎么存、怎么管」上。四种互补的策略可以应对显存约束：

  • 1. Reduce storage precision. Lower-precision formats (FP8/FP4 instead of BF16) reduce activation memory with minimal impact on accuracy. Memory-Efficient Permutation eliminates redundant intermediate tensors entirely.1. 降低存储精度。用更低精度的格式（FP8/FP4 替代 BF16）压缩激活显存，对精度影响很小。Memory-Efficient Permutation 则彻底消除冗余的中间张量。
  • 2. Trade computation for storage. Activation recomputation [11, 43, 5] discards intermediate results during the forward pass and regenerates them during backward, exchanging compute cycles for memory capacity.2. 用计算换存储。激活重计算 [11, 43, 5] 在前向时丢弃中间结果，反向时重新生成，用算力换显存。
  • 3. Offload to host memory. When GPU memory is exhausted, activations can be transferred to CPU memory during forward pass and retrieved during backward, trading PCIe bandwidth for GPU memory [78].3. offload 到主机内存。GPU 显存耗尽时，可以在前向把激活搬到 CPU 内存、反向时取回，用 PCIe 带宽换 GPU 显存 [78]。
  • 4. Distribute across devices. Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) [101, 75, 76, 93] partitions parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across data-parallel ranks, enabling training of models that exceed single-device capacity.4. 分散到多设备。完全分片数据并行（FSDP）[101, 75, 76, 93] 把参数、梯度与优化器状态切分到各数据并行 rank 上，从而训练超出单设备容量的模型。

The following subsections present these techniques in two groups. First, activation memory optimizations ordered by overhead: zero-overhead (Memory-Efficient Permutation), precision trade-offs (FP8/FP4 vs. BF16), computational trade-offs (recomputation), and bandwidth trade-offs (offloading). Then, optimizations targeting weights and optimizer states: precision-aware optimizer and distribution strategies (FSDP).

接下来的小节分两组介绍这些技术。第一组是激活显存优化，按开销从低到高排列：零开销（Memory-Efficient Permutation）、精度取舍（FP8/FP4 对 BF16）、计算取舍（重计算）、带宽取舍（offload）。第二组针对权重与优化器状态：精度感知优化器与分布策略（FSDP）。

4.1.2.Memory-Efficient Permutation: Zero-Overhead Activation ReductionMemory-Efficient Permutation：零开销的激活压缩

The most desirable memory optimizations are those with no computational overhead. Memory-Efficient Permutation achieves exactly this by eliminating redundant intermediate tensors through a simple algebraic rearrangement. The technique is zero-overhead because it merely changes when router probabilities are applied, not whether they are applied; the pre-activation buffers required for the backward pass would be stored anyway in conventional implementations.

最理想的显存优化是不带任何计算开销的那种。Memory-Efficient Permutation 正是如此：它通过一次简单的代数重排，消除了冗余的中间张量。之所以说零开销，是因为它只改变了路由概率「何时」施加，而没改变「是否」施加；反向所需的 pre-activation 缓冲，在常规实现里本来就要存。

As described in Section 2.1, the router assigns each token to its top-kk experts with a learned routing weight, and the weighted expert outputs are combined to produce the final result.

如第 2.1 节所述，router 把每个 token 分配给 top-k 个专家并给出学到的路由权重，最终结果是各专家输出的加权组合。

Consider a token 𝐱\mathbf{x} routed to its top-kk experts. Let 𝒯⁡(𝐱)⊂{1,…,E}\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{x})\subset\{1,\dots,E\} denote the selected expert set with routing weights {pi}i∈𝒯⁡(𝐱)\{p_{i}\}_{i\in\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{x})}. Each expert EiE_{i} is a two-layer MLP with weight matrices 𝐖1(i),𝐖2(i)\mathbf{W}_{1}^{(i)},\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)} and nonlinear activation ϕ\phi (e.g., SwiGLU):

考虑一个被路由到 top-k 专家的 token x。令 T(x) ⊂ {1,…,E} 表示被选中的专家集合，对应的路由权重为 {p_i}，i ∈ T(x)。每个专家 E_i 是一个两层 MLP，权重矩阵为 W₁⁽ⁱ⁾、W₂⁽ⁱ⁾，非线性激活为 φ（例如 SwiGLU）：

Ei​(𝐱)=𝐖2(i)​ϕ​(𝐖1(i)​𝐱).E_{i}(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)}\,\phi\!\bigl(\mathbf{W}_{1}^{(i)}\mathbf{x}\bigr).

In the standard formulation, routing weights are applied after expert computation:

标准写法是在专家计算之后才施加路由权重：

𝐲=∑i∈𝒯⁡(𝐱)pi⋅𝐖2(i)​ϕ​(𝐖1(i)​𝐱).\mathbf{y}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{x})}p_{i}\cdot\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)}\,\phi\!\bigl(\mathbf{W}_{1}^{(i)}\mathbf{x}\bigr).

Memory-Efficient Permutation absorbs pip_{i} into the activation, applying it before the second linear layer:

Memory-Efficient Permutation 把 p_i 吸收进激活里，在第二个线性层之前施加：

𝐲=∑i∈𝒯⁡(𝐱)𝐖2(i)​(pi⋅ϕ⁡(𝐖1(i)​𝐱)).\mathbf{y}=\sum_{i\in\mathcal{T}(\mathbf{x})}\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)}\,\bigl(p_{i}\cdot\phi\!\bigl(\mathbf{W}_{1}^{(i)}\mathbf{x}\bigr)\bigr).

When the experts have no bias terms, 𝐖2(i)\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)} is a pure linear map and scalar multiplication commutes: pi⋅𝐖2(i)​𝐡=𝐖2(i)​(pi⋅𝐡)p_{i}\cdot\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)}\mathbf{h}=\mathbf{W}_{2}^{(i)}(p_{i}\cdot\mathbf{h}) for any vector 𝐡\mathbf{h}, so equation 1 and equation 2 are mathematically equivalent.

当专家没有 bias 项时，W₂⁽ⁱ⁾ 是纯线性映射，标量乘法可以交换：对任意向量 h，有 p_i·W₂⁽ⁱ⁾h = W₂⁽ⁱ⁾(p_i·h)，因此式 (1) 与式 (2) 在数学上等价。

This rearrangement reduces peak memory by eliminating saved tensors needed for the router’s backward pass. Let 𝐳i=𝐖1(i)​𝐱\mathbf{z}_{i}=\mathbf{W}_{1}^{(i)}\mathbf{x} denote the pre-activation input. In the standard formulation, computing ∂ℒ/∂pi\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial p_{i} requires retaining each expert output Ei​(𝐱)E_{i}(\mathbf{x}) throughout the backward pass. In the memory-efficient formulation, pip_{i} multiplies ϕ⁡(𝐳i)\phi(\mathbf{z}_{i}) directly, so ∂ℒ/∂pi\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial p_{i} only depends on ϕ⁡(𝐳i)\phi(\mathbf{z}_{i}), which a fused backward kernel recomputes from 𝐳i\mathbf{z}_{i} on the fly. Since 𝐳i\mathbf{z}_{i} must already be saved for the SwiGLU activation’s own backward pass regardless of whether Memory-Efficient Permutation is used, no additional buffers are introduced, yielding a net reduction in peak memory with zero computational overhead. Figure 7 illustrates this transformation.

这次重排削减了峰值显存，因为它消除了 router 反向所需保存的张量。令 z_i = W₁⁽ⁱ⁾x 表示 pre-activation 输入。在标准写法中，计算 ∂L/∂p_i 要求整个反向过程都保留每个专家的输出 E_i(x)。在省显存的写法中，p_i 直接乘在 φ(z_i) 上，于是 ∂L/∂p_i 只依赖 φ(z_i)，而融合的反向 kernel 可以从 z_i 现场重算出来。由于无论是否使用 Memory-Efficient Permutation，z_i 本来就要为 SwiGLU 自身的反向保存，因此不会引入额外缓冲，净效果是峰值显存下降、计算开销为零。图 7 展示了这一变换。

For DeepSeek-V3 (Table 3), Memory-Efficient Permutation saves approximately 26.3 GB of activation memory per GPU, a significant reduction with zero computational cost.

对 DeepSeek-V3（表 3）来说，Memory-Efficient Permutation 每卡省下约 26.3 GB 激活显存，收益可观而计算成本为零。

4.1.3.Reduced-Precision Training: FP8/FP4 for Activation Memory Reduction低精度训练：用 FP8/FP4 压缩激活显存

Storing activations in FP8/FP4 instead of BF16 reduces their memory footprint with minimal impact on model quality.

把激活以 FP8/FP4 而非 BF16 存储，可以在对模型质量影响极小的前提下压缩显存占用。

During the forward pass, the input to each linear layer must be retained to compute weight gradients in the backward pass. In Transformer models, these linear layer inputs make up most of the activation memory: attention projections (Q, K, V, output) and MLP layers (including expert MLPs in MoE) each save their inputs for gradient computation. By storing these input tensors in FP8/FP4 instead of BF16, each tensor’s memory footprint is reduced by 50%/75%.

前向过程中，每个线性层的输入都必须保留，以便反向时计算权重梯度。在 Transformer 里，这些线性层输入构成了激活显存的大部分：注意力投影（Q、K、V、输出）与 MLP 层（包括 MoE 里的专家 MLP）都要为求梯度而保存输入。把这些输入张量改以 FP8/FP4 存储，每个张量的显存占用就降到原来的 50%/25%。

For the DeepSeek-V3 configuration in Table 3, enabling FP8 training reduces approximately 16 GB of activation memory, representing roughly 12% of the 131 GB activation budget. This corresponds to halving approximately 32 GB of linear layer inputs that are eligible for FP8 storage. The remaining activations (attention scores, normalization intermediates, routing tensors) either require higher precision for numerical stability or are not stored across the forward-backward boundary. This reduction is orthogonal to other activation optimizations such as recomputation and offloading, allowing them to be combined for cumulative savings.

对表 3 的 DeepSeek-V3 配置，开启 FP8 训练可省下约 16 GB 激活显存，约占 131 GB 激活预算的 12%。这相当于把约 32 GB 适合用 FP8 存储的线性层输入砍半。其余激活（注意力分数、归一化中间量、路由张量）要么需要更高精度以保数值稳定，要么本就不跨越前向-反向边界保存。这项压缩与重计算、offload 等其它激活优化彼此正交，可以叠加使用、累积收益。

For details on reduced-precision training mechanisms, including recipes, quantization strategies, and MoE-specific optimizations, see Section 5.

关于低精度训练的机制细节——包括配方、量化策略与 MoE 专属优化——见第 5 节。

4.1.4.Recomputation: Trading Compute for Memory重计算：用计算换显存

Activation recomputation (or activation checkpointing) is a well-established technique that discards intermediate activations during forward pass and recomputes them during backward pass [11]. However, trivial full-layer recomputation can add ∼\sim33% computational overhead, and for MoE layers it is even more costly because recomputing expert computation also re-triggers EP all-to-all communication. Megatron-Core introduces fine-grained recomputation that targets only the most memory-intensive yet computationally cheap operations, achieving significant memory savings with minimal overhead [43].

激活重计算（也叫 activation checkpointing）是一项成熟技术：前向时丢弃中间激活，反向时重新算出来 [11]。但粗暴地对整层重计算会带来约 33% 的计算开销；对 MoE 层代价更高，因为重算专家计算还会再次触发 EP 的 all-to-all 通信。Megatron-Core 引入细粒度重计算，只针对「最吃显存、但重算便宜」的算子，以极小开销换取可观的显存节省 [43]。

Two techniques compose to form this strategy (figure 8):

这项策略由两个技术组合而成（图 8）：

Granular recomputation. Rather than applying activation checkpointing to large, monolithic sections, users specify exactly which computations to recompute in the backward pass. For instance, one may recompute only the activation functions within expert MLPs, the LayerNorm modules, or the up-projection within Multi-Latent Attention (MLA). By recomputing individual operations or submodules, significant memory savings are achievable with only a modest increase in computational workload, as only the selected portions require recalculation (less than 5% additional compute overhead).

粒度化重计算。它不对大块的整体做 checkpointing，而是由用户精确指定反向时要重算哪些计算。例如只重算专家 MLP 内的激活函数、LayerNorm 模块，或 Multi-Latent Attention（MLA）里的 up-projection。因为只重算选中的那几块，额外计算量很小——不到 5%——却能省下可观的显存。

Output-discarding recomputation. Conventional activation checkpointing workflows pass the outputs of checkpointed modules to downstream layers, storing these outputs for potential use in backpropagation. However, since these outputs will be recomputed during the backward pass, this storage is redundant. To avoid this, Megatron-Core MoE promptly releases the outputs of checkpointed modules after they are consumed by subsequent layers. During the backward pass, the outputs are restored from recomputed results. This strategy ensures that memory is not unnecessarily reserved for activations that can be cheaply restored, reducing memory footprint without compromising gradient correctness or training dynamics.

丢弃输出的重计算。常规的 activation checkpointing 流程会把被 checkpoint 模块的输出传给下游层，并把这些输出存下来以备反向使用。然而这些输出在反向时本来就要重算，存下来是冗余的。Megatron-Core MoE 的做法是：被 checkpoint 模块的输出一旦被后续层消费完，就立刻释放；反向时再从重算结果里恢复。这样就不会为「可以廉价重建的激活」白白占着显存，既降低了占用，又不影响梯度正确性与训练动态。

Table 4 summarizes the memory reduction achieved by different recomputation targets for the DeepSeek-V3 configuration in Table 3.

表 4 汇总了表 3 的 DeepSeek-V3 配置下，不同重计算目标各自带来的显存节省。
