4.1.5.Fine-grained Activation Offloading细粒度激活 offload

When GPU memory remains insufficient even after precision and recomputation optimizations, offloading activations to CPU memory provides additional capacity. Unlike recomputation which trades compute cycles for memory, offloading trades PCIe bandwidth instead. The challenge is hiding transfer latency behind computation so that offloading appears “free”.

如果做完精度与重计算优化后显存仍然不够，把激活 offload 到 CPU 内存可以额外腾出空间。重计算用算力换显存，offload 换的是 PCIe 带宽。难点在于把传输延迟藏到计算后面，让 offload 看起来「免费」。

Fine-grained MoE models have extreme parameter inflation: DeepSeek-V3 activates only 37B per token (18×\times ratio, Table 3); Kimi-K2 reaches 1T total with 32B active (31×\times). This parameter-compute mismatch (Section 1.2) is especially acute for offloading because activation memory does not decrease with Expert Parallelism (EP) or Pipeline Parallelism (PP); these strategies reduce parameter memory, not activation memory.

细粒度 MoE 模型的参数膨胀极为严重：DeepSeek-V3 每 token 只激活 37B（18 倍，表 3）；Kimi-K2 总参数达 1T，激活 32B（31 倍）。这种参数-计算失配（第 1.2 节）对 offload 尤其棘手，因为激活显存并不会随专家并行（EP）或流水并行（PP）下降——这些策略减的是参数显存，不是激活显存。

Transformer Engine provides layer-level offloading, but this coarse granularity limits effectiveness. Different modules within a layer have significantly different memory-to-compute ratios: LayerNorm activations are small and cheap to recompute, while expert_fc1 inputs are large but computationally expensive. Layer-level offloading cannot distinguish these cases. It either offloads everything (wasting bandwidth) or nothing (wasting memory).

Transformer Engine 提供的是层级 offload，粒度太粗，效果有限。同一层内不同模块的「显存/计算」比差异很大：LayerNorm 的激活很小、重算也便宜，而 expert_fc1 的输入很大、重算又贵。层级 offload 无法区分这些情况，结果要么全部 offload（浪费带宽），要么一个都不 offload（浪费显存）。

The GPU’s Copy Engine and Compute Engine operate independently. When a module’s computation time exceeds its activation transfer time, the D2H copy can run concurrently with subsequent computation at zero cost. Figure 9 illustrates the stream overlap mechanism for both forward and backward passes.

GPU 的 Copy Engine 与 Compute Engine 是独立工作的。当一个模块的计算时间长于其激活的传输时间时，D2H 拷贝就能与后续计算并发执行，成本为零。图 9 展示了前向与反向的流重叠机制。

During forward propagation, input activations are offloaded to CPU immediately after module computation, running in parallel with the next module’s computation via a dedicated D2H stream. One exception: the last layer’s activations are not offloaded because they are needed immediately during backward, so no computation is available to hide the transfer latency.

前向时，模块一算完就把输入激活 offload 到 CPU，通过专用的 D2H 流与下一个模块的计算并行。有一个例外：最后一层的激活不 offload，因为反向时立刻就要用，没有计算可以拿来遮住传输延迟。

During backward propagation, activation reloading follows a Layer-Staggered Reload pattern: the system reloads the activation of the same module (e.g., expert_fc1) from the next layer while computing gradients for the current layer. The reload occurs after backward completes for each module, so only one activation per module type resides in GPU memory at any time, avoiding the need to double activation storage. This is essential when a single module has very large activations where 2×\times memory footprint would cause unexpected memory peaks.

反向时，激活回载遵循「层错位回载」模式：在计算当前层梯度的同时，从下一层回载同类型模块（如 expert_fc1）的激活。回载发生在每个模块的反向完成之后，因此任一时刻每种模块类型只有一份激活驻留显存，不需要把激活存储翻倍。当单个模块的激活非常大、2 倍占用会造成意外显存尖峰时，这一点至关重要。

For PP/VPP scenarios, a ChunkOffloadHandler manages the offloading/reloading logic for each (microbatch, VPP stage) combination, identical to the PP=1 case. The main challenge is managing data dependencies and execution order between virtual pipeline chunks. Handlers are enqueued into a deque with VPP stages in reverse order (FILO) and microbatches in normal order (FIFO). During backward, the popped handler automatically matches the VPP chunk execution order, correctly pairing offloaded activations with their corresponding backward passes.

在 PP/VPP 场景下，由 ChunkOffloadHandler 管理每个 (microbatch, VPP stage) 组合的 offload/回载逻辑，与 PP=1 时一致。主要难点是管理虚拟流水各 chunk 之间的数据依赖与执行顺序。handler 被放进一个双端队列：VPP 阶段按逆序（FILO），microbatch 按正序（FIFO）。反向时弹出的 handler 会自动与 VPP chunk 的执行顺序对齐，从而把 offload 的激活与对应的反向正确配对。

  • • Module-level granularity: Users specify which modules to offload via --offload-modules, enabling mixed strategies. Lightweight modules (LayerNorm, activations) use recomputation while expensive ones (attention, experts) use offloading.模块级粒度：用户通过 --offload-modules 指定要 offload 哪些模块，从而采用混合策略。轻量模块（LayerNorm、激活函数）用重计算，昂贵的模块（注意力、专家）用 offload。
  • • Asynchronous transfers: Dedicated D2H/H2D CUDA streams run transfers in parallel with computation; CUDA events coordinate synchronization only when necessary.异步传输：专用的 D2H/H2D CUDA 流让传输与计算并行；CUDA event 只在必要时做同步协调。
  • • Recomputation integration: Combines with fine-grained recomputation (section 4.1.4). For moe_act, both strategies apply: recompute the activation while offloading its input, releasing the entire fc1→\rightarrowact chain.与重计算结合：可与细粒度重计算（第 4.1.4 节）叠加。对 moe_act 而言两种策略同时生效：重算激活，同时 offload 它的输入，把整条 fc1 → act 链都释放掉。
  • • CUDA Graphs compatibility: Uses external events rather than stream synchronization, allowing offloading modules to be hidden by computations outside the CUDA graph.兼容 CUDA Graphs：用外部 event 而不是流同步，使得 offload 模块可以被 CUDA graph 之外的计算遮住。
  • • Full-scenario compatibility: Supports PP=1/PP>>1/VPP>>1, all precisions (BF16/FP8/MXFP8/NVFP4), 1F1B with all-to-all overlap, and MoE/MLA architectures.全场景兼容：支持 PP=1、PP>1、VPP>1，全部精度（BF16/FP8/MXFP8/NVFP4），带 all-to-all 重叠的 1F1B，以及 MoE/MLA 架构。

Full recomputation stores each layer’s input on GPU while releasing intermediate activations; backward recomputes intermediates from these stored inputs. For an LL-layer model, GPU peak memory is L×layer_input+1×layer_intermediateL\times\text{layer\_input}+1\times\text{layer\_intermediate}. In contrast, offloading moves layer inputs to CPU; during backward, each input is reloaded just before use and released immediately after. This reduces GPU peak memory up to 1×layer_input+1×layer_intermediate1\times\text{layer\_input}+1\times\text{layer\_intermediate}, independent of model depth. For deep models (e.g., 60+ layers), this represents a fundamental memory advantage that full recomputation cannot achieve.

全量重计算把每层的输入留在 GPU 上、释放中间激活；反向时再依据这些输入重算中间结果。对 L 层模型，GPU 峰值显存为 L×layer_input + 1×layer_intermediate。offload 则把层输入搬到 CPU；反向时在用到之前才回载、用完立刻释放。这样 GPU 峰值显存可以降到 1×layer_input + 1×layer_intermediate，与模型深度无关。对深层模型（如 60 层以上）来说，这是全量重计算无法企及的根本性显存优势。

Fine-grained offloading and recomputation work together as complementary strategies (figure 10): lightweight operations like LayerNorm use recomputation, while expensive modules like attention and experts use offloading. Asynchronous transfers overlap with computation to hide PCIe latency. Table 5 shows results across multiple configurations. Fine-grained offloading reduces memory by 10–18% with only 1.6–2% throughput overhead. In the case of training Qwen3-235B, offloading enables reducing Tensor Parallelism degree, which improves throughput by 15.0% with nearly the same memory cost.

细粒度 offload 与重计算是互补的两套策略，配合使用（图 10）：LayerNorm 这类轻量算子用重计算，注意力与专家这类昂贵模块用 offload。异步传输与计算重叠，把 PCIe 延迟藏起来。表 5 给出多组配置下的结果。细粒度 offload 降低 10–18% 的显存，吞吐只损失 1.6–2%。在训练 Qwen3-235B 时，offload 还允许降低张量并行度，从而把吞吐提升 15.0%，显存成本几乎不变。

表 5　细粒度激活 offload 对显存与吞吐的影响。Memory and throughput impact of fine-grained activation offloading.
Model & ConfigBaseline+OffloadMem $\Delta$Throughput $\Delta$
DeepSeek-V3 full169 GB151 GB$-$10.7%$-$1.6%

4.1.6.Weight and Optimizer Optimization: Low-Precision Storage and Offloading权重与优化器优化：低精度存储与 offload

The preceding optimizations target activation memory, which dominates the memory breakdown. However, Table 3 shows that main weights and optimizer states consume 32.1 GB per GPU, representing 16% of the total memory footprint. For models with hundreds of billions of parameters, this component becomes a significant optimization target. Megatron-Core provides two techniques: precision-aware optimization that reduces storage requirements, and CPU offloading that moves inactive state off-GPU.

此前的优化都针对激活显存——它占了显存拆解的大头。但表 3 显示，主权重与优化器状态每卡仍要 32.1 GB，占总占用的 16%。对于数千亿参数的模型，这部分同样值得优化。Megatron-Core 提供两种技术：降低存储需求的精度感知优化，以及把非活跃状态挪出 GPU 的 CPU offload。

The Adam optimizer [40] maintains two state tensors per parameter: first moment (exp_avg) and second moment (exp_avg_sq). Traditional implementations store these in FP32, consuming 8 bytes per parameter, which poses a significant memory bottleneck for large-scale training. The key insight is that optimizer states can tolerate lower storage precision without affecting convergence, provided that the actual update computation remains in higher precision.

Adam 优化器 [40] 为每个参数维护两个状态张量：一阶矩（exp_avg）与二阶矩（exp_avg_sq）。传统实现用 FP32 存这两个量，每参数 8 字节，在大规模训练中成为明显的显存瓶颈。关键洞察是：只要实际更新计算仍用更高精度，优化器状态就可以容忍更低的存储精度而不影响收敛。

The precision-aware optimizer decouples storage precision from computation precision [20]. The first and second moments can be stored in BF16 (2 bytes each) or even FP8 (1 byte each), reducing per-parameter storage from 8 bytes to 4 bytes (BF16) or 2 bytes (FP8). During each optimizer step, these lower-precision states are dynamically cast to FP32 within TransformerEngine’s FusedAdam kernel; the update is computed with full-precision arithmetic to maintain numerical stability.

精度感知优化器把存储精度与计算精度解耦 [20]。一阶、二阶矩可以用 BF16（各 2 字节）甚至 FP8（各 1 字节）存储，每参数存储从 8 字节降到 4 字节（BF16）或 2 字节（FP8）。每次优化器 step 时，这些低精度状态在 TransformerEngine 的 FusedAdam kernel 内被动态转成 FP32，更新以全精度算术完成，以维持数值稳定。

The implementation provides four configurable precision levels: main gradients, main parameters, first moment, and second moment precision. In typical configurations, main parameters and gradients remain in FP32 to ensure high-quality gradient updates, while moment estimates are stored in BF16 [51]. This achieves approximately 50% reduction in optimizer state memory (roughly 10–12 GB savings from the 32.1 GB budget in Table 3) with negligible impact on training dynamics.

该实现提供四个可配置的精度层级：主梯度、主参数、一阶矩、二阶矩。典型配置中，主参数与梯度保持 FP32 以保证梯度更新质量，矩估计则以 BF16 存储 [51]。这样优化器状态显存约降 50%（表 3 的 32.1 GB 预算里省下约 10–12 GB），对训练动态的影响可以忽略。

When combined with the distributed optimizer, which shards optimizer states across data-parallel ranks of size dd, the theoretical memory requirement per rank is further reduced. In DeepSeek-V3 training with BF16 moments, the memory consumption per parameter per DP rank decreases from 6+12/d6+12/d bytes to 6+8/d6+8/d bytes.

再叠加分布式优化器（把优化器状态切分到大小为 d 的数据并行 rank 上），单 rank 的理论显存需求会进一步下降。在 DeepSeek-V3 用 BF16 矩训练时，每个 DP rank 上每参数的内存消耗从 6 + 12/d 字节降到 6 + 8/d 字节。

During forward and backward passes, optimizer states occupy GPU memory but remain inactive; offloading reclaims this memory for other operations. Optimizer state offloading keeps the optimizer step on GPU but transfers optimizer states (exp_avg, exp_avg_sq) and master weights to CPU after optimizer.step() and reloads them before the next step. This approach uses GPU compute while reclaiming memory during forward and backward passes.

前向与反向期间，优化器状态占着 GPU 显存却完全不参与计算；offload 正好把这块内存收回来给别的操作用。优化器状态 offload 把优化器 step 留在 GPU 上执行，但在 optimizer.step() 之后把优化器状态（exp_avg、exp_avg_sq）与 master weights 搬到 CPU，下一次 step 之前再取回。这样既用上了 GPU 算力，又在前向/反向期间腾出了显存。

State offloading is particularly effective on systems with high-bandwidth interconnects. On GB200 with NVLink-C2C, asynchronous transfers overlap with computation, and pinned memory enables maximum bandwidth utilization. For DeepSeek-V3, state offloading saves 15–20 GB of GPU memory (47–62% of the 32.1 GB optimizer and weight budget) with only 0.1–0.2 seconds per iteration overhead.

状态 offload 在高带宽互联的系统上尤其有效。在带 NVLink-C2C 的 GB200 上，异步传输与计算重叠，pin memory 让带宽跑满。对 DeepSeek-V3，状态 offload 省下 15–20 GB 显存（占 32.1 GB 优化器与权重预算的 47–62%），每迭代只多花 0.1–0.2 秒。

These two techniques offer trade-offs that work well together. The precision-aware optimizer incurs no performance overhead since the FP32 cast occurs within the fused Adam kernel; it reduces optimizer state memory by up to 50%. CPU offloading saves more memory (all the optimizer state and master weights) but introduces modest transfer overhead. Importantly, the techniques compose well: using precision-aware storage with BF16 moments reduces the state size that must be offloaded, thereby decreasing transfer time and making offloading more practical even on systems without the highest-bandwidth interconnects.

这两种技术各有取舍，而且搭配起来很合拍。精度感知优化器没有性能开销——FP32 转换发生在融合的 Adam kernel 内部——却能把优化器状态显存降最多 50%。CPU offload 省得更多（全部优化器状态与 master weights），代价是适度的传输开销。重要的是二者能组合：先用 BF16 矩压缩状态，需要 offload 的数据量就变小，传输时间随之下降，即便互联带宽不是顶级，offload 也变得可行。

4.1.7.FSDP for MoE面向 MoE 的 FSDP

Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP) [101, 75] shards model parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across data-parallel ranks so that each GPU holds only a local shard. Expert parameters often dominate memory in MoE models, making FSDP a natural complement to Expert Parallelism. However, the two must compose correctly.

完全分片数据并行（FSDP）[101, 75] 把模型参数、梯度与优化器状态切分到各数据并行 rank 上，每块 GPU 只保留本地分片。在 MoE 模型里，专家参数往往占了显存的大头，因此 FSDP 是专家并行的天然补充。不过两者必须正确地组合。

Megatron-FSDP composes seamlessly with multiple parallel strategies, including Expert Parallelism (EP), Tensor Parallelism (TP), and Context Parallelism (CP). For large-scale MoE models, combining FSDP with EP turns the general advantages of FSDP into concrete benefits for expert-heavy workloads.

Megatron-FSDP 能与多种并行策略无缝组合，包括专家并行（EP）、张量并行（TP）与上下文并行（CP）。对大规模 MoE 模型来说，FSDP 与 EP 结合，把 FSDP 的一般性优势变成了针对「专家密集型」负载的具体收益。

  • • Reduced Memory and Communication: EP assigns each GPU a subset of experts, and FSDP shards those local experts across the expert data-parallel (EDP) group rather than the full DP group. Per-GPU memory and collective volume both scale with EDP size instead of total DP size, so MoE models can support more experts or larger batches under the same hardware budget.显存与通信双降：EP 先把一部分专家分给每块 GPU，FSDP 再把这些本地专家在「专家数据并行」（EDP）组内分片，而不是在整个 DP 组内分片。单卡显存与集合通信量都随 EDP 规模而非总 DP 规模增长，因此在同样的硬件预算下，MoE 模型可以支持更多专家或更大的 batch。
  • • PP-free Flexibility: FSDP+EP avoids several engineering pain points of pipeline parallelism, including uneven PP/VPP stage balancing, placement of output and MTP layers in DeepSeek-style models, and partitioning vision encoders in multimodal settings. Configuration reduces to choosing EP size and FSDP sharding degree, without complex pipeline-stage design.免流水的灵活性：FSDP+EP 绕开了流水并行的几个工程痛点，包括 PP/VPP 各阶段负载不均、DeepSeek 类模型里输出层与 MTP 层的摆放、以及多模态场景下视觉编码器的切分。配置简化为「选 EP 规模 + 选 FSDP 分片度」，不再需要复杂的流水阶段设计。
  • • Broad Model Compatibility: Megatron-FSDP supports two model implementation paths: models built with Megatron-Core’s own modules and PyTorch-native models composed from standard torch.nn modules. Both paths receive the same FSDP+EP sharding, communication optimizations, and checkpointing support. For interoperability with the HuggingFace ecosystem, Megatron-Bridge handles online weight conversion between HuggingFace models and Megatron FSDP, so users can load a pretrained HuggingFace checkpoint, train with FSDP+EP, and export weights back without manual format conversion.广泛的模型兼容性：Megatron-FSDP 支持两条模型实现路径——用 Megatron-Core 自有模块搭建的模型，以及由标准 torch.nn 模块组成的 PyTorch 原生模型。两条路径享受同样的 FSDP+EP 分片、通信优化与 checkpoint 支持。为了与 HuggingFace 生态互通，Megatron-Bridge 负责在 HuggingFace 模型与 Megatron FSDP 之间做在线权重转换：用户可以加载预训练的 HuggingFace checkpoint，用 FSDP+EP 训练，再把权重导回去，无需手工转格式。

The core design challenge is that dense and expert layers need different sharding scopes. Dense modules (attention, normalization) benefit from FSDP sharding over the full DP group. EP partitions expert modules first, so each GPU holds only its assigned experts. FSDP should therefore shard within each expert’s data-parallel (EDP) group, not globally.

核心设计难点在于：稠密层与专家层需要不同的分片范围。稠密模块（注意力、归一化）适合在整个 DP 组上做 FSDP 分片。而 EP 已经先一步把专家模块切开，每块 GPU 只持有分到的专家，因此 FSDP 应该在每个专家的数据并行（EDP）组内部分片，而不是全局分片。

Megatron-FSDP resolves this through a dual DeviceMesh architecture. A primary DeviceMesh governs DP-Shard, DP-Outer, TP, and CP for dense modules. An auxiliary Expert DeviceMesh manages EP modules with FSDP scoped to the EDP dimension. Each transformer layer routes its sub-modules to the appropriate mesh automatically. Attention and normalization use the primary mesh, while MoE expert FFN layers use the Expert DeviceMesh. As a result, AllGather and ReduceScatter for expert parameters stay within small EDP groups instead of spanning all DP ranks.

Megatron-FSDP 通过双 DeviceMesh 架构解决这个问题。一个主 DeviceMesh 为稠密模块管理 DP-Shard、DP-Outer、TP 与 CP；一个辅助的 Expert DeviceMesh 管理 EP 模块，并把 FSDP 的作用域限定在 EDP 维度。每个 Transformer 层会自动把子模块路由到对应的 mesh：注意力与归一化走主 mesh，MoE 专家 FFN 走 Expert DeviceMesh。结果是，专家参数的 AllGather 与 ReduceScatter 只在小规模 EDP 组内进行，不会横跨全部 DP rank。

For large-scale deployments, this design extends to Hybrid Sharded Data Parallelism (HSDP), which adds an outer DP replication dimension. HSDP fully shards parameters within a subset of ranks and replicates across subsets, bounding AllGather to the intra-group size. The dual DeviceMesh keeps separate outer-DP groups for expert and non-expert parameters, exploiting the bandwidth gap between NVLink (intra-node) and the scale-out interconnect (inter-node).

面向大规模部署，这套设计还能扩展到混合分片数据并行（HSDP）：增加一个外层 DP 复制维度，在一部分 rank 内完全分片参数、在多个子集之间复制，从而把 AllGather 限制在组内规模。双 DeviceMesh 为专家参数与非专家参数维护各自独立的外层 DP 组，正好利用 NVLink（节点内）与 scale-out 互联（节点间）之间的带宽差。

The dual DeviceMesh determines which ranks participate in each FSDP collective, but collectives themselves still carry overhead from buffer management and data copying. Megatron-FSDP eliminates this overhead through two optimizations.

双 DeviceMesh 决定了哪些 rank 参与每次 FSDP 集合通信，但集合通信本身仍有缓冲管理与数据拷贝的开销。Megatron-FSDP 用两项优化把它消掉。

1. Non-uniform sharding: Standard FSDP2 shards each parameter independently along its primary dimension, producing uniform per-parameter shards (Figure 11(a)). Megatron-FSDP instead flattens and concatenates all parameters within a module, then applies non-uniform sharding across devices (Figure 11(b)). Shard boundaries then align with communication buffer layouts, and collectives read directly from flattened storage without redundant copying. In Llama3 405B training, this reduces communication overhead by roughly 10%.

1. 非均匀分片：标准 FSDP2 对每个参数沿其主维度独立分片，得到的每个参数分片大小一致（图 11(a)）。Megatron-FSDP 则先把一个模块内的所有参数展平拼接，再跨设备做非均匀分片（图 11(b)）。这样分片边界与通信缓冲的布局对齐，集合通信可以直接从展平后的存储读取，无需冗余拷贝。在 Llama3 405B 训练中，这把通信开销降低了约 10%。

2. Persistent double buffers with NCCL User Buffer Registration: Baseline FSDP frequently allocates and frees communication buffers, and NCCL copies data between user buffers and its internal staging area on every collective. Megatron-FSDP pre-allocates two persistent buffers at training start and cycles between them (Figure 12), eliminating allocation churn. Megatron-FSDP then registers these buffers with NCCL via User Buffer Registration (UBR), so NCCL reads and writes the pre-registered memory directly without intermediate copies. The combined effect is true zero-copy communication. On NVLink systems, the SM footprint of communication kernels drops from 8–32 SMs to 1–4 SMs. On SHARP-enabled InfiniBand, network switches handle reductions and free GPU SMs entirely.

2. 常驻双缓冲 + NCCL 用户缓冲注册：基线 FSDP 会频繁分配与释放通信缓冲，而且 NCCL 每次集合通信都要在用户缓冲与内部暂存区之间拷贝数据。Megatron-FSDP 在训练开始时预分配两块常驻缓冲并交替使用（图 12），消除了分配抖动；随后通过 User Buffer Registration（UBR）把这两块缓冲注册给 NCCL，NCCL 直接读写预注册的内存，不再有中间拷贝。两者合起来就是真正的零拷贝通信。在 NVLink 系统上，通信 kernel 占用的 SM 从 8–32 个降到 1–4 个；在支持 SHARP 的 InfiniBand 上，由网络交换机完成归约，GPU 的 SM 完全释放。

Even with zero-copy collectives, AllGather and ReduceScatter still occupy the network while GPUs wait for parameters or gradient synchronization. Megatron-FSDP pipelines these collectives with computation using dedicated CUDA streams: AllGather for the next FSDP unit is issued while the current unit’s forward or backward pass is still executing, and ReduceScatter for gradients runs concurrently with the backward pass of subsequent layers. Increasing the micro-batch size extends the computation window available for hiding communication, though at the cost of higher memory usage. Users can tune this trade-off through the overlap_param_gather and overlap_grad_reduce flags.

即便有了零拷贝集合通信，AllGather 与 ReduceScatter 仍会占用网络，GPU 要等参数或梯度同步完成。Megatron-FSDP 用专用 CUDA 流把这些集合通信与计算流水起来：当前 FSDP 单元还在做前向或反向时，就提前发起下一个单元的 AllGather；梯度的 ReduceScatter 则与后续层的反向并行。增大 micro-batch 可以拉长用于遮盖通信的计算窗口，代价是显存占用上升。这组取舍可以通过 overlap_param_gather 与 overlap_grad_reduce 两个开关调节。

4.1.8.Summary小结

Table 6 summarizes the memory optimization techniques described in this section and their primary targets.

表 6 汇总了本节介绍的显存优化技术及其主要作用对象。

表 6　显存优化技术汇总。Summary of memory optimization techniques.
TechniqueMemory TargetTrade-off
Reduced-Precision TrainingActivationsNumerical Precision and CPU Overhead
Memory-Efficient PermutationActivations-
Fine-grained RecomputationActivationsCompute Overhead
Fine-grained OffloadingActivationsCPU Overhead and Non-Overlapped Copy
Precision-aware OptimizerOptimizer StatesNumerical Precision
FSDP (with EP)Params + OptimizerCommunication Overhead

These memory optimizations complement each other: Memory-Efficient Permutation eliminates redundant storage with zero overhead; FP8/FP4 activations reduce precision with minimal quality impact; fine-grained recomputation offers favorable compute-memory trade-offs for specific modules; activation offloading provides additional headroom when other techniques are insufficient; low-precision storage and state offloading reduce weight and optimizer memory; and FSDP enables scaling beyond single-device capacity. Together, they reduce memory from a blocking barrier to a manageable constraint.

这些显存优化互相补位：Memory-Efficient Permutation 零开销地消除冗余存储；FP8/FP4 激活以极小的质量代价换取精度压缩；细粒度重计算为特定模块提供划算的「计算换显存」；激活 offload 在其它手段不够时额外腾出余量；低精度存储与状态 offload 削减权重与优化器显存；FSDP 则让模型规模突破单设备容量。合起来，它们把显存从一道「过不去就停」的关卡，变成了一个可管理的约束。

Memory optimization is not a one-time gate that, once passed, can be forgotten. For large-scale MoE models, memory is a persistently scarce resource throughout the entire optimization lifecycle. Beyond enabling training to proceed at all, memory headroom unlocks other optimizations: larger batch sizes provide more computation to hide communication latency (Section 4.2.3), CUDA Graphs require additional static buffers (Section 4.3.6), and EP communication overlap must hold activations from multiple microbatches simultaneously. Many optimizations described in the following sections consume memory, and the techniques above are what make that consumption feasible.

显存优化不是「过了这道门就可以忘掉」的一次性关卡。对大规模 MoE 模型来说，在整个优化生命周期里，显存始终是稀缺资源。除了让训练能跑起来，显存余量还在解锁别的优化：更大的 batch 能提供更多计算去遮盖通信延迟（第 4.2.3 节）、CUDA Graphs 需要额外的静态缓冲（第 4.3.6 节）、EP 通信重叠必须同时持有多个 micro-batch 的激活。后面几节里的许多优化都要吃显存，正是上面这些技术让这种「吃」变得可行。

4.2.Breaking the Communication Wall打破通信墙

Communication overhead directly reduces GPU utilization: every microsecond spent in collective operations represents lost compute capacity. Before optimization, EP all-to-all communication typically consumes 20–60% of training time, depending on model configuration, EP size, and hardware topology. When EP stays within the NVLink domain (e.g., DeepSeek-V3 with EP64 on GB200 NVL72), the overhead is around 20%; when EP crosses node boundaries (e.g., DeepSeek-V3 with EP64 on H100 across nodes), it rises to 40–60%. The techniques in this section target all points on this spectrum.

通信开销直接拉低 GPU 利用率：每在集合通信上多花一微秒，就少了一微秒的算力。未做优化时，EP 的 all-to-all 通常吃掉训练时间的 20–60%，具体取决于模型配置、EP 规模与硬件拓扑。当 EP 留在 NVLink 域内（例如 GB200 NVL72 上用 EP64 跑 DeepSeek-V3），开销约 20%；当 EP 跨节点（例如 H100 上用 EP64 跨节点），会升到 40–60%。本节的技术覆盖这整个区间。

Expert Parallelism (EP) distributes experts across devices to scale MoE models beyond single-device capacity, but this distribution introduces a unique communication pattern. Unlike AllReduce, whose volume is independent of parallelism degree, all-to-all volume is proportional to token count and hidden dimension, and larger EP pushes this communication cross-node where bandwidth is limited. For fine-grained MoE architectures like DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi-K2, three factors compound this challenge:

专家并行（EP）把专家分布到多设备上，让 MoE 模型突破单设备容量，但这种分布引入了独特的通信模式。AllReduce 的通信量与并行度无关，all-to-all 则与 token 数和隐藏维成正比；EP 一大，通信就被推到带宽受限的跨节点路径上。对 DeepSeek-V3、Kimi-K2 这类细粒度 MoE 架构，三个因素叠加放大了这个挑战：

  • • High frequency: More experts mean more dispatch/combine operations per layer (DeepSeek-V3 has 58 MoE layers, each requiring two all-to-all operations).高频：专家越多，每层的 dispatch/combine 次数越多（DeepSeek-V3 有 58 个 MoE 层，每层需要两次 all-to-all）。
  • • Cross-node bottleneck: With large EP sizes spanning multiple nodes, inter-node all-to-all latency dominates due to lower bandwidth.跨节点瓶颈：当 EP 规模很大、跨多个节点时，带宽更低，节点间 all-to-all 的延迟成为主导。
  • • Low arithmetic intensity: Small experts complete computation quickly, leaving less time to overlap with communication.算术强度低：小专家算得很快，留给「与通信重叠」的时间窗口就短。

4.2.1.Communication Anatomy: The Expert Parallel Pattern通信解剖：专家并行的通信模式

Figure 13 illustrates the expert parallelism communication pattern. In standard EP implementations, each MoE layer requires two collective communication operations: dispatch sends tokens to their assigned experts, and combine returns processed tokens to their original ranks. For a model with LL MoE layers, BB tokens per batch, hidden dimension hh, and EP degree EP, each forward pass involves 2​L2L dispatch/combine operations, each transferring O⁡(B​h)O(Bh) data across EP ranks.

图 13 展示了专家并行的通信模式。在标准 EP 实现中，每个 MoE 层需要两次集合通信：dispatch 把 token 送到被分配的专家，combine 把处理完的 token 送回原来的 rank。对拥有 L 个 MoE 层、每 batch B 个 token、隐藏维 h、EP 度为 EP 的模型，每次前向涉及 2L 次 dispatch/combine，每次在 EP 各 rank 间传输 O(Bh) 的数据。

At DeepSeek-V3 scale, this translates to 58 MoE layers ×\times 2 operations/layer = 116 dispatch/combine operations per forward pass. The backward pass doubles this count. At 50 GB/s inter-node bandwidth (e.g., InfiniBand NDR), a single dispatch with 200 MB payload takes several milliseconds, accumulating to hundreds or thousands of milliseconds per iteration.

放到 DeepSeek-V3 的规模上，就是 58 个 MoE 层 × 每层 2 次 = 每次前向 116 次 dispatch/combine，反向还要翻倍。在 50 GB/s 的节点间带宽下（例如 InfiniBand NDR），一次 200 MB 载荷的 dispatch 就要几毫秒，累积到一个迭代就是数百甚至数千毫秒。

Communication volume is determined by the EP configuration and cannot be reduced without changing the parallelism strategy. Optimization must therefore target how communication is executed and scheduled. Two strategies work together to address communication overhead:

通信量由 EP 配置决定，不改并行策略就降不下来。因此优化只能落在「通信怎么执行、怎么调度」上。两种策略配合使用：

  • 1. Maximize bandwidth utilization. Standard NCCL all-to-all implementations do not fully exploit available bandwidth, particularly for fine-grained MoE workloads. Optimized dispatchers (DeepEP, HybridEP) use specialized kernels that fuse operations and exploit hardware primitives to approach peak bandwidth.1. 把带宽利用率拉满。标准 NCCL 的 all-to-all 实现并没有吃满可用带宽，尤其是在细粒度 MoE 负载下。优化后的 dispatcher（DeepEP、HybridEP）用专用 kernel 融合操作、调用硬件原语，逼近峰值带宽。
  • 2. Hide latency behind computation. Even with optimal bandwidth, all-to-all operations take time. By overlapping communication with computation from adjacent microbatches, this latency can be hidden rather than exposed on the critical path.2. 把延迟藏到计算后面。即便带宽最优，all-to-all 仍要花时间。把通信与相邻 micro-batch 的计算重叠，就能让这段延迟藏起来，而不是暴露在关键路径上。

The following subsections present techniques organized by these strategies: bandwidth optimization (DeepEP, HybridEP), and latency hiding (EP communication overlapping, pipeline integration).

下面按这两类策略组织技术：带宽优化（DeepEP、HybridEP）与延迟隐藏（EP 通信重叠、流水集成）。

4.2.2.DeepEP and HybridEP: Maximizing EP BandwidthDeepEP 与 HybridEP：把 EP 带宽吃满

In conventional EP implementations, token exchange relies on all-to-all communication. Even with optimized NCCL collectives, this path has inherent limitations: a permutation stage is needed before dispatch, which replicates each token top-kk times and creates redundant traffic. In some settings, this preprocessing also surfaces as host overhead.

传统 EP 实现靠 all-to-all 交换 token。即便用上优化过的 NCCL 集合通信，这条路径也有固有缺陷：dispatch 之前需要一个 permutation 阶段，它把每个 token 复制 top-k 份，产生冗余流量。在某些配置下，这个预处理还会表现为主机侧开销。

To address these issues, Megatron-Core provides two token-based dispatch backends, HybridEP and DeepEP [100]. Token-based dispatch eliminates the permutation step and avoids sending redundant tokens, reducing overall communication volume and improving effective bandwidth.

为解决这些问题，Megatron-Core 提供两个基于 token 的 dispatch 后端：HybridEP 与 DeepEP [100]。基于 token 的 dispatch 省掉了 permutation 这一步，也不再发送冗余 token，从而降低总通信量、提升有效带宽。

HybridEP was developed by NVIDIA. It follows the same token-based principle as DeepEP, exploits hardware primitives such as TMA and IBGDA, and targets comparable or higher bandwidth with lower SM usage, including Multi-Node NVLink (MNNVL) deployments.

HybridEP 由 NVIDIA 开发。它沿用与 DeepEP 相同的「基于 token」原则，调用 TMA、IBGDA 等硬件原语，目标是在更低的 SM 占用下达到相当或更高的带宽，并覆盖 Multi-Node NVLink（MNNVL）部署。

For dispatch, as illustrated in figure 14, HybridEP reads data from global memory into shared memory based on routing information, then writes tokens to destinations through a FIFO queue. In the inter-node case, instead of sending duplicated payloads directly through the network interface, HybridEP first uses an RDMA warp group to exchange data between GPUs with the same local index across nodes, then forwards within each node. This reduces cross-node traffic and allows inter-node and intra-node transfers to overlap.

dispatch 阶段如图 14 所示：HybridEP 依据路由信息把数据从全局内存读进共享内存，再通过 FIFO 队列把 token 写到目的地。跨节点时，它不直接把重复载荷推过网卡，而是先用一个 RDMA warp group 在各节点间「本地序号相同」的 GPU 之间交换数据，再在节点内转发。这样既减少了跨节点流量，又让节点间与节点内的传输可以重叠。

For combine, standard all-to-all dispatch performs communication only, so a separate unpermutation stage is required afterward. HybridEP instead fuses reduction into the communication kernel. As shown in figure 15, HybridEP reads data through a FIFO queue, performs reduction, and writes results directly to target locations. In inter-node settings, HybridEP first performs reduction across nodes for data that must be communicated cross-node, then completes a second reduction within each node.

combine 阶段，标准 all-to-all 只做通信，之后还得单独跑一个反重排阶段。HybridEP 则把归约融进通信 kernel：如图 15 所示，它通过 FIFO 队列读数据、做归约，直接把结果写到目标位置。跨节点时，HybridEP 先对必须跨节点传输的数据做节点间归约，再在各节点内完成第二次归约。

We evaluate all-to-all dispatch and HybridEP on GB200 and H100 with hidden size 7168, sequence length 4096, and 256 experts under multiple EP sizes. Results are summarized in Table 7. Across all tested settings, HybridEP consistently outperforms all-to-all, with larger gains in inter-node scenarios. The table reports communication latency only; in end-to-end training, the gap is typically larger once permutation and host overhead are included.

我们在 GB200 与 H100 上评测 all-to-all dispatch 与 HybridEP：隐藏维 7168、序列长度 4096、256 个专家，覆盖多个 EP 规模，结果汇总在表 7。在所有测试配置中，HybridEP 都稳定优于 all-to-all，跨节点场景的优势更明显。表中只报告通信延迟；放到端到端训练里，把 permutation 与主机侧开销算进去，差距通常更大。
