4.2.3.EP Communication Overlapping: Hiding EP Communication LatencyEP 通信重叠：把 EP 通信延迟藏起来

Optimized dispatchers improve all-to-all bandwidth utilization, but the fundamental issue remains: all-to-all still lies on the end-to-end critical path. For DeepSeek-V3 with EP64, EP all-to-all communication can still account for 30–40% of iteration time, directly limiting throughput.

优化后的 dispatcher 提升了 all-to-all 的带宽利用率，但根本问题还在：all-to-all 仍位于端到端关键路径上。对 EP64 的 DeepSeek-V3，EP all-to-all 仍可能占迭代时间的 30–40%，直接限制吞吐。

The key observation is that all-to-all latency can be hidden behind computation when enough independent work exists in the overlap window [95, 9]. For fine-grained MoE models such as DeepSeek-V3 and Kimi-K2, this is challenging because cross-node EP communication can consume about half of layer time, while adjacent operators (for example, GEMMs) are often too short to hide it.

关键观察是：只要重叠窗口里有足够的独立工作，all-to-all 的延迟就能被计算遮住 [95, 9]。但对 DeepSeek-V3、Kimi-K2 这类细粒度 MoE 模型，这并不容易——跨节点 EP 通信可能占掉约一半的层时间，而相邻算子（例如 GEMM）往往太短，遮不住它。

To address this imbalance, Megatron-Core uses a dedicated 1F1B all-to-all overlap scheme [55] that merges forward and backward passes from neighboring micro-batches and interleaves compute and all-to-all kernels across CUDA streams [61, 34]. Concretely, backward all-to-all for one micro-batch overlaps with forward attention/MLP for another. Conceptually, this is a DualPipe-like [92] bidirectional schedule built on top of standard 1F1B while preserving Megatron-Core compatibility.

为解决这种失衡，Megatron-Core 采用一套专用的 1F1B all-to-all 重叠方案 [55]：把相邻 micro-batch 的前向与反向合并，并让计算 kernel 与 all-to-all kernel 在不同 CUDA 流上交错执行 [61, 34]。具体来说，一个 micro-batch 的反向 all-to-all 会与另一个 micro-batch 的前向注意力/MLP 重叠。概念上，这是在标准 1F1B 之上搭起来的、类似 DualPipe [92] 的双向调度，同时保持与 Megatron-Core 的兼容。

To enable all-to-all overlap in 1F1B, we merge adjacent micro-batch forward and backward passes and evaluate two patterns:

为了在 1F1B 中实现 all-to-all 重叠，我们把相邻 micro-batch 的前向与反向合并，评估了两种模式：

  • 1. Merged FWD-FWD / BWD-BWD: This strategy merges passes of the same type from two micro-batches (figure 16). In FWD-FWD, forward passes for micro-batches 0 and 1 run in parallel and overlap all-to-all with computation. BWD-BWD applies the same principle to backward passes. This approach has clear trade-offs: • Memory Overhead: 2x peak activation memory. • all-to-all Overlap: Less opportunity to hide all-to-all because forward computation is roughly half of backward computation.1. 合并 FWD-FWD / BWD-BWD：把两个 micro-batch 中同类型的传播合并（图 16）。在 FWD-FWD 中，micro-batch 0 与 1 的前向并行执行，all-to-all 与计算重叠；BWD-BWD 对反向同理。这种做法的取舍很明确：显存开销——激活峰值翻倍；all-to-all 重叠——可藏的空间更小，因为前向计算量大约只有反向的一半。
  • 2. Merged FWD-BWD (DualPipe Equivalent): This is the preferred strategy (figure 17). It merges the forward pass of one micro-batch with the backward pass of another (for example, FWD of micro-batch 1 with BWD of micro-batch 0). Compared with FWD-FWD, it offers: • Memory Overhead: No additional memory overhead (activations from the forward pass are reused for the backward pass). • Compatibility: Matches DualPipe’s design but avoids complex scheduling. • Limitation: The first FWD and last BWD remain on the end-to-end critical path, so their all-to-all cannot be hidden.2. 合并 FWD-BWD（等价于 DualPipe）：这是首选方案（图 17）。它把一个 micro-batch 的前向与另一个 micro-batch 的反向合并（例如 micro-batch 1 的 FWD 配 micro-batch 0 的 BWD）。相比 FWD-FWD，它的好处是：显存开销——没有额外开销（前向的激活正好给反向复用）；兼容性——与 DualPipe 的设计一致，但避开了复杂的调度；局限——第一个 FWD 与最后一个 BWD 仍在端到端关键路径上，它们的 all-to-all 藏不住。

To maximize all-to-all hiding in merged FWD-BWD, we use two key optimizations:

为了在合并 FWD-BWD 中把 all-to-all 藏得更彻底，我们用了两个关键优化：

  • 1. Stream Separation: We split workloads into two CUDA streams: • Compute Stream: Runs forward/backward computations (e.g., attention, expert MLP). • Comm Stream: Runs all-to-all communication (e.g., token dispatch/combine for EP). By alternating tasks across streams, all-to-all runs in parallel with computation—minimizing idle cycles.1. 流分离：把工作负载拆到两条 CUDA 流上——计算流跑前向/反向计算（如注意力、专家 MLP），通信流跑 all-to-all（如 EP 的 token dispatch/combine）。两条流交替推进，all-to-all 与计算并行，空闲周期被压到最少。
  • 2. W/D Split (Weight-Gradient / Data-Gradient Split) [19]: A key dependency blocks overlap: backward dispatch (B/dispatch) requires outputs from backward MLP (B/mlp). To break this dependency, we split backward MLP into: • W/mlp: Weight gradient calculation (independent of B/dispatch). • D/mlp: Data gradient calculation (feeds into B/dispatch). This split reduces compute-stream idle time: W/mlp can overlap with F/mlp to hide B/dispatch when F/mlp alone is too short.2. W/D 拆分（权重梯度 / 数据梯度拆分）[19]：有一个关键依赖挡住了重叠——反向 dispatch（B/dispatch）需要反向 MLP（B/mlp）的输出。为打破这个依赖，把反向 MLP 拆成两块：W/mlp 算权重梯度（与 B/dispatch 无关），D/mlp 算数据梯度（喂给 B/dispatch）。拆分后计算流的空闲时间下降：当仅靠 F/mlp 遮不住 B/dispatch 时，W/mlp 可以与 F/mlp 重叠，一起把它盖住。

Figure 18 summarizes these optimizations. The baseline (top) executes sequentially, where all-to-all blocks computation. The 1F1B FWD-BWD scheme (bottom) interleaves adjacent micro-batches so communication can be hidden behind compute. The W/D split further increases overlap opportunities. Together, these methods reduce EP communication overhead from 30–40% (after DeepEP) to under 5% of iteration time in DeepSeek-V3 training on H100.

图 18 汇总了这些优化。基线（上）串行执行，all-to-all 直接挡住计算。1F1B FWD-BWD 方案（下）让相邻 micro-batch 交错，使通信能藏到计算后面；W/D 拆分进一步增加重叠机会。合起来，在 H100 上训练 DeepSeek-V3 时，EP 通信开销从 30–40%（用了 DeepEP 之后）降到迭代时间的 5% 以下。

To scale overlap to large models, merged FWD-BWD can be combined with Interleaved Pipeline Parallelism (Interleaved PP), which partitions the model into virtual pipeline stages (VPP) and expands overlap opportunities across pipeline ranks. Figure 19 shows an interleaved 1F1B schedule with three phases: warmup, 1F1B, and flush. Adjacent FWD-BWD pairs in the 1F1B phase can apply the EP overlap pattern above. However, adjacent pairs may still have data dependencies when they belong to the same micro-batch. To avoid this, we run one extra micro-batch at the end of warmup before entering 1F1B, ensuring adjacent FWD/BWD pairs are dependency-free and enabling full all-to-all overlap across virtual stages.

要把重叠扩展到更大的模型，合并 FWD-BWD 可以与交错流水并行（Interleaved PP）结合：后者把模型切成虚拟流水阶段（VPP），在各个流水 rank 上扩大重叠机会。图 19 展示了一个分三阶段的交错 1F1B 调度：warmup、1F1B、flush。1F1B 阶段里相邻的 FWD-BWD 对可以套用上面的 EP 重叠模式。但当相邻对属于同一个 micro-batch 时，仍可能存在数据依赖。为避免这一点，我们在 warmup 末尾多跑一个 micro-batch 再进入 1F1B，确保相邻的 FWD/BWD 对彼此无依赖，从而在虚拟阶段之间实现完整的 all-to-all 重叠。

A latency comparison between merged FWD-BWD (1F1B) and DualPipeV (a refined DualPipe variant) shows:

把合并 FWD-BWD（1F1B）与 DualPipeV（DualPipe 的精炼变体）做延迟对比，结果是：

  • • 1F1B is faster with large VPP sizes (more virtual stages enable more overlapping opportunities).VPP 规模大时 1F1B 更快（虚拟阶段越多，重叠机会越多）。
  • • The latency gap shrinks at large PP sizes and micro-batch counts (both strategies reach near-optimal overlap).PP 规模与 micro-batch 数都很大时，延迟差距收窄（两种策略都接近最优重叠）。
  • • For hybrid models (e.g., DeepSeek-V3 with mixed dense/MoE layers), workload balance across PP stages is critical. Megatron-Core’s Flexible Asymmetric VPP supports custom per-stage layer placement to maximize overlap.对混合模型（如 DeepSeek-V3 那样稠密层与 MoE 层混排），各 PP 阶段的负载均衡至关重要。Megatron-Core 的 Flexible Asymmetric VPP 支持自定义每个阶段放哪些层，从而把重叠最大化。

Several factors limit the achievable speedup from all-to-all overlap:

有几个因素会限制 all-to-all 重叠能拿到的加速：

  • • Proportion of overlapped batches: More micro-batches increase the proportion of overlapped batches.可重叠 batch 的占比：micro-batch 越多，能重叠的比例越高。
  • • all-to-all Proportion: EP overlap gains are larger when all-to-all dominates, especially for cross-node EP and fine-grained MoE models with low compute-to-communication ratios.all-to-all 的占比：当 all-to-all 占主导时，重叠收益更大，尤其是跨节点 EP 和算通比很低的细粒度 MoE 模型。
  • • SM Carve-out Overhead: Reserving SMs for all-to-all can reduce GEMM efficiency. In our DeepSeek-V3 benchmark, DeepEP uses 20 SMs per GPU and introduces roughly 20% GEMM-efficiency overhead.SM 划拨开销：为 all-to-all 预留 SM 会拉低 GEMM 效率。在我们的 DeepSeek-V3 基准中，DeepEP 每卡占用 20 个 SM，带来约 20% 的 GEMM 效率损失。

On fine-grained MoE models such as DeepSeek-V3, combining all-to-all overlap with optimized dispatchers (Section 4.2.2) achieves a 93% overlap ratio for expert communication latency, reducing expert communication share from 30–40% of iteration time to under 5%.

在 DeepSeek-V3 这类细粒度 MoE 模型上，把 all-to-all 重叠与优化后的 dispatcher（第 4.2.2 节）结合，专家通信延迟的重叠率达到 93%，专家通信占迭代时间的比例从 30–40% 降到 5% 以下。

4.2.4.Summary小结

The communication wall optimizations work together: DeepEP/HybridEP maximize bandwidth utilization; FWD-BWD overlap hides latency behind computation; Interleaved PP extends overlap opportunities across pipeline stages; Flexible VPP enables optimal load balance. Combined, they reduce all-to-all’s contribution to training time under 10%.

通信墙的几项优化是协同的：DeepEP/HybridEP 把带宽利用率拉满；FWD-BWD 重叠把延迟藏到计算后面；Interleaved PP 把重叠机会扩展到各流水阶段；Flexible VPP 让负载均衡达到最优。合起来，all-to-all 在训练时间里的占比被压到 10% 以下。

With communication latency hidden behind computation, high GPU utilization might be expected. However, profiling reveals the Compute Efficiency Wall, which has two distinct aspects: kernel efficiency (fine-grained experts produce small GEMMs that underutilize GPU resources) and host overhead (numerous small operations create gaps between kernel executions where the GPU awaits work from the host).

通信延迟既然藏到了计算后面，按理说 GPU 利用率应该很高。但 profile 揭示了计算效率墙，它有两个不同侧面：kernel 效率（细粒度专家产生大量小型 GEMM，GPU 资源用不满）与主机侧开销（大量小操作在 kernel 之间留下空隙，GPU 只能等主机派活）。

4.3.Breaking the Compute Efficiency Wall打破计算效率墙

Compute efficiency is the final constraint: even with sufficient memory and hidden communication, GPU resources can remain underutilized if kernels are inefficient or the host cannot dispatch work fast enough. As model and expert counts grow, compute inefficiencies compound, making optimization essential for achieving peak hardware utilization.

计算效率是最后一道约束：即便显存充裕、通信也藏住了，只要 kernel 本身效率低、或者主机端来不及派发任务，GPU 资源仍会闲着。随着模型规模与专家数量增长，计算侧的效率损失会累积放大，因此要跑出峰值硬件利用率，这部分优化必不可少。

4.3.1.Compute Anatomy: Sources of Inefficiency计算解剖：低效从哪来

Compute inefficiency in MoE training stems from two distinct sources:

MoE 训练中的计算低效源自两个不同方向：

Kernel Efficiency. Fine-grained MoE architectures produce workloads that underutilize GPU resources. DeepSeek-V3’s 256 small experts yield GEMMs with M dimensions of ∼\sim128 tokens per expert, far from the thousands needed for peak Tensor Core utilization. Beyond expert computation, MoE introduces complex routing and dispatching operations composed of many small kernels that individually cannot saturate GPU compute capacity.

Kernel 效率。 细粒度 MoE 架构产生的工作负载天然吃不饱 GPU。DeepSeek-V3 的 256 个小专家，每个专家的 GEMM 只有 ∼128 个 token 的 M 维，距离跑满 Tensor Core 所需的数千量级相差甚远。除专家计算之外，MoE 还引入了复杂的路由与派发操作，这些操作由大量小 kernel 拼成，单个 kernel 都无法占满 GPU 的算力。

Host Overhead. Numerous small operations create kernel launch overhead, and the CPU cannot dispatch work fast enough to keep the GPU saturated. Three factors make this worse:

主机端开销。 大量小算子带来 kernel 启动开销，CPU 派发速度跟不上，GPU 就喂不饱。有三个因素让情况更糟：

  • • Fine-grained experts: Many individual GEMMs rather than few large ones, each requiring a separate kernel launch.• 细粒度专家：大量独立的小型 GEMM，而不是少数几个大 GEMM，每一个都要单独启动一次 kernel。
  • • Reduced-precision training: Additional quantization kernels add to the launch overhead.• 低精度训练：额外的量化 kernel 又给启动开销加了一层。
  • • Dropless routing: Dynamic token counts require host-device synchronization to determine tensor shapes, placing the CPU on the critical path.• Dropless 路由：token 数是动态的，必须做主机-设备同步才能确定张量形状——CPU 由此被推到了关键路径上。

The result is host-boundedness: GPU kernels separated by microseconds of host-side latency, visible as gaps in profiling traces where compute resources sit idle.

结果就是「主机受限」（host-bounded）：GPU kernel 之间隔着几微秒的主机侧延迟，在 profile trace 里表现为一段段空档，计算资源就那么闲置着。

Kernel shapes are determined by model architecture and cannot be changed without modifying the model. Optimization must therefore target how computation is organized and scheduled. Five strategies work together to address compute inefficiency:

Kernel 的形状由模型架构决定，不动模型就改不了。所以优化只能落在「计算如何组织、如何调度」上。有五套策略配合使用来对付计算低效：

  • 1. Fuse related operations. Kernel fusion consolidates routing, permutation, and auxiliary loss computations into fewer, larger kernels.1. 融合相关操作。 算子融合把路由、permutation 与辅助损失计算合并成更少、更大的 kernel。
  • 2. Accelerate with low precisions. Reduced-precision training in FP8/FP4 uses faster Tensor Core operations, increasing throughput for the same kernel shapes.2. 用低精度加速。 FP8/FP4 低精度训练走更快的 Tensor Core 指令，在 kernel 形状不变的前提下提高吞吐。
  • 3. Eliminate per-iteration CPU logic. CUDA Graphs capture kernel sequences and replay them with minimal host involvement.3. 消除逐迭代的 CPU 逻辑。 CUDA Graphs 把 kernel 序列录下来，重放时几乎不需要主机参与。
  • 4. Remove host-device synchronization. Sync-free execution enables GPU kernels to proceed without waiting for shape information from the host.4. 去掉主机-设备同步。 无同步执行让 GPU kernel 不必等主机告知形状就能往下跑。
  • 5. Balance expert load. ECHO dynamically clones hot experts to underutilized ranks, reducing load imbalance that causes some ranks to wait while others compute.5. 平衡专家负载。 ECHO 动态地把热点专家克隆到空闲的 rank 上，缓解负载不均导致的「一部分 rank 在算、另一部分在等」。

The following subsections present techniques organized by these strategies: batching and fusion for kernel efficiency (Section 4.3.2), low-precision acceleration (Section 4.3.5), CUDA Graphs for host overhead elimination (Section 4.3.6), sync-free execution for dropless MoE (Section 4.3.7), and load balancing via ECHO (Section 4.3.7).

后续小节按这套策略展开：kernel 效率用批处理与融合（第 4.3.2 节），低精度加速（第 4.3.5 节），用 CUDA Graphs 消除主机开销（第 4.3.6 节），dropless MoE 的无同步执行（第 4.3.7 节），以及 ECHO 负载均衡（第 4.3.7 节）。

4.3.2.Grouped GEMM and Kernel Fusion: Improving Kernel EfficiencyGrouped GEMM 与算子融合：提升 kernel 效率

The most direct approach to improving kernel efficiency is combining small operations into larger ones. Grouped GEMM batches expert computations for better hardware utilization [27], while kernel fusion consolidates routing and permutation operations into fewer kernels [10]. Megatron-Core implements these optimizations at three levels: expert computation (Grouped GEMM), token routing (Permutation Fusion), and router logic (Router and Aux-Loss Fusion).

提升 kernel 效率最直接的办法，是把小操作拼成大操作。Grouped GEMM 把各专家的计算批在一起以提高硬件利用率 [27]，算子融合则把路由与 permutation 操作合并成更少的 kernel [10]。Megatron-Core 在三个层次上落地了这些优化：专家计算（Grouped GEMM）、token 路由（Permutation Fusion）与路由逻辑（Router 与辅助损失融合）。

The computation of experts is essentially a series of independent GEMMs. Grouped GEMM improves performance over separate sequential GEMMs by overlapping the wave tail effect of kernels.

专家的计算本质上是若干互相独立的 GEMM。相比逐个串行执行 GEMM，Grouped GEMM 通过让各 kernel 的 wave tail 效应互相重叠来提升性能。

Megatron-Core provides two Grouped GEMM implementations:

Megatron-Core 提供两种 Grouped GEMM 实现：

  1. i. Multi-stream launch of cuBLASLt GEMMs. By launching individual cuBLASLt GEMMs into multiple CUDA streams, they can overlap with each other. This method supports various precision and scaling modes, including BF16, per-tensor FP8, blockwise FP8, MXFP8, and NVFP4, with performance comparable to highly optimized Grouped GEMM implementations.i. 多流启动 cuBLASLt GEMM。 把一个个 cuBLASLt GEMM 发射到多条 CUDA 流上，它们就能彼此重叠。这种方法支持多种精度与 scaling 模式，包括 BF16、per-tensor FP8、blockwise FP8、MXFP8 与 NVFP4，性能与高度优化的 Grouped GEMM 实现相当。
  2. ii. CUTLASS Grouped GEMM. By fusing individual GEMMs into a single kernel, CUTLASS Grouped GEMM achieves better performance when the number of GEMMs is large. However, different precisions, scaling modes, and hardware platforms require individual development effort, and additional tuning is needed for different problem sizes. The current implementation in TE only supports BF16 on the Hopper platform.ii. CUTLASS Grouped GEMM。 把各个 GEMM 融进单个 kernel，GEMM 数量较多时性能更优。但不同精度、不同 scaling 模式、不同硬件平台都需要单独开发，针对不同问题规模还得额外调优。目前 TE 中的实现仅支持 Hopper 平台上的 BF16。

Two additional implementations are under development:

另有两种实现正在开发中：

  1. iii. cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM via CUBLASLT_BATCH_MODE_GROUPED. The cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM assumes the shape information on device and conducts the computation in one single kernel, which unblocks applying CUDA Graphs to the expert part. It covers all precisions and scaling modes with built-in heuristics, and is intended to supersede (i) and (ii) where supported.iii. 基于 CUBLASLT_BATCH_MODE_GROUPED 的 cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM。 cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM 假定形状信息已在设备端，用单个 kernel 完成计算——这就解开了「专家部分能否用 CUDA Graphs」的限制。它借助内置启发式覆盖全部精度与 scaling 模式，在支持的情况下将取代（i）与（ii）。
  2. iv. cuteDSL Grouped GEMM with fusions. Grouped GEMM fused with activation functions, quantization (for the next layer), and scaling factor swizzling via cuteDSL. These kernels are optimized for MXFP8 and NVFP4 [64] on the Blackwell platform, targeting the fprop GEMM of FC1 and dgrad GEMM of FC2. By consolidating expert computation, activation, and quantization into a single kernel, this approach significantly reduces kernel count and is compatible with CUDA Graphs.iv. 带融合的 cuteDSL Grouped GEMM。 用 cuteDSL 把 Grouped GEMM 与激活函数、量化（供下一层使用）以及 scaling factor swizzle 融在一起。这类 kernel 针对 Blackwell 平台上的 MXFP8 与 NVFP4 [64] 做了优化，目标指向 FC1 的 fprop GEMM 与 FC2 的 dgrad GEMM。把专家计算、激活与量化合并进单个 kernel，能显著减少 kernel 数量，并且与 CUDA Graphs 兼容。

4.3.3.Permutation FusionPermutation 融合

Currently, Grouped GEMM requires tokens assigned to the same expert to be stored contiguously (i.e., permuted tokens). If all-to-all collective communication is enabled, further permutation is necessary to ensure tokens assigned to each rank are grouped together. Implementing efficient permutation using native PyTorch is challenging, as it tends to launch many small kernels and incurs additional CPU overhead.

目前 Grouped GEMM 要求属于同一专家的 token 在内存中连续存放（即已完成 permutation 的 token）。若启用了 all-to-all 集合通信，还得再做一次 permutation，才能保证分给同一 rank 的 token 聚在一起。用原生 PyTorch 实现高效的 permutation 很有难度——它倾向于发射大量小 kernel，并带来额外的 CPU 开销。

The permute fusion pipeline in the training workload (figure 20) consists of three stages:

训练负载中的 permute 融合流水线（图 20）包含三个阶段：

  • • Preprocessing: Permutation is fundamentally a data transfer process that requires tokens to be stored consecutively in the buffer corresponding to each expert. The purpose of the preprocessing step is to generate an offset map (Row ID map in figure 20), which indicates the offset of each token in the input and output buffers. This ensures that permute and unpermute operations can be executed efficiently. The preprocessing kernel is called only once before permute during the forward pass, while other components reuse the results.• 预处理（Preprocessing）：permutation 本质是一个数据搬运过程，需要把 token 连续存放到各专家对应的缓冲中。预处理这一步的目的是生成一张偏移映射（图 20 中的 Row ID map），标明每个 token 在输入缓冲与输出缓冲中的偏移位置。有了它，permute 与 unpermute 才能高效执行。前向过程中，预处理 kernel 只在 permute 之前调用一次，其余组件复用其结果。
  • • Permute: The functionality of the permute kernel is straightforward: it moves tokens from the input buffer to the output buffer according to the offset map, and then passes them to the subsequent expert MLP. In memory-efficient permute, probabilities also need to be permuted, with the results directly entering the activation part of the expert.• Permute：permute kernel 的功能很直接——按偏移映射把 token 从输入缓冲搬到输出缓冲，然后送给后续的专家 MLP。在 memory-efficient permute 中，概率（probabilities）也要一并 permute，结果直接进入专家的激活部分。
  • • Unpermute: The unpermute step is the inverse of the permute operation. Since a token will be copied multiple times and sent to different destinations during permutation, these tokens must be summed together during the combine phase. In memory-efficient permute, the combine step simply adds them up; otherwise, the probabilities are used as weights. All accumulation is performed in FP32 precision.• Unpermute：unpermute 是 permute 的逆操作。由于 permutation 过程中一个 token 会被复制多份、发往不同目的地，combine 阶段必须把这些副本累加起来。在 memory-efficient permute 中，combine 直接相加即可；否则要用概率作权重加权。所有累加均在 FP32 精度下完成。

4.3.4.Router and Aux-Loss FusionRouter 与辅助损失融合

The router and auxiliary loss [25, 104, 35, 74] computations are other areas that generate many small kernels and introduce considerable CPU overhead. As device computing power grows, fusion becomes increasingly important.

Router 与辅助损失 [25, 104, 35, 74] 的计算，是另外两块会产生大量小 kernel、带来可观 CPU 开销的来源。随着设备算力增长，融合变得越来越重要。

The challenge is that the router contains components difficult to fuse, such as GEMM and communication. We decompose the remaining operations into three sections, each fused into a single kernel (figure 21).

难点在于 router 里有些组件很难融合，比如 GEMM 与通信。我们把剩下的操作切成三段，每段融进一个 kernel（图 21）。

  • • Score computation, including top-kk and softmax/sigmoid: This is the most complex function, with various branches for different models. It includes different top-kk algorithms (naive top-kk, group top-kk [18, 19]), score functions (sigmoid, softmax), their combinations, and possible scaling operations.• 分数计算，包括 top-k 与 softmax/sigmoid：这是最复杂的函数，针对不同模型有各种分支。它涵盖不同的 top-k 算法（朴素 top-k、group top-k [18, 19]）、打分函数（sigmoid、softmax）及其组合，还有可能存在的缩放操作。
  • • Score computation for auxiliary loss: This is a subset of the first section. After the score function and naive top-kk computation, the input for auxiliary loss calculation is generated.• 供辅助损失使用的分数计算：这是第一段的子集。在打分函数与朴素 top-k 计算完成之后，辅助损失所需的输入就生成了。
  • • Computation of MoE auxiliary loss: Building on step 2, the auxiliary loss computation is fused into a single kernel.• MoE 辅助损失的计算：在第 2 步的基础上，把辅助损失的计算融进单个 kernel。

After enabling router fusion, the workflow within the router module is shown in figure 21. Future work may incorporate communication into the fusion scope.

启用 router 融合之后，router 模块内部的工作流如图 21 所示。未来的工作可能把通信也纳入融合范围。

4.3.5.Reduced-Precision Training: Low-Precision Acceleration低精度训练：用低位宽换速度

Fine-grained MoE workloads with small expert GEMMs are often memory-bandwidth bound, limiting Tensor Core utilization. Reduced-precision training addresses this issue by reducing data movement and using faster FP8/FP4 Tensor Core operations on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs.

细粒度 MoE 的专家 GEMM 很小，工作负载往往受限于显存带宽，Tensor Core 的利用率上不去。低精度训练正是针对这一点：一方面减少数据搬运，另一方面在 Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU 上使用更快的 FP8/FP4 Tensor Core 指令。

From a computation efficiency perspective, reduced-precision training provides a key benefit: FP8/FP4 GEMMs maximize Tensor Core utilization by performing Linear Layer computation in FP8/FP4. Together with the memory benefits in Sections 4.1.3, FP8 training achieves approximately 10% to 25% end-to-end performance improvement for large-scale MoE training on different hardware platforms, while FP4 gives it even more speedup.

从计算效率角度看，低精度训练带来一个关键好处：用 FP8/FP4 执行线性层计算，FP8/FP4 GEMM 能把 Tensor Core 的利用率拉满。再加上第 4.1.3 节所述的显存收益，在不同硬件平台上，FP8 训练可为大规模 MoE 训练带来约 10% 到 25% 的端到端性能提升，FP4 的加速幅度还要更大。

For complete coverage of reduced-precision training recipes, MoE-specific challenges, and quantization strategies, see Section 5.

关于低精度训练的完整配方、MoE 特有的挑战以及量化策略，见第 5 章。

4.3.6.CUDA Graphs: Eliminating Host OverheadCUDA Graphs：消除主机开销

Kernel fusion reduces the number of kernel launches; CUDA Graphs eliminate the per-iteration cost of those launches. This subsection presents how CUDA Graphs address CPU overhead, the different strategies for drop-and-pad versus dropless MoE, and the memory optimizations required to make CUDA Graphs practical.

算子融合减少了 kernel 启动的次数，CUDA Graphs 则把这些启动的逐迭代成本抹掉。本小节讲 CUDA Graphs 如何对付 CPU 开销、drop-and-pad 与 dropless MoE 分别采用什么策略，以及要让 CUDA Graphs 真正可用需要哪些显存优化。

In MoE training, CPU overhead often becomes the dominant performance bottleneck. This overhead stems from three sources:

在 MoE 训练中，CPU 开销常常成为主要的性能瓶颈。这种开销有三个来源：

  • 1. Python execution: Interpreter overhead, C foreign function interface (CFFI), and garbage collection introduce latency.1. Python 执行：解释器开销、C 外部函数接口（CFFI）以及垃圾回收都会引入延迟。
  • 2. Framework overhead: Even simple operations such as torch.empty add microseconds of host-side cost; library layers (TransformerEngine, cuBLAS, cuDNN) add more.2. 框架开销：即便 torch.empty 这样的简单操作也要花掉几微秒的主机侧时间；再往上叠库层（TransformerEngine、cuBLAS、cuDNN）的开销。
  • 3. Kernel launch overhead: Each kernel launch incurs several microseconds of CPU-side cost.3. Kernel 启动开销：每次 kernel 启动都要付出几微秒的 CPU 侧成本。

Three trends amplify this in modern training:

现代训练中有三个趋势在放大这个问题：

  • • Faster GPUs: As kernel execution speeds increase, less time remains to overlap CPU work, making CPU overhead increasingly visible.• GPU 越来越快：kernel 执行越快，留给 CPU 工作重叠的时间就越少，CPU 开销也就越显眼。
  • • MoE complexity: MoE models add substantial complexity to FFN layers—routers, dispatch, Grouped GEMMs, and combine operations—yielding many small kernels beyond the GEMMs themselves and thus substantial CPU overhead.• MoE 的复杂度：MoE 模型给 FFN 层加上了大量复杂度——router、dispatch、Grouped GEMM 与 combine 操作——在 GEMM 本身之外还产生许多小 kernel，因而带来可观的 CPU 开销。
  • • Reduced-precision training: Extra quantization kernels, especially in fine-grained MoE where operation count scales with the number of experts.• 低精度训练：额外的量化 kernel，在算子数量随专家数增长的细粒度 MoE 中尤其明显。

Figure 22 shows the large CPU overhead and the resulting GPU bubbles in a traditional execution pipeline, revealing large gaps between GPU kernels. This clearly indicates that the CPU cannot launch kernels fast enough to keep the GPU fully utilized, a phenomenon known as CPU overhead or host-boundedness. CUDA Graphs address this by capturing a sequence of GPU kernels into a replayable graph during an initial iteration [12, 2]. Subsequent iterations issue a single Graph Launch call, largely bypassing per-op Python/framework overhead and per-kernel launch overhead, thereby reducing CPU-side latency.

图 22 展示了传统执行流水线中庞大的 CPU 开销与由此产生的 GPU 气泡，GPU kernel 之间留下大片空档。这清楚说明 CPU 发射 kernel 的速度不足以让 GPU 跑满，这种现象称为 CPU 开销或主机受限（host-boundedness）。CUDA Graphs 的应对办法是：在首次迭代时把一串 GPU kernel 捕获成一张可重放的图 [12, 2]。此后每次迭代只发一次 Graph Launch 调用，基本绕开了逐算子的 Python/框架开销与逐 kernel 的启动开销，从而削减 CPU 侧延迟。

However, CUDA Graphs require all captured operations to have static, predetermined shapes. Dynamic shapes or control flow cause graph capture to fail. This creates a fundamental tension with MoE, where token counts per expert vary dynamically. The next paragraph describes Megatron-Core’s two CUDA Graph modes—full CUDA Graphs and layer-wise CUDA Graphs—and how they address this dynamic-shape constraint in MoE.

但 CUDA Graphs 要求被捕获的所有操作形状固定、事先已知。动态形状或控制流会让捕获失败。这与 MoE 存在根本冲突——每个专家收到的 token 数是动态变化的。下一段介绍 Megatron-Core 的两种 CUDA Graph 模式——整图 CUDA Graphs 与逐层 CUDA Graphs——以及它们如何应对 MoE 的动态形状约束。

As shown in figure 23, two types of CUDA Graphs are supported in Megatron-Core: full CUDA Graphs and layer-wise CUDA Graphs. Full CUDA Graphs, also noted as full-iteration CUDA Graphs, capture the entire forward-backward pass into a single CUDA Graph. This is only supported for dense or MoE models using token dropping with padding, which means each expert has a fixed receiving capacity; tokens exceeding capacity are dropped, and inputs are padded to ensure constant tensor shapes. With all shapes static, the whole iteration can be graphed, maximizing CPU overhead reduction. As for dropless MoE models such as DeepSeek-V3, where no routed tokens can be dropped, full CUDA Graphs are not feasible because the number of tokens assigned to each expert varies dynamically based on routing decisions. Expert GEMM shapes change from iteration to iteration, violating the static-shape requirement. Additionally, device-host synchronization is required to retrieve per-expert token counts for dispatching. Section 4.3.7 describes our effort to overcome the dynamic dispatching and synchronization issues so that the full CUDA Graphs can also be applied to dropless MoE. Alternatively, here we introduce a simpler method based on layer-wise CUDA Graphs, called partial CUDA Graphs.

如图 23 所示，Megatron-Core 支持两类 CUDA Graphs：整图 CUDA Graphs 与逐层 CUDA Graphs。整图 CUDA Graphs（也称完整迭代 CUDA Graphs）把整个前向-反向过程捕获进一张 CUDA Graph。它只支持采用「带 padding 的 token dropping」的稠密模型或 MoE 模型——即每个专家有固定的接收容量，超出容量的 token 被丢弃，输入通过 padding 补齐以保证张量形状恒定。形状全部静态，整个迭代就能入图，CPU 开销的削减也最彻底。至于 DeepSeek-V3 这类 dropless MoE 模型，任何被路由的 token 都不能丢，整图 CUDA Graphs 就不可行了——每个专家分到的 token 数随路由决策动态变化，专家 GEMM 的形状每次迭代都不一样，违反了静态形状的约束。此外还需要主机-设备同步来取回各专家的 token 数以便派发。第 4.3.7 节讲述了我们如何攻克动态派发与同步问题，使整图 CUDA Graphs 也能用在 dropless MoE 上。作为替代，这里先介绍一种更简单的、基于逐层 CUDA Graphs 的方法，称为部分 CUDA Graphs（partial CUDA Graphs）。

Layer-wise CUDA Graphs capture each transformer layer separately. As with full CUDA Graphs, capturing an entire transformer layer still runs into dynamic shapes in the MoE part. Partial CUDA Graphs avoid this by capturing only the static components of each layer while leaving dynamic parts outside the graph, yielding large performance gains for dropless MoE even without capturing the full model. In a dropless MoE layer:

逐层 CUDA Graphs 对每个 transformer 层分别捕获。与整图 CUDA Graphs 一样，捕获一整个 transformer 层仍会撞上 MoE 部分的动态形状。部分 CUDA Graphs 换了个思路：只捕获每层中的静态组件，把动态部分留在图外——对 dropless MoE 来说，即便没有捕获整个模型，收益也相当可观。在一个 dropless MoE 层里：

  • • Static components (can be graphed): ∘\circ Attention layers (process a fixed number of tokens) ∘\circ Router computation (fixed input/output shapes) ∘\circ Expert Parallelism (EP) preprocessing (static permutation metadata) ∘\circ Shared experts (if present, process all tokens with fixed shapes) ∘\circ MLP layers in dense transformer blocks• 静态组件（可入图）：注意力层（处理的 token 数固定）；router 计算（输入/输出形状固定）；专家并行（EP）预处理（permutation 元数据是静态的）；共享专家（若存在，处理全部 token，形状固定）；稠密 transformer 块中的 MLP 层。
  • • Dynamic components (cannot be graphed): ∘\circ Token dispatch (from fixed shape to dynamic shape) ∘\circ Expert GEMM operations (dynamic M dimension based on token assignment) ∘\circ Token combine (from dynamic shape to fixed shape)• 动态组件（不可入图）：Token dispatch（从固定形状变为动态形状）；专家 GEMM 操作（M 维依 token 分配而动态变化）；Token combine（从动态形状回到固定形状）。

Partial CUDA Graphs capture the static portions of each layer independently, leaving routed expert computation to execute normally. As shown in figure 24, the forward path of each transformer layer is split into several “scopes”, and the user can choose which scopes to graph. With the "attn+moe_router+moe_preprocess" scopes enabled, one graph captures all static components before the dispatching operation for that layer: attention, router (projection, top-kk selection, and auxiliary loss computation), and EP preprocessing (token metadata calculation and permutation). A shared expert, if present, is also captured in this graph. This approach eliminates CPU overhead while preserving correctness by allowing dynamic expert computation to execute with varying shapes. Despite not capturing the entire model, this achieves significant performance gains.

部分 CUDA Graphs 对每层中的静态部分分别捕获，把被路由的专家计算留在图外正常执行。如图 24 所示，每个 transformer 层的前向路径被切分为若干「作用域」（scope），用户可以选择哪些作用域入图。开启 "attn+moe_router+moe_preprocess" 作用域后，一张图就捕获了该层 dispatch 操作之前的全部静态组件：注意力、router（投影、top-k 选择与辅助损失计算）以及 EP 预处理（token 元数据计算与 permutation）。若存在共享专家，也会一并入图。这样既消除了 CPU 开销，又因为让动态的专家计算以可变形状正常执行而保证了正确性。虽然没有捕获整个模型，收益依然显著。

Megatron-Core has been extensively adapted so that CUDA Graphs work correctly with key features like Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), EP communication overlapping, fine-grained offloading and checkpointing, and flexible PP layouts. Nsight Systems profiling with partial CUDA Graphs enabled shows greatly reduced CPU overhead (figure 25). The remaining CPU overhead is primarily confined to the region between token dispatch and combine operations, which cannot be graphed due to their dynamic nature. See Section 4.3.7 for more details on how to address this remaining bottleneck by making the whole layer graphable.

Megatron-Core 做了大量适配，使 CUDA Graphs 能与多 Token 预测（MTP）、EP 通信重叠、细粒度 offload 与 checkpointing、以及灵活 PP 布局等关键特性正确协同。启用部分 CUDA Graphs 后，用 Nsight Systems 做 profile 可以看到 CPU 开销大幅下降（图 25）。残余的 CPU 开销主要局限在 token dispatch 与 combine 之间那段区域——由于是动态的，它无法入图。如何让整个层都可入图、从而解决这最后一块瓶颈，详见第 4.3.7 节。

CUDA Graphs add memory overhead from three sources:

CUDA Graphs 带来的显存开销有三个来源：

  • 1. Graph structure: Memory for storing the graph topology (typically negligible).1. 图结构：保存图拓扑所需的显存（通常可忽略）。
  • 2. Separate memory pools: Graphed and non-graphed operations need separate PyTorch memory pools and cannot share memory. With partial CUDA Graphs, a single transformer layer needs two pools: one for graphed work and one for non-graphed work.2. 独立显存池：入图与不入图的操作需要各自独立的 PyTorch 显存池，无法共用。启用部分 CUDA Graphs 后，单个 transformer 层就需要两个池：一个给入图的工作，一个给不入图的工作。
  • 3. Static buffers: Each graph needs dedicated input/output static buffers that, once allocated, are taken out of PyTorch’s memory allocator.3. 静态缓冲：每张图都需要专用的输入/输出静态缓冲，一旦分配就从 PyTorch 的显存分配器中拿走了。

If not carefully optimized, partial CUDA Graphs would incur much higher memory overhead from the above three sources. Megatron-Core and Transformer Engine implement several optimizations to minimize this overhead:

如果不做精细优化，部分 CUDA Graphs 会因上述三项而背上高得多的显存开销。Megatron-Core 与 Transformer Engine 实现了若干优化来把这份开销压到最小：

Reducing the number of graphs. With pipeline parallelism (PP), each microbatch requires a dedicated CUDA Graph. The reason is that if microbatches share a graph, microbatch i+1i+1’s forward pass will overwrite the saved context before microbatch ii’s backward pass executes, causing memory corruption (figure 26). This results in L×M×2L\times M\times 2 graphs in total (where LL = layers per GPU, MM = microbatches, ×2\times 2 for forward/backward).

减少图的数量。 使用流水并行（PP）时，每个 micro-batch 都需要一张专属的 CUDA Graph。原因在于：如果多个 micro-batch 共用一张图，micro-batch i+1 的前向会在 micro-batch i 的反向执行之前就覆盖掉已保存的上下文，导致显存被写坏（图 26）。于是图的总数是 L×M×2（L 为每卡层数，M 为 micro-batch 数，×2 对应前向/反向）。

On the contrary, if PP is not used, microbatches can share the same graph, reducing the count to L×2L\times 2. To enable graph sharing, an is_first_microbatch GPU flag is introduced to control microbatch-specific behaviors within the shared graph, e.g., quantization that runs only on the first microbatch. Setting this flag to 0 or 1 before replay causes the captured quantization kernel to be skipped or executed as needed.

反过来，若不用 PP，各 micro-batch 就可以共用同一张图，数量降到 L×2。为了支持图共享，引入了一个 GPU 标志 is_first_microbatch，用于在共享图内控制依赖 micro-batch 的行为——例如只在第一个 micro-batch 上执行的量化。在重放前把该标志置为 0 或 1，就能让已捕获的量化 kernel 按需跳过或执行。

Pool sharing. Although graphed and non-graphed operations require separate memory pools, all graphs can share one pool when captured in execution order. Transformer Engine’s make_graphed_callables() API accepts an _order argument that specifies the inter-microbatch scheduling, allowing sequential capture with correct pool sharing.

池共享。 虽然入图与不入图的操作需要各自独立的显存池，但只要按执行顺序捕获，所有图仍可共用一个池。Transformer Engine 的 make_graphed_callables() 接口接受一个 _order 参数，用于指定 micro-batch 之间的调度顺序，从而在捕获时正确实现池共享。

Buffer reuse. Static input/output buffers can be reused across graphs according to the PP execution order. Once a microbatch finishes its backward pass of a layer, its forward buffers and backward input buffer become available for the next forward and backward graphs to reuse. Only the backward output buffer must be kept until the data is sent to the next PP stage.

缓冲复用。 静态的输入/输出缓冲可以按 PP 执行顺序在多个图之间复用。某个 micro-batch 完成某一层的反向之后，它的前向缓冲与反向输入缓冲就空出来了，可供后续的前向图与反向图复用。只有反向输出缓冲必须一直保留，直到数据被送往下一个 PP 阶段。

With these memory optimizations, we achieve 10% end-to-end speedup with about 7 GB extra memory on DeepSeek-V3 GB200 training.

借助这些显存优化，我们在 DeepSeek-V3 的 GB200 训练上取得了 10% 的端到端加速，额外显存约 7 GB。

Full CUDA Graphs do not support dropless MoE. Partial CUDA Graphs eliminate CPU overhead for static components, but the dynamic expert computation region remains outside the graph. Is there any way we could make CUDA Graphs cover the dynamic part? There are at least two challenges we must solve to achieve this:

整图 CUDA Graphs 不支持 dropless MoE。部分 CUDA Graphs 消除了静态组件的 CPU 开销，但动态的专家计算区域仍在图外。有没有办法把 CUDA Graphs 也覆盖到动态部分？要做到这一点，至少得解决两个难题：

  • 1. Dynamic shapes require host–device synchronization: The host must query per-expert token counts from the GPU to launch token dispatching and Grouped GEMMs.1. 动态形状需要主机-设备同步：主机必须从 GPU 查询每个专家的 token 数，才能发射 token dispatch 与 Grouped GEMM。
  • 2. Memory allocation requires known buffer sizes: Worst-case buffer allocation wastes memory; actual-size allocation requires synchronization.2. 显存分配需要已知的缓冲大小：按最坏情况分配会浪费显存；按实际大小分配又需要一次同步。

The next subsection presents how Megatron-Core achieves full CUDA Graphs coverage for dropless MoE through three complementary techniques: sync-free kernels, ECHO, and Paged Stashing.

下一小节介绍 Megatron-Core 如何通过三项互补的技术——无同步 kernel、ECHO 与 Paged Stashing——让 dropless MoE 也能被整图 CUDA Graphs 完全覆盖。

4.3.7.Full CUDA Graphs Coverage for Dropless MoE via Sync-Free Kernels, ECHO, and Paged Stashing用无同步 kernel、ECHO 与 Paged Stashing 让 dropless MoE 全面用上 CUDA Graphs

While kernel fusion and CUDA Graphs help reduce host overhead, dropless MoE introduces a new challenge: dynamic tensor shapes require host-device synchronization, preventing CUDA Graphs from covering expert computation.

算子融合与 CUDA Graphs 有助于削减主机开销，但 dropless MoE 又带来一个新难题：动态张量形状要求主机-设备同步，导致 CUDA Graphs 无法覆盖专家计算。

In dropless MoE, token counts received by each EP rank vary dynamically based on routing decisions. The router generates this shape information on the GPU, but the host needs it to launch subsequent operations and allocate memory. Obtaining this information requires a device-to-host copy and synchronization, placing the CPU on the critical path and preventing CUDA Graphs capturing of the dynamic portions. To enable sync-free MoE for dropless training with dynamic routing, there are two fundamental challenges:

在 dropless MoE 中，每个 EP rank 收到的 token 数随路由决策动态变化。router 是在 GPU 上生成这些形状信息的，而主机需要它才能发射后续操作、分配显存。获取这份信息需要一次设备到主机的拷贝加同步，把 CPU 推上关键路径，也就挡住了 CUDA Graphs 对动态部分的捕获。要让采用动态路由的 dropless 训练实现无同步 MoE，有两个根本性挑战：

Challenge 1: Kernel launch without knowing the actual problem size. Conventionally, many GPU operators assume that (dynamic) shape information is available on the host. The host-side code determines launch configurations, such as grid size and tile size, as well as the amount of work the kernel must perform based on the shape information obtained at run time. In dropless MoE, this creates a host-device synchronization point: the host must query per-expert token counts from the device before launching Grouped GEMM or communication kernels. To tackle this issue, the GPU kernels handling dynamic shapes need to be redesigned. We developed device-initiated GPU kernels, including device-initiated Grouped GEMM and sync-free dispatch with HybridEP.

挑战一：在不知道实际问题规模的前提下启动 kernel。 按照常规，许多 GPU 算子都假定（动态的）形状信息在主机侧可取。主机侧代码依据运行时拿到的形状信息来决定发射配置（如 grid 大小、tile 大小）以及 kernel 需要处理的工作量。在 dropless MoE 中，这就形成了一个主机-设备同步点：主机必须先向设备查询各专家的 token 数，才能发射 Grouped GEMM 或通信 kernel。要解决这个问题，处理动态形状的 GPU kernel 必须重新设计。我们开发了设备端发起（device-initiated）的 GPU kernel，包括设备端发起的 Grouped GEMM 与基于 HybridEP 的无同步 dispatch。

Challenge 2: Memory allocation without knowing the actual size. Sync-free execution means the size of buffers needs to be pre-determined on the host. To avoid token overflow, buffers often need to be over-sized, e.g., based on the worst-case size to accommodate the case where all tokens are routed to the same expert. This over-provisioning, however, leads to severe memory fragmentation: if the actual token distribution is balanced, the vast majority of the preallocated memory remains unused, yet it cannot be reclaimed by other operations within the graph. The worst-case buffer potentially requires O⁡(EP_size)O(\text{EP\_size}) times more memory than the actual working set.

挑战二：在不知道实际大小的前提下分配显存。 无同步执行意味着缓冲大小必须由主机预先确定。为避免 token 溢出，缓冲往往要开得偏大——例如按最坏情况来准备，以容纳「所有 token 都被路由到同一个专家」这种局面。但这种过度预留会造成严重的显存碎片：如果实际的 token 分布是均衡的，预分配的显存里绝大多数都闲着，而在图内又无法被其他操作回收。最坏情况下的缓冲所需显存，可能是实际工作集的 O(EPsize) 倍。

This memory fragmentation can be mitigated through two complementary strategies: reducing load imbalance so that worst-case provisioning is closer to actual usage, and dynamic memory management within the CUDA Graph to reclaim unused buffer space. ECHO employs the first strategy by dynamically cloning popular experts on underutilized ranks, reducing the variance in per-rank token counts and thus the gap between worst-case and average memory requirements. Paged Stashing adopts the second strategy by enabling fine-grained memory management within CUDA Graph, allowing unused portions of preallocated buffers to be repurposed for other operations. ECHO and Paged Stashing are detailed below.

这种显存碎片可以靠两套互补的策略来缓解：一是降低负载不均，让最坏情况的预留更贴近实际用量；二是在 CUDA Graph 内做动态显存管理，把闲置的缓冲空间回收再用。ECHO 走第一条路——它把热门专家动态克隆到空闲 rank 上，减小各 rank token 数的方差，从而缩小「最坏情况需求」与「平均需求」之间的差距。Paged Stashing 走第二条路——它在 CUDA Graph 内部实现细粒度显存管理，让预分配缓冲中未被使用的部分可以改作他用。下文分别详述。

To eliminate the mandatory host-device synchronization required by conventional host-initiated GPU operators, kernels must be device-initiated. This requires three things:

要消除传统「主机端发起」GPU 算子所必须的主机-设备同步，kernel 必须改为设备端发起。这需要满足三点：

  1. i. The GPU kernel needs to read shape information from GPU memory and use it to guide the computation.i. GPU kernel 需要自行从 GPU 显存中读取形状信息，并用它来指导计算。
  2. ii. The GPU kernel needs to decouple the actual amount of work it performs, which is only known at runtime, from its static launch configuration.ii. GPU kernel 需要把它实际执行的工作量（只有运行时才知道）与它静态的发射配置解耦。
  3. iii. The GPU kernel needs to skip unnecessary computation, such as operations on padded data.iii. GPU kernel 需要能跳过无用的计算，比如对 padding 数据的操作。

To satisfy these requirements, existing kernels must be redesigned. The Grouped GEMM kernel and HybridEP kernel serve as two concrete examples below.

为满足这些要求，已有 kernel 必须重新设计。下面以 Grouped GEMM kernel 与 HybridEP kernel 作为两个具体例子。

Device-Initiated Grouped GEMM. As discussed in Section 4.3.2, TE offers two Grouped GEMM implementations: the multi-stream cuBLASLt GEMMs and the CUTLASS Grouped GEMM. Both are host-initiated. They require a CPU-side list of per-expert token counts to determine each GEMM’s shape and launch configuration, creating a host-device synchronization barrier. To eliminate this, TE introduces device-initiated Grouped GEMM, which reads shape information directly from device memory. Two implementations are provided:

设备端发起的 Grouped GEMM。 如第 4.3.2 节所述，TE 提供两种 Grouped GEMM 实现：多流 cuBLASLt GEMM 与 CUTLASS Grouped GEMM。两者都是主机端发起的——它们需要 CPU 侧提供一份逐专家的 token 数列表，用以确定每个 GEMM 的形状与发射配置，这就形成了一道主机-设备同步屏障。为消除它，TE 引入了设备端发起的 Grouped GEMM，直接从设备显存读取形状信息。提供了两种实现：

  1. i. cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM. Since CUDA 13.1, cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM supports passing matrix shapes as device arrays. This implementation includes built-in heuristics for selecting optimal kernel configurations, now covering various precisions and scaling modes across recent CUDA releases.i. cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM。 自 CUDA 13.1 起，cuBLASLt Grouped GEMM 支持把矩阵形状作为设备数组传入。该实现内置启发式来挑选最优 kernel 配置，在近几个 CUDA 版本中已覆盖多种精度与 scaling 模式。
  2. ii. cuteDSL Grouped GEMM with Fused Activation and Quantization. In the cuteDSL-based implementation, the SwiGLU activation can be fused into the epilogue stage, and for FP8 training, quantization can also be fused. While current support is limited to specific precisions and fusion patterns, ongoing development continues to expand coverage across new configurations.ii. 融合激活与量化的 cuteDSL Grouped GEMM。 在基于 cuteDSL 的实现中，SwiGLU 激活可以融进 epilogue 阶段；对 FP8 训练而言，量化也可以一并融合。目前支持范围限于特定精度与融合模式，但开发仍在推进，覆盖的配置会持续扩大。

Sync-Free Dispatch with HybridEP. HybridEP, introduced in Section 4.2.2, provides an efficient implementation of MoE communication and also plays an important role in sync-free MoE. After each dispatch and permutation, the number of tokens received by a given rank is dynamic, normally requiring synchronization to obtain buffer sizes. By estimating an upper bound and passing it to HybridEP, the dispatcher can pre-allocate output buffers according to this bound, eliminating all synchronizations at the cost of additional GPU memory.

基于 HybridEP 的无同步 dispatch。 第 4.2.2 节介绍的 HybridEP 提供了 MoE 通信的高效实现，在无同步 MoE 中也扮演重要角色。每次 dispatch 与 permutation 之后，某个 rank 收到的 token 数是动态的，通常需要同步才能获知缓冲大小。做法是先估计一个上界并把它传给 HybridEP，dispatcher 就能按这个上界预分配输出缓冲，从而消除全部同步——代价是多占一些 GPU 显存。

Even with device-initiated kernels, worst-case buffer allocation wastes memory. Two complementary strategies address this: ECHO reduces load imbalance so worst-case provisioning approaches actual usage, while Paged Stashing enables fine-grained memory management to reclaim unused buffer space.

即便有了设备端发起的 kernel，按最坏情况分配缓冲依然浪费显存。两套互补策略针对此点：ECHO 降低负载不均，让最坏情况的预留逼近实际用量；Paged Stashing 实现细粒度显存管理，把没用上的缓冲空间回收。

Load imbalance is inherent in MoE: popular experts receive far more tokens than others, creating two problems. First, EP ranks hosting hot experts become compute bottlenecks, causing other ranks to wait at synchronization points. Second, high load variance means worst-case buffer provisioning wastes significant memory compared to actual usage. ECHO addresses both by dynamically cloning hot experts to spare slots on underutilized ranks.

负载不均内生于 MoE：热门专家收到的 token 远多于其他专家，由此产生两个问题。其一，承载热门专家的 EP rank 成为计算瓶颈，其他 rank 在同步点上干等。其二，负载方差大意味着按最坏情况预留缓冲会比实际用量浪费大量显存。ECHO 通过把热门专家动态克隆到空闲 rank 的空槽位上，一举应对这两点。

figure 27 illustrates the ECHO workflow. In the forward pass, the ECHO planner identifies hot experts and generates two outputs: a hot expert map indicating which experts to clone to which spare slots, and an updated routing map redirecting overflow tokens to clones. Expert Dispatch copies hot expert weights to spare slots via HybridEP-based sync-free communication; Token Dispatch routes tokens to both home and cloned experts; expert computation proceeds on all experts. In the backward pass, Expert Gradient Dispatch collects gradients from clones and reduces them to home experts, ensuring consistency. Cloned experts are discarded after computation to save memory.

图 27 展示了 ECHO 的工作流。前向过程中，ECHO 规划器（planner）识别出热门专家，并产出两份结果：一份热门专家映射，指明把哪些专家克隆到哪些空槽；一份更新后的路由映射，把溢出的 token 改投到克隆体上。专家派发（Expert Dispatch）通过基于 HybridEP 的无同步通信把热门专家的权重拷贝到空槽；token 派发（Token Dispatch）把 token 同时送往原专家与克隆专家；专家计算在所有专家上照常进行。反向过程中，专家梯度派发（Expert Gradient Dispatch）收集各克隆体的梯度并归约回原专家，保证一致性。克隆出来的专家在计算结束后即被丢弃，以节省显存。

Cloning experts for training is much more expensive than for inference: each cloned expert requires weight communication during forward and gradient reduction during backward to ensure consistency. Cloning all hot experts to all spare slots would maximize load balance but introduce excessive communication overhead. The goal of the ECHO planner is to minimize the number of expert clones while achieving sufficient load balance. It computes the spillover for each expert (tokens exceeding the average load per EP rank) and the spare capacity on each rank (available capacity below average). Using a bin-packing algorithm, the planner efficiently matches spillover tokens to spare capacity, determining which specific experts to clone and to which ranks, producing the hot expert map and routing map with minimal cloning overhead.

在训练中克隆专家比推理时昂贵得多：每个克隆专家在前向要做权重通信、在反向要做梯度归约，才能保证一致性。把所有热门专家克隆到所有空槽固然能把负载均衡做到极致，却会引入过量的通信开销。ECHO 规划器的目标是在达到足够负载均衡的前提下，把克隆数量压到最少。它计算每个专家的溢出量（超出每个 EP rank 平均负载的那部分 token）与每个 rank 的空余容量（低于平均值的可用容量），再用装箱（bin-packing）算法把溢出 token 高效地匹配到空余容量上，确定具体克隆哪些专家、克隆到哪些 rank——以最小的克隆开销产出热门专家映射与路由映射。

ECHO provides two key benefits: (1) reduced memory fragmentation for CUDA Graphs, since reducing load variance across EP ranks makes worst-case buffer sizing closer to actual usage, enabling smaller static buffers; and (2) improved compute efficiency, since balanced workloads reduce the straggler problem, improving overall GPU utilization.

ECHO 带来两个关键收益：（1）减少 CUDA Graphs 的显存碎片——降低 EP rank 之间的负载方差，使最坏情况的缓冲尺寸更贴近实际用量，静态缓冲因而可以更小；（2）提升计算效率——负载均衡后拖后腿（straggler）问题缓解，整体 GPU 利用率提高。

While ECHO reduces load imbalance to narrow the gap between worst-case and typical memory requirements, Paged Stashing addresses the complementary problem: enabling fine-grained memory management within CUDA Graph to reduce internal memory fragmentation.

ECHO 通过降低负载不均，把「最坏情况」与「典型情况」的显存需求差距收窄；Paged Stashing 处理的则是另一半问题：在 CUDA Graph 内部实现细粒度显存管理，以减少内部显存碎片。

The fragmentation problem arises because sizes of buffers involved in CUDA Graphs need to be pre-determined. To avoid undesired overflow, the buffers usually need to be over-sized. In a straightforward approach, buffers in all layers are allocated according to the worst-case size (figure 28, middle). For dropless MoE, this means each layer reserves a buffer based on maximum possible tokens each rank may receive, resulting in O⁡(layers×worst_case)O(\text{layers}\times\text{worst\_case}) memory overhead even when actual token counts are much lower.

碎片问题的根源在于 CUDA Graphs 涉及的缓冲大小必须预先确定。为避免意外溢出，缓冲通常得开得偏大。最直白的做法是让所有层都按最坏情况分配缓冲（图 28 中）。对 dropless MoE 来说，这意味着每一层都要按「该 rank 可能收到的最大 token 数」预留缓冲，即便实际 token 数远低于此，显存开销仍然是 O(layers×worstcase)。

Paged Stashing is based on a key observation: there is a vast gap (often more than an order of magnitude) between the actual memory needed to store activations for backward computation and the worst-case memory allocated to avoid overflow at each layer. Paged Stashing addresses this by decoupling these two memory buffers. This is illustrated in figure 28 (right). Instead of allocating worst-case-sized buffers for every layer, the paged-stashing manager maintains: (1) a single tmp buffer sized for the worst-case token counts, which is shared across all layers for computation, and (2) a stashing buffer organized in the form of pages that stores only the actual tokens used by each layer. When a layer completes its forward computation, its activations are copied from the tmp buffer to the stashing buffer, storing only the actual token count rather than the worst-case allocation. The tmp buffer can then be readily reused for the computation in following layers. This significantly reduces memory consumption from O⁡(layers×worst_case)O(\text{layers}\times\text{worst\_case}) to O⁡(worst_case+actual_total)O(\text{worst\_case}+\text{actual\_total}).

Paged Stashing 基于一个关键观察：为反向计算保存激活所需的实际显存，与每层为避免溢出而按最坏情况分配的显存之间，存在巨大落差（往往超过一个数量级）。Paged Stashing 的做法是把这两块缓冲解耦，如图 28（右）所示。它不再为每一层分配最坏情况的缓冲，而是由 paged-stashing 管理器维护两样东西：（1）一块按最坏情况 token 数开辟的 tmp 缓冲，被所有层共用，用于计算；（2）一块以页（page）为单位组织的 stashing 缓冲，只存每层实际用到的 token。某一层完成前向计算后，其激活从 tmp 缓冲拷入 stashing 缓冲，只按实际 token 数存储，而不是按最坏情况的分配量。随后 tmp 缓冲就可以直接给后面的层继续计算用。显存占用于是从 O(layers×worstcase) 降到 O(worstcase+actualtotal)，降幅显著。

The stashing buffer uses the classic idea of paging to manage memory in a flexible yet efficient way. The PagedStashBuffer is organized as pages of fixed size (default 64 tokens per page). The page stashing manager tracks available pages through a free list implemented by a circular buffer. Paging operations are implemented as device-initiated stash kernels. The stash kernel copies activations to free pages allocated from the head of the free list and records the target pages. The reload kernel retrieves activations from the recorded pages and returns the unused pages to the tail of the free list.

stashing 缓冲借助经典的分页思想，以灵活而高效的方式管理显存。PagedStashBuffer 按固定大小的页组织（默认每页 64 个 token）。页管理器通过一个由环形缓冲实现的空闲链表（free list）来跟踪可用页。分页操作由设备端发起的 stash kernel 完成：stash kernel 把激活拷贝到从空闲链表头部取出的空闲页上，并记下目标页号；reload kernel 则从记录下来的页中取回激活，并把用完的页归还到空闲链表尾部。

To minimize overhead, Paged Stashing overlaps memory transfers with computation using dedicated CUDA streams (figure 29). The system pre-fetches activations for the next backward layer while current computation executes, hiding reload latency. This overlap requires slight memory overhead due to double buffering.

为把开销压到最低，Paged Stashing 用专用的 CUDA 流把显存搬运与计算重叠起来（图 29）。系统在计算进行的同时预取下一反向层所需的激活，从而把 reload 延迟藏住。这种重叠因为要双缓冲，会带来少许显存开销。

Together, these three techniques enable full CUDA Graphs coverage for dropless MoE, eliminating CPU overhead while preserving the flexibility of dynamic routing:

三项技术合起来，使 dropless MoE 得以被整图 CUDA Graphs 完全覆盖——既消除了 CPU 开销，又保住了动态路由的灵活性：

  • • Device-initiated kernels remove host-device synchronization entirely by reading dynamic shapes directly from GPU memory, making all MoE operations capturable by CUDA Graphs.• 设备端发起的 kernel 直接从 GPU 显存读取动态形状，彻底去掉了主机-设备同步，使全部 MoE 操作都能被 CUDA Graphs 捕获。
  • • ECHO balances expert workloads across EP ranks, narrowing the gap between worst-case and actual buffer requirements. This enables smaller static allocations and mitigates the straggler problem that otherwise limits GPU utilization.• ECHO 在 EP rank 之间平衡专家负载，缩小最坏情况与实际情况的缓冲需求差距。这让静态分配可以更小，也缓解了原本会拉低 GPU 利用率的拖后腿问题。
  • • Paged Stashing reduces memory from O⁡(layers×worst_case)O(\text{layers}\times\text{worst\_case}) to O⁡(worst_case+actual_total)O(\text{worst\_case}+\text{actual\_total}) by sharing a single worst-case tmp buffer across layers and storing only actual activations in a paged stashing buffer.• Paged Stashing 用一块跨层共享的最坏情况 tmp 缓冲、加上只存实际激活的分页 stashing 缓冲，把显存从 O(layers×worstcase) 降到 O(worstcase+actualtotal)。

Overhead. These benefits come with measured trade-offs. ECHO introduces extra communication for cloning hot experts in the forward pass and reducing their gradients in the backward pass; in practice, only a small fraction of experts are cloned (determined by the spillover above average load), so the additional communication remains modest relative to the standard all-to-all dispatch. Paged Stashing adds memory copy operations (stash in the forward pass, reload in the backward pass) and a persistent worst-case-sized tmp buffer with double-buffering overhead; these copies run on dedicated CUDA streams overlapped with layer computation, so the latency is largely hidden and the primary cost is additional memory bandwidth. Both overheads are relatively small compared to the gains from eliminating per-iteration host-device synchronization and enabling static memory planning with CUDA Graphs.

代价。 这些收益都是有实测取舍的。ECHO 在前向多出克隆热门专家的通信，在反向多出其梯度归约；实践中只有一小部分专家会被克隆（由超出平均负载的溢出量决定），因此额外通信相对于标准的 all-to-all dispatch 仍然有限。Paged Stashing 增加了显存拷贝操作（前向 stash、反向 reload），还要常驻一块最坏情况大小的 tmp 缓冲并承担双缓冲开销；这些拷贝跑在专用 CUDA 流上、与层计算重叠，延迟基本被藏住，主要成本是额外的显存带宽。与「消除逐迭代的主机-设备同步、并用 CUDA Graphs 做静态显存规划」带来的收益相比，这两项开销都相对较小。

4.3.8.Summary小结

The compute efficiency optimizations address both sources of inefficiency. For kernel efficiency: Grouped GEMM batches expert computations, kernel fusion consolidates routing and permutation operations, and reduced-precision training accelerates Tensor Core throughput. For host overhead: CUDA Graphs eliminate per-iteration CPU logic, and Sync-Free MoE removes host-device synchronization barriers. ECHO addresses load imbalance that compounds both issues. Together, these optimizations transform compute inefficiency from a dominant bottleneck into a manageable constraint.

计算效率优化同时针对低效的两个来源。kernel 效率方面：Grouped GEMM 把专家计算批量化，算子融合把路由与 permutation 操作合并，低精度训练提升 Tensor Core 吞吐。主机开销方面：CUDA Graphs 消除逐迭代的 CPU 逻辑，Sync-Free MoE 拆掉主机-设备同步屏障。ECHO 则处理会同时加剧这两类问题的负载不均。这些优化合在一起，把计算低效从主导瓶颈变成了可控的约束。

4.4.Summary: Breaking the Three Walls小结：打破三堵墙

This section addressed the three fundamental barriers to efficient MoE training, each a hard constraint that, unaddressed, prevents practical training at scale.

本章处理了高效 MoE 训练的三大根本障碍，每一个都是硬约束——不解决就没法在规模上真正训起来。

  • • Memory Wall: Memory is the first constraint. If parameters, optimizer states, and activations exceed the GPU capacity, training cannot proceed. Memory-Efficient Permutation, FP8/FP4 activations, fine-grained recomputation, offloading, precision-aware optimizers, and FSDP together transform the 199.5 GB per-GPU requirement of DeepSeek-V3 into a feasible training configuration.• 显存墙：显存是第一道约束。一旦参数、优化器状态与激活超出 GPU 容量，训练根本跑不动。Memory-Efficient Permutation、FP8/FP4 激活、细粒度重计算、offload、精度感知优化器与 FSDP 合在一起，把 DeepSeek-V3 每卡 199.5 GB 的需求变成了可落地的训练配置。
  • • Communication Wall: Communication overhead directly reduces GPU utilization. Optimized dispatchers (DeepEP, HybridEP) maximize bandwidth and FWD-BWD overlap hides latency behind computation. Together, these reduce all-to-all overhead from up to 60% of the training time to less than 10% in DeepSeek-V3 training.• 通信墙：通信开销直接侵蚀 GPU 利用率。优化后的 dispatcher（DeepEP、HybridEP）把带宽拉满，FWD-BWD 重叠把延迟藏到计算后面。两者合力，使 DeepSeek-V3 训练中 all-to-all 的开销从最高占训练时长的 60% 降到 10% 以下。
  • • Compute Efficiency Wall: Compute inefficiency stems from two sources: small kernels that underutilize GPU resources, and host overhead that leaves GPUs idle. Grouped GEMM and kernel fusion improve kernel efficiency; CUDA Graphs and Sync-Free MoE eliminate host overhead. These transform computation inefficiency from the dominant bottleneck into a manageable constraint.• 计算效率墙：计算低效有两个来源——吃不饱 GPU 的小 kernel，以及让 GPU 空转的主机开销。Grouped GEMM 与算子融合提升 kernel 效率；CUDA Graphs 与 Sync-Free MoE 消除主机开销。这些把计算低效从主导瓶颈变成了可控的约束。

These optimizations are not independent. They form a coherent system where solutions to one wall enable or enhance solutions to others. Reduced-precision training shows this clearly: it reduces memory (activations) and improves compute efficiency (faster Tensor Core operations), while requiring careful integration to avoid introducing new bottlenecks (quantization kernel overhead).

这些优化并不是彼此独立的。它们构成一个自洽的体系：某一堵墙的解法，往往会促成或强化另一堵墙的解法。低精度训练把这一点体现得最清楚——它减少了显存（激活）占用，也提升了计算效率（更快的 Tensor Core 指令），但同时需要小心集成，以免引入新的瓶颈（量化 kernel 的开销）。

The following sections address two cross-cutting concerns: Section 5 covers reduced-precision training in FP8/FP4, which simultaneously impacts all three walls, and Section 6 addresses long-context MoE training, which changes the optimization balance when attention dominates computation.

后续各章处理两个横切（cross-cutting）议题：第 5 章讲 FP8/FP4 低精度训练，它同时作用于三堵墙；第 6 章讲长上下文 MoE 训练，当注意力主导计算时，优化的平衡点会发生变化。

5.Reduced-Precision Training in FP8/FP4 for MoEMoE 的 FP8/FP4 低精度训练

The preceding sections addressed each of the three walls with targeted optimizations. Reduced-precision training is unique: it simultaneously impacts memory, communication, and computation efficiency, making it a cross-cutting optimization that deserves dedicated treatment.

前面各节用针对性的优化逐一应对了三堵墙。低精度训练则很特殊：它同时作用于显存、通信与计算效率，是一项值得单独成章的横切优化。

Mixed-precision training has been a cornerstone of efficient deep learning, with BF16 as standard practice [57, 70, 97]. Reduced-precision training in FP8/FP4 represents a more aggressive step, reducing the precision from 16 bits to 8 or even 4, with correspondingly larger benefits and risks [58, 26]. For DeepSeek-V3, FP8 training reduces activation memory by approximately 16 GB per GPU, improves expert GEMMs through faster Tensor Core operations, and accelerates the parameter AllGather communication. These gains compound across the three walls, making FP8 essential for efficient large-scale MoE training.

混合精度训练一直是高效深度学习的基石，BF16 已成标准做法 [57, 70, 97]。FP8/FP4 低精度训练是更激进的一步——把精度从 16 位压到 8 位乃至 4 位，收益与风险也相应放大 [58, 26]。对 DeepSeek-V3 而言，FP8 训练使每卡激活显存减少约 16 GB，通过更快的 Tensor Core 指令提升专家 GEMM，并加速参数 AllGather 通信。这些收益在三堵墙上叠加，使 FP8 成为高效大规模 MoE 训练的必要条件。

However, low-precision training introduces convergence risks that must be systematically addressed. This section presents Megatron-Core’s approach to reduced-precision training: understanding where precision matters, selecting appropriate quantization recipes, and implementing MoE-specific optimizations that capture benefits of reduced-precision training while maintaining training stability.

然而低精度训练会带来收敛风险，必须系统性地处理。本章介绍 Megatron-Core 的低精度训练方案：弄清精度在哪些地方才真正重要，挑选合适的量化配方，并实现 MoE 特有的优化——既拿到低精度训练的收益，又保持训练稳定。

5.1.Why Reduced-Precision Training Matters for MoE为什么 MoE 尤其需要低精度训练

MoE architectures amplify both the benefits and risks of low-precision training compared to dense models:

与稠密模型相比，MoE 架构会把低精度训练的收益与风险同时放大：

Amplified Benefits. With hundreds of experts, activation memory scales proportionally. FP8/FP4 activations provide larger absolute memory savings than in dense models. The communication volume for parameter AllGather is halved33 3 For the NVFP4 recipe on Blackwell, since we need to gather both the row-wise and column-wise weight tensors, the saved communication volume is also 50%., and expert GEMMs (which dominate MoE computation) benefit from faster Tensor Core throughput.

收益被放大。 拥有数百个专家时，激活显存按比例增长，因此 FP8/FP4 激活带来的显存节省绝对值比稠密模型更大。参数 AllGather 的通信量减半³（³ 在 Blackwell 上采用 NVFP4 配方时，由于需要同时收集行向与列向的权重张量，节省的通信量同样是 50%。），而主导 MoE 计算的专家 GEMM 则受益于更快的 Tensor Core 吞吐。

Amplified Risks. Router decisions depend on precise scores to assign tokens to experts. Quantization noise could destabilize expert selection, leading to training instability, degraded model quality, or expert collapse [60]. The numerically sensitive components must be protected from aggressive quantization.

风险也被放大。 Router 的决策依赖精确的分数来把 token 分配给专家。量化噪声可能动摇专家选择的稳定性，导致训练不稳、模型质量下降，甚至出现专家坍缩（expert collapse）[60]。数值敏感的部分必须保护起来，不能承受激进的量化。

The Strategy: Selective Precision. The solution is precision where it matters, efficiency everywhere else. Three principles guide the deployment of reduced-precision training in MoE:

策略：选择性精度。 解法是「该精确的地方精确，其余地方求快」。在 MoE 中部署低精度训练有三条原则：

  • 1. Protect routing decisions. The router remains in FP32 to ensure stable expert selection.1. 保护路由决策。 router 保持 FP32，以保证专家选择的稳定。
  • 2. Preserve precision for key components. Embeddings, output layers, main gradients, master weights, and optimizer states remain in their original precision to maintain model quality.2. 关键组件保留精度。 embedding、输出层、主梯度、主权重（master weights）与优化器状态保持原有精度，以维持模型质量。
  • 3. Quantize bulk computation. Expert GEMMs, which constitute the majority of computation, use reduced-precision training with carefully designed quantization schemes (called recipe).3. 对大宗计算做量化。 构成绝大部分计算量的专家 GEMM 采用低精度训练，并配以精心设计的量化方案（称为 recipe）。

Note The key to successful reduced-precision MoE training is selective precision: keep numerically sensitive components (router, embeddings, output layers, gradients, and optimizer states) in higher precision while aggressively quantizing the bulk of computation (expert GEMMs). This strategy captures most benefits of the reduced-precision training while avoiding convergence issues.

要点 低精度 MoE 训练成功的关键在于选择性精度：把数值敏感的组件（router、embedding、输出层、梯度与优化器状态）留在更高精度，同时对计算的大头（专家 GEMM）施以激进量化。这一策略拿到了低精度训练的绝大部分收益，又避开了收敛问题。

5.2.The Impact from Reduced-Precision Training on All Three Walls低精度训练对三堵墙的影响

Reduced-precision training provides benefits across all three performance walls, making it a unifying optimization. Table 8 summarizes these impacts.

低精度训练在三堵墙上同时带来收益，因而是一项「统一」的优化。表 8 汇总了这些影响。

表 8　低精度训练对三堵墙影响的汇总。Summary of the impact from reduced-precision training on the Three Walls.
WallReduced-Precision Training BenefitDetails
Memory50% (FP8)/75% (FP4) activation reductionSection 4.1.3
Eliminate BF16 weight copiesSection 5.3.5
BF16 optimizer statesSection 4.1.6

ComputeFaster Tensor Core GEMMsSection 4.3.5
