5.2.1.Breaking the Memory Wall with Reduced-Precision Training用低精度训练打破显存墙

Reduced-precision training reduces memory consumption in three ways:

低精度训练通过三条途径降低显存占用：

Activation Memory (detailed in Section 4.1.3). The primary source of activation memory savings comes from input tensors of linear layers saved for backward computation. By storing these tensors in FP8/FP4 instead of BF16, the memory footprint is reduced by 50%/75%. For example, FP8 saves approximately 16 GB of activation memory per GPU for DeepSeek-V3.

激活显存（详见第 4.1.3 节）。激活显存节省的主要来源，是为反向计算而保存的线性层输入张量。把这些张量以 FP8/FP4 而非 BF16 存储，显存占用可分别降低 50%/75%。例如对 DeepSeek-V3，FP8 每卡可节省约 16 GB 激活显存。

Parameter Memory. Conventional reduced-precision training maintains three parameter copies: FP32 master weights, BF16 model weights, and FP8/FP4 computation weights. Our native FP8/FP4 approach (detailed in Section 5.3.5 below) eliminates the BF16 copy by casting weights directly from FP32 to FP8/FP4 and doing parameter AllGather in reduced precisions.

参数显存。 常规的低精度训练会保留三份参数副本：FP32 主权重、BF16 模型权重与 FP8/FP4 计算权重。我们的原生 FP8/FP4 方案（详见下文第 5.3.5 节）把权重直接从 FP32 转成 FP8/FP4，并在低精度下做参数 AllGather，从而省掉了 BF16 那份副本。

Optimizer State Memory (detailed in Section 4.1.6). Adam optimizer states (first and second moments) can be stored in BF16 instead of FP32, reducing optimizer memory by 50%. This is orthogonal to reduced-precision training and is also applicable to BF16.

优化器状态显存（详见第 4.1.6 节）。Adam 优化器状态（一阶、二阶矩）可以 BF16 而非 FP32 存储，优化器显存因而降低 50%。这与低精度训练正交，对 BF16 训练同样适用。

5.2.2.Breaking the Communication Wall with Reduced-Precision Training用低精度训练打破通信墙

Parameter AllGather in FP8/FP4. When using FP8/FP4 primary weights with distributed optimizer, parameter AllGather communication is reduced by 50% (1 byte vs 2 bytes per parameter). Note that

FP8/FP4 下的参数 AllGather。 使用分布式优化器、且主权重为 FP8/FP4 时，参数 AllGather 的通信量减少 50%（每参数 1 字节 vs 2 字节）。需要注意的是：

  • • For NVFP4, we need to gather both row-wise and column-wise FP4 weights, so the reduced traffic of parameter AllGather is also 50%.• 对 NVFP4，我们需要同时收集行向与列向的 FP4 权重，所以参数 AllGather 减少的流量同样是 50%。
  • • For MXFP8, even with FP8 primary weights, we first copy the FP32 master weights into a temporary BF16 buffer and communicate in BF16 precision. This is because MXFP8 requires different quantization directions for forward and backward passes. Communicating MXFP8 weights would require both row-wise and column-wise quantized versions, effectively communicating two bytes per parameter and eliminating any advantage over communicating BF16. Hence, for MXFP8, we communicate parameters in BF16 precision.• 对 MXFP8，即便主权重是 FP8，我们仍会先把 FP32 主权重拷进一块临时的 BF16 缓冲，以 BF16 精度通信。原因是 MXFP8 在前向与反向需要不同的量化方向；若要通信 MXFP8 权重，就得同时传行向量化版与列向量化版，相当于每参数传两个字节，相对 BF16 通信毫无优势。因此对 MXFP8，我们以 BF16 精度通信参数。

5.2.3.Breaking the Compute Efficiency Wall with Reduced-Precision Training用低精度训练打破计算效率墙

Faster GEMMs. FP8 (Ada/Hopper and later) and FP4 (Blackwell and later) Tensor Cores provide higher throughput than BF16, accelerating both forward and backward passes.

更快的 GEMM。 FP8（Ada/Hopper 及之后）与 FP4（Blackwell 及之后）Tensor Core 的吞吐高于 BF16，前向与反向都能提速。

The Trade-off: Quantization Overhead. Reduced-precision training introduces additional quantization kernels that increase CPU overhead, which is particularly problematic for fine-grained MoE where many small operations already stress the CPU. This overhead is managed through:

取舍：量化开销。 低精度训练引入额外的量化 kernel，增加了 CPU 开销——这对细粒度 MoE 尤其棘手，因为那里已有大量小操作在压榨 CPU。这份开销通过以下手段管控：

  • • Kernel fusion that fuses quantization with other operations, such as normalization and activation functions.• 算子融合，把量化与其他操作（如归一化、激活函数）融在一起。
  • • Fuse padding/unpadding with the permutation kernel or routing map to avoid explicit padding/unpadding.• 把 padding/unpadding 融进 permutation kernel 或路由映射，避免显式的 padding/unpadding。
  • • Grouped quantization that fuses the quantization of multiple input tensors into one single kernel.• 分组量化（grouped quantization），把多个输入张量的量化融进单个 kernel。
  • • CUDA Graphs that captures quantization kernels to eliminate launch overhead. See Section 4.3.6 for more details.• 用 CUDA Graphs 捕获量化 kernel，消除启动开销。详见第 4.3.6 节。

5.3.Reduced-Precision Training Recipes: Per-Tensor FP8, Blockwise FP8, MXFP8, and NVFP4低精度训练配方：Per-Tensor FP8、Blockwise FP8、MXFP8 与 NVFP4

Having established the impact of reduced-precision training on all three walls, we now examine the technical components that define a reduced-precision training configuration.

既然已经明确低精度训练对三堵墙的影响，接下来看一套低精度训练配置由哪些技术要素构成。

A reduced-precision training recipe consists of:

一套低精度训练配方由以下几部分组成：

  • • Data format. There are two types of FP8 format: E4M3 and E5M2 [58, 46]. Usually there are two combinations used in training: ∘\circ E4M3: Inputs, weights, and gradients are all quantized in the E4M3 format. ∘\circ Hybrid: Inputs and weights are quantized in E4M3, while gradients are quantized in E5M2. While for FP4, E2M1 is the only supported format.• 数据格式。 FP8 有两种格式：E4M3 与 E5M2 [58, 46]。训练中通常有两种搭配：E4M3——输入、权重与梯度全部量化为 E4M3；混合——输入与权重用 E4M3，梯度用 E5M2。至于 FP4，E2M1 是唯一受支持的格式。
  • • Scaling granularity. Choices include per-tensor and per-block (also called group or tile). For per-block scaling, the block size also varies between recipes.• scaling 粒度。 可选 per-tensor 与 per-block（也叫 group 或 tile）。采用 per-block scaling 时，block 大小在不同配方之间也有差异。
  • • Which parts are quantized. Usually all linear layers are quantized, while keeping embedding, output layer (LM head), and optimizers in their original high precision. Part of the communication can be in FP8/FP4 (e.g., TP AllGather, DP AllGather, EP all-to-all). Current reduced-precision training recipes usually keep SDPA in BF16.• 量化哪些部分。 通常所有线性层都量化，而 embedding、输出层（LM head）与优化器保持原有高精度。部分通信可以在 FP8/FP4 下进行（如 TP AllGather、DP AllGather、EP all-to-all）。目前的低精度训练配方通常让 SDPA 保持 BF16。
  • • Additional mechanisms, such as stochastic rounding, Random Hadamard Transforms (RHT), etc. These mechanisms are recipe-specific and require careful verification.• 附加机制，如随机舍入（stochastic rounding）、随机 Hadamard 变换（RHT）等。这些机制因配方而异，需要仔细验证。

Megatron-Core provides three FP8 recipes, each validated at scale (figure 30). The evolution from per-tensor to blockwise to MXFP8 reflects both hardware advances and lessons learned from large-scale deployments. Per-Tensor Scaling uses a single scale factor per tensor, simple but limited precision, suitable for experimentation. Blockwise FP8 (128×\times128 blocks) provides finer granularity with proven stability at scale, recommended for Hopper. MXFP8 (1×\times32 granularity) offers native Blackwell Tensor Core support with hardware-accelerated scaling, recommended for Blackwell. Besides, Megatron-Core also provides an NVFP4 recipe [63] on Blackwell.

Megatron-Core 提供三种 FP8 配方，每一种都在大规模下验证过（图 30）。从 per-tensor 到 blockwise 再到 MXFP8 的演进，既反映了硬件的进步，也凝聚了大规模部署中得到的经验。Per-Tensor Scaling 每个张量只用一个 scale factor，简单但精度有限，适合做实验。Blockwise FP8（128×128 的块）粒度更细，且已被证明在大规模下稳定，是 Hopper 上的推荐配方。MXFP8（1×32 粒度）由 Blackwell Tensor Core 原生支持、scaling 由硬件加速，是 Blackwell 上的推荐配方。此外，Megatron-Core 在 Blackwell 上还提供 NVFP4 配方 [63]。

5.3.1.Per-Tensor FP8 RecipePer-Tensor FP8 配方

The per-tensor FP8 recipe, supported on Hopper and Blackwell, usually adopts the hybrid format (E4M3 for inputs/weights, E5M2 for gradients). It calculates the absolute max value (amax) of all values in the input tensor and uses that to quantize the tensor into FP8.

per-tensor FP8 配方在 Hopper 与 Blackwell 上都可用，通常采用混合格式（输入/权重用 E4M3，梯度用 E5M2）。它计算输入张量中所有值的绝对值最大值（amax），并据此把张量量化为 FP8。

There are two variants of per-tensor scaling:

per-tensor scaling 有两种变体：

  • • Delayed scaling: Use the amax from a history window. This breaks the data dependency between the calculation of amax and scaling, offering the best performance at the risk of losing precision due to the estimated amax.• 延迟 scaling（delayed scaling）：使用历史窗口中的 amax。这打破了 amax 计算与 scaling 之间的数据依赖，性能最好，代价是 amax 是估计值，可能损失精度。
  • • Current (live) scaling: Calculate the amax in a just-in-time manner, providing better precision.• 实时 scaling（current/live scaling）：以 just-in-time 方式计算 amax，精度更好。

We do not recommend delayed scaling due to precision issues; current scaling provides better precision and model convergence. Figures 31(a) and 31(b) illustrate the computation of a linear layer with per-tensor current scaling on the Hopper and Blackwell platforms, respectively. Since only TN layout FP8 GEMM is supported on Hopper, we must store the transposed FP8 activations for backward calculation. In Transformer Engine, the quantization kernels fuse the cast and transpose into a single kernel to reduce global memory access. On the Blackwell platform, FP8 GEMMs in all layouts are supported, so we do not need the transposed version, further reducing the memory footprint.

由于精度问题，我们不推荐延迟 scaling；实时 scaling 的精度与模型收敛都更好。图 31(a) 与 31(b) 分别展示了在 Hopper 与 Blackwell 平台上、采用 per-tensor 实时 scaling 的线性层计算过程。Hopper 只支持 TN 布局的 FP8 GEMM，因此必须为反向计算额外保存转置后的 FP8 激活。在 Transformer Engine 中，量化 kernel 把 cast 与 transpose 融进单个 kernel，以减少全局显存访问。在 Blackwell 平台上，各种布局的 FP8 GEMM 都支持，所以不需要转置版本，显存占用进一步降低。

Per-tensor scaling is a good starting point for migrating to FP8 training due to its simplicity and relatively good precision and performance.

由于实现简单、精度与性能都还不错，per-tensor scaling 是迁移到 FP8 训练时很好的起点。

5.3.2.Blockwise FP8 on HopperHopper 上的 Blockwise FP8

The blockwise FP8 recipe adopts the E4M3 format for all tensors, quantizing activations and gradients in 1×1281\times 128 tiles and weights in 128×128128\times 128 blocks. Blockwise scaling uses fine-grained scaling granularity for better precision and has been proven successful in production at very large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V3 [19], Minimax-M2 [59], Ant Ling-2.0 [48], etc. As a result, blockwise FP8 is the recommended FP8 recipe on the Hopper platform.

blockwise FP8 配方对所有张量都采用 E4M3 格式，激活与梯度按 1×128 的 tile 量化，权重按 128×128 的块量化。blockwise scaling 用更细的 scaling 粒度换取更好的精度，并且已在超大规模 MoE 模型的生产环境中得到验证，包括 DeepSeek-V3 [19]、Minimax-M2 [59]、Ant Ling-2.0 [48] 等。因此，blockwise FP8 是 Hopper 平台上推荐的 FP8 配方。

Transformer Engine provides highly optimized quantization kernels and GEMM kernels (via cuBLAS) for the blockwise recipe, as well as layer-level APIs and an autocast context to enable FP8 training with just a few lines of code.

针对 blockwise 配方，Transformer Engine 提供了高度优化的量化 kernel 与 GEMM kernel（经 cuBLAS），还提供了层级别的 API 与 autocast 上下文——几行代码就能启用 FP8 训练。

Figure 31(c) illustrates the computation of a linear layer with the blockwise FP8 recipe on the Hopper platform, which is very similar to the per-tensor current scaling on Hopper, except for tile-based quantization.

图 31(c) 展示了 Hopper 平台上采用 blockwise FP8 配方的线性层计算过程。除了量化按 tile 进行之外，它与 Hopper 上的 per-tensor 实时 scaling 非常相似。

5.3.3.MXFP8 on BlackwellBlackwell 上的 MXFP8

On the Blackwell platform, thanks to native fifth-generation Tensor Core support for the MXFP8 format [79], we adopt MXFP8, a more fine-grained quantization scheme for training. Both activations and weights are quantized at 1×321\times 32 granularity, and E8M0 is used for the scaling factor. Theoretically, MXFP8 should be more precise due to the finer-grained scaling granularity, and has better performance due to the native support of MXFP8 in the Tensor Core. Therefore, MXFP8 is the default FP8 recipe on the Blackwell platform.

在 Blackwell 平台上，得益于第五代 Tensor Core 对 MXFP8 格式的原生支持 [79]，我们采用 MXFP8——一种更细粒度的量化方案。激活与权重都按 1×32 粒度量化，scale factor 使用 E8M0。理论上，MXFP8 因 scaling 粒度更细而更精确，又因 Tensor Core 原生支持而性能更好。因此 MXFP8 是 Blackwell 平台上的默认 FP8 配方。

Figure 31(d) illustrates the computation of a linear layer with the MXFP8 recipe on the Blackwell platform. Although FP8 GEMMs with all layouts are supported on Blackwell, we need to store additional column-wise quantized FP8 data for activations and weights due to quantization in the other direction.

图 31(d) 展示了 Blackwell 平台上采用 MXFP8 配方的线性层计算过程。虽然 Blackwell 支持各种布局的 FP8 GEMM，但由于需要在另一个方向上也做量化，我们必须为激活与权重额外保存一份按列量化的 FP8 数据。

Ongoing optimizations for the MXFP8 recipe in MoE training include:

针对 MoE 训练的 MXFP8 配方，正在推进的优化包括：

  • 1. Grouped quantization to reduce the quantization overhead.1. 分组量化，以降低量化开销。
  • 2. Fuse activation and quantization (for the following GEMM) with the GEMM kernel.2. 把激活与量化（供后续 GEMM 使用）融进 GEMM kernel。
  • 3. Ensure that the whole pipeline of MXFP8 quantization, scaling factor swizzling, and Grouped GEMM is CUDA-graphable.3. 确保 MXFP8 量化、scale factor swizzle 与 Grouped GEMM 的整条流水线都能被 CUDA Graph 捕获。

5.3.4.NVFP4 on BlackwellBlackwell 上的 NVFP4

In [63], we presented NVFP4 as a 4-bit microscaling format for LLM training that improves numerical fidelity while preserving the efficiency benefits of FP4.

在 [63] 中，我们提出 NVFP4 作为一种面向 LLM 训练的 4 位微缩放（microscaling）格式，它在保留 FP4 效率优势的同时改善了数值保真度。

NVFP4 uses FP4 elements in E2M1 format, so values are quantized with scaling because raw FP4 has a very limited representable range. A central design choice is two-level microscaling. NVFP4 applies a per-tensor FP32 scale and a per-block 8-bit scale in E4M3. The tensor-level FP32 scale first remaps the tensor distribution into a range compatible with block scaling, and the block-level E4M3 scale then maps each block into FP4 range. NVFP4 uses blocks of 16 contiguous elements, and each block’s amax is scaled to the FP4 maximum.

NVFP4 的元素采用 E2M1 格式，由于原始 FP4 的可表示范围极其有限，数值必须带缩放地量化。一个核心设计选择是两级微缩放：NVFP4 同时施加一个 per-tensor 的 FP32 scale 和一个 per-block 的 8 位 E4M3 scale。张量级的 FP32 scale 先把整个张量的分布重映射到适合块缩放的范围内，块级的 E4M3 scale 再把每个块映射进 FP4 的表示范围。NVFP4 的块大小为 16 个连续元素，每块的 amax 被缩放到 FP4 的最大值。

Building on this format design, we also found that stable NVFP4 training depends on several algorithmic choices around quantization. In particular, we add three practical techniques:

在这种格式设计的基础上，我们还发现稳定的 NVFP4 训练依赖若干围绕量化的算法选择。具体来说，我们加入了三项实用技术：

  • • Random Hadamard Transforms (RHT): Applied to weight gradient computation to reduce the impact of outliers.• 随机 Hadamard 变换（RHT）：施加于权重梯度的计算，以削弱离群值的影响。
  • • 2D scaling: Specifically, 16x16 weight block scaling (with the FP32 tensor scale retained) is used to keep weight quantization more consistent between forward and backward passes and reduce forward/backward quantization mismatch.• 二维 scaling：具体是 16×16 的权重块缩放（同时保留 FP32 的张量级 scale），使权重量化在前向与反向之间更一致，减小前向/反向的量化失配。
  • • Stochastic rounding: Used on gradients to reduce rounding bias during FP4 conversion, as deterministic rounding introduces bias that hurts convergence.• 随机舍入（stochastic rounding）：用于梯度，以减小 FP4 转换过程中的舍入偏差——确定性舍入会引入偏差，损害收敛。

These additions are a key part of the training recipe used in the paper and are important for convergence at larger scales.

这些增补是论文所用训练配方的关键组成部分，对更大规模下的收敛至关重要。

5.3.5.FP8/FP4 Primary Weights: Eliminating Redundant StorageFP8/FP4 主权重：消除冗余存储

Conventional reduced-precision training maintains a three-tier parameter hierarchy: FP32 master weights for optimizer updates, BF16 model weights as an intermediate representation, and FP8/FP4 weights for forward and backward GEMM computation. This introduces redundant memory overhead by maintaining both BF16 and FP8/FP4 copies of parameters.

常规的低精度训练维护三层参数体系：供优化器更新用的 FP32 主权重、作为中间表示的 BF16 模型权重，以及供前向与反向 GEMM 计算使用的 FP8/FP4 权重。这同时保留了 BF16 与 FP8/FP4 两份参数副本，造成冗余的显存开销。

Native FP8/FP4 eliminates this redundancy by establishing a direct casting path from FP32 master weights to FP8/FP4 computation weights, bypassing the BF16 intermediate layer entirely, reducing memory footprint and accelerating parameter AllGather.

原生 FP8/FP4 消除了这份冗余：它在 FP32 主权重与 FP8/FP4 计算权重之间建立了直接的转换通路，完全绕过 BF16 这个中间层，既降低显存占用，又加速参数 AllGather。

The core challenge in implementing native FP8/FP4 lies in managing the quantization metadata required for FP8/FP4 tensors. We provide a unified interface supporting different FP8/FP4 recipes (delayed scaling, current scaling, blockwise scaling, MXFP8 and NVFP4) that handles version-specific differences in TransformerEngine’s implementations, ensuring compatibility across versions.

实现原生 FP8/FP4 的核心难点，在于管理 FP8/FP4 张量所需的量化元数据。我们提供了一个统一接口，支持多种 FP8/FP4 配方（延迟 scaling、实时 scaling、blockwise scaling、MXFP8 与 NVFP4），并处理了 TransformerEngine 各版本实现之间的差异，保证跨版本兼容。

During each optimizer step in the distributed optimizer, the FP32 parameter shards are updated based on reduced gradients. Subsequently, these updated FP32 shards are directly quantized to FP8/FP4 format using the appropriate scaling factors. The quantization process computes the amax from the FP32 values, updates the scaling factors across data-parallel ranks to maintain consistency, and writes the quantized FP8/FP4 values to the model parameter buffers. This direct path eliminates the memory overhead of maintaining BF16 parameters, a reduction particularly impactful for large language models where parameter memory can exceed hundreds of gigabytes.

在分布式优化器的每次优化器步中，FP32 参数分片依据归约后的梯度完成更新。随后，这些更新后的 FP32 分片用相应的 scale factor 直接量化为 FP8/FP4。量化过程从 FP32 值计算 amax，在各数据并行 rank 之间同步更新 scale factor 以保持一致，再把量化后的 FP8/FP4 值写进模型参数缓冲。这条直达通路省掉了维护 BF16 参数的显存开销——对于参数显存可达数百 GB 的大语言模型，这一节省尤为可观。

More specifically, the quantization of FP32 shards for delayed scaling and current scaling proceeds in three steps, see figure 33:

更具体地说，针对延迟 scaling 与实时 scaling，FP32 分片的量化分三步进行，见图 33：

  • • Step 1: Get local abs-max from master weights. If a weight has no sharded part on the current rank, set its corresponding abs-max to 0.• 第 1 步：从主权重求本地 abs-max。若某个权重在当前 rank 上没有分片部分，则把其对应的 abs-max 置为 0。
  • • Step 2: Get global abs-max through AllReduce.• 第 2 步：通过 AllReduce 求全局 abs-max。
  • • Step 3: Use global abs-max and master weights to do partial cast.• 第 3 步：用全局 abs-max 与主权重做局部转换（partial cast）。

In the Blockwise recipe, the abs-max of a weight is computed over a 2D block, so we cannot directly use a reduction kernel to obtain the local abs-max. We implemented specialized kernels that are aware of the weight’s 2D layout and the correspondence between the master weight and the original weight to compute the abs-max, see figure 32.

在 blockwise 配方中，权重的 abs-max 是在一个二维块上求的，因此不能直接用归约 kernel 求本地 abs-max。我们实现了专用 kernel，它会感知权重的二维布局以及主权重与原始权重之间的对应关系，据此计算 abs-max，见图 32。

Another advantage of FP8/FP4 primary weights is that the parameter AllGather communication volume is greatly reduced (see Section 5.2.2).

FP8/FP4 主权重的另一个好处是参数 AllGather 的通信量大幅降低（见第 5.2.2 节）。

5.4.MoE-Specific Challenges and Solutions of Reduced-Precision TrainingMoE 特有的低精度训练挑战与解法

The preceding subsections covered the fundamentals of reduced-precision training applicable to any deep learning model. MoE architectures introduce unique challenges for reduced-precision training that require specialized solutions beyond standard implementations.

前面几小节讲的是低精度训练的基础，适用于任何深度学习模型。MoE 架构给低精度训练带来了独有的挑战，需要超出标准实现的专门解法。

5.4.1.Fusion of Padding and Unpadding: Dynamic Shape Alignment融合 padding 与 unpadding：动态形状对齐

FP8 and FP4 GEMMs require tensor dimensions to be aligned to specific multiples: 16 for per-tensor and blockwise recipes, and 32 for MXFP8 and NVFP4. These padding requirements arise from the block scaling granularity of each quantization recipe, as well as the requirement that Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) accesses maintain 16-byte alignment along the GEMM dot-product dimension. In the forward pass, the hidden dimension K is the dot-product dimension and is usually already aligned by model design. However, in the weight-gradient GEMM, the dot-product dimension corresponds to the token dimension M, which varies dynamically and often does not satisfy the alignment requirement. As a result, zero-padding along the token dimension is necessary. To further enable grouped quantization kernels with lower CPU overhead and CUDA Graph compatibility, we increase the tokens-per-expert padding to 128. Section 5.4.3 explains why this larger padding is required for the NVFP4 grouped quantization kernel; the same principle also applies to MXFP8 grouped quantization. In summary, the final padding applied to the token dimension is determined jointly by the requirements of all kernels involved in the routed expert layer.

FP8 与 FP4 GEMM 要求张量维度对齐到特定倍数：per-tensor 与 blockwise 配方是 16，MXFP8 与 NVFP4 是 32。这些 padding 要求一方面来自各量化配方的块缩放粒度，另一方面来自张量内存加速器（TMA）访问须在 GEMM 点积维度上保持 16 字节对齐的要求。前向过程中，隐藏维 K 就是点积维，通常模型设计时已对齐。但权重梯度 GEMM 的点积维对应的是 token 维 M，它是动态变化的，往往不满足对齐要求。因此必须沿 token 维做零填充。为进一步支持 CPU 开销更低、且兼容 CUDA Graph 的分组量化 kernel，我们把每专家的 token padding 提高到 128。第 5.4.3 节解释了 NVFP4 分组量化 kernel 为何需要这么大的 padding；同样的道理也适用于 MXFP8 分组量化。总之，token 维最终采用的 padding 量，是由被路由专家层中所有相关 kernel 的需求共同决定的。

Our baseline solution is the fused padding and unpadding kernels for multiple input tensors for different experts. However, explicit padding and unpadding kernels introduce non-negligible overheads. We propose two solutions:

我们的基线方案是融合的 padding 与 unpadding kernel，可一次处理多个输入张量、适用于不同专家。然而显式的 padding 与 unpadding kernel 会带来不可忽视的开销。我们提出两种解法：

  • • Routing map padding, which pads the routing map instead of the received tokens. This ensures the number of tokens per expert is aligned to the requirement at the cost of sending only a small number of extra tokens, avoiding expensive per-tensor padding operations.• 路由映射 padding：对路由映射做 padding，而不是对收到的 token 做 padding。这样只需多送少量 token，就能保证每个专家的 token 数满足对齐要求，避免了昂贵的逐张量 padding 操作。
  • • Fusing padding into permutation avoids one-pass of global memory read and write and should provide the best performance. It is the default choice when available.• 把 padding 融进 permutation：省掉一整趟全局显存的读写，性能应当最好。在条件允许时这是默认选择。

5.4.2.Grouped Quantization and Grouped GEMM分组量化与 Grouped GEMM

Due to the different padding requirements between the quantized data and scaling factors, and the complex data layouts introduced by both row-wise and column-wise quantization, a naive way to quantize the input tensors for different experts is to apply the quantization kernel to them one by one. Nevertheless, it introduces plenty of tiny kernels, which adds to the CPU overhead and is not efficient from the GPU perspective.

量化数据与 scale factor 的对齐要求不同，加上行向量化与列向量化同时存在所引入的复杂数据布局，一个朴素的做法是逐个对张量施加量化 kernel 来准备各专家的输入。但这样会产生大量微小 kernel，既加重 CPU 开销，从 GPU 角度看也不高效。

To tackle this problem, we implement grouped quantization kernels to fuse the quantization of multiple tensors into one single kernel, which greatly reduces the CPU overhead, improves the GPU utilization and is CUDA-Graphable.

为此我们实现分组量化 kernel，把多个张量的量化融进单个 kernel——大幅降低 CPU 开销、提升 GPU 利用率，并且可被 CUDA Graph 捕获。

Optimized and CUDA-Graphable grouped GEMM in Section 4.3.7.

经过优化、可被 CUDA Graph 捕获的 Grouped GEMM 见第 4.3.7 节。

5.4.3.NVFP4 Quantization FusionNVFP4 量化融合

NVFP4 quantization is particularly more complicated because of the numerical techniques we use to preserve numerical stability, so aggressive kernel fusion is necessary to keep quantization overhead under control. In practice, our NVFP4 quantization kernel is not just a simple “scale + cast” kernel: it needs to carefully absorb the training-recipe logic, including Random Hadamard Transform, 2D scaling and stochastic rounding.

为了保住数值稳定性而采用的若干数值技术，使 NVFP4 量化格外复杂，因此必须做激进的算子融合，才能把量化开销压住。实践中，我们的 NVFP4 量化 kernel 并不只是简单的「scale + cast」——它需要把训练配方的逻辑仔细吸收进来，包括随机 Hadamard 变换、二维 scaling 与随机舍入。

Among these, RHT fusion is the most latency-sensitive. If implemented as a separate kernel, the Hadamard transform would introduce an additional full-precision (BF16) read/write of the tensor in global memory, significantly increasing bandwidth cost. By fusing RHT with NVFP4 quantization, we perform the Hadamard transform and FP4 quantization in a single kernel, avoiding that extra BF16 traffic.

其中对延迟最敏感的是 RHT 融合。若把 Hadamard 变换实现为独立 kernel，就要对张量在全局显存里额外做一次全精度（BF16）读写，带宽成本显著上升。把 RHT 与 NVFP4 量化融合后，Hadamard 变换与 FP4 量化在单个 kernel 内完成，省掉了这笔额外的 BF16 流量。

A second implementation challenge is that Blackwell NVFP4 Tensor Core GEMMs are TN-oriented, while Wgrad uses transposed activations and gradients. Therefore, when RHT is fused into NVFP4 quantization for the Wgrad path, the kernel must also absorb the transpose, rather than relying on a separate BF16 transpose kernel (which would again incur a full BF16 tensor read and write through global memory).

第二个实现难点是：Blackwell 的 NVFP4 Tensor Core GEMM 是 TN 取向的，而权重梯度（Wgrad）用的是转置后的激活与梯度。因此当 RHT 被融进 Wgrad 路径的 NVFP4 量化时，kernel 还必须一并吸收转置——否则就得单独跑一个 BF16 转置 kernel，那又会带来一整趟 BF16 张量的全局显存读写。

As a result, the fused quantization pipeline must support multiple outputs from the same high-precision input: (1) standard FP4 quantization for forward-pass GEMMs, and (2) transpose + RHT + FP4 quantization for the backward/Wgrad path. In training, we launch this fused kernel during the forward pass to generate two FP4 copies: one consumed immediately by the forward GEMM, and one saved for backward. The original high-precision input is then discarded, so we avoid storing BF16 activations while still preparing the backward path efficiently.

结果就是，融合后的量化流水线必须能从同一份高精度输入产出多份输出：（1）供前向 GEMM 使用的标准 FP4 量化结果；（2）供反向/Wgrad 路径使用的「转置 + RHT + FP4 量化」结果。训练中，我们在前向过程发射这个融合 kernel，产出两份 FP4 副本：一份立刻被前向 GEMM 消费，一份留给反向。随后原始的高精度输入即被丢弃——这样既避免了保存 BF16 激活，又高效地备好了反向路径。

A further complication comes from the per-tensor FP32 scale in NVFP4. Current NVFP4 pretraining recipe, the tensor-wide abs-max is measured after the Hadamard transform, which means we need a dedicated Hadamard+amax kernel that computes only the amax (without materializing a transformed BF16 output buffer). As a result, the Hadamard transform is effectively computed twice—first in the Hadamard-amax kernel and then again in the fused quantization kernel. Although this duplicates transform compute, it is still faster end-to-end than writing out a full transformed BF16 tensor to global memory, because it avoids the extra high-bandwidth BF16 read/write traffic.

更麻烦的一层来自 NVFP4 的 per-tensor FP32 scale。当前的 NVFP4 预训练配方中，张量级的 abs-max 是在 Hadamard 变换之后测得的，这意味着需要一个专门的 Hadamard+amax kernel，它只计算 amax（不落地变换后的 BF16 输出缓冲）。结果，Hadamard 变换实际上被算了两次——先在 Hadamard-amax kernel 里算一次，再在融合量化 kernel 里算一次。虽然重复了变换计算，但端到端仍比把整个变换后的 BF16 张量写回全局显存要快，因为省掉了那笔高带宽的 BF16 读写流量。

In contrast, 2D quantization is less visible in end-to-end throughput because it applies only to weights: we can quantize weights once (for example, on the first microbatch) and cache the quantized weights and scales for reuse across later microbatches, so its cost is largely amortized.

相比之下，二维量化在端到端吞吐上不那么显眼，因为它只作用于权重：权重可以只量化一次（例如在第一个 micro-batch 上），把量化后的权重与 scale 缓存下来供后续 micro-batch 复用，成本因此被大幅摊薄。

Stochastic rounding, however, adds a kernel-level requirement on the critical path: the quantization kernel must also support an optional stochastic rounding path with random number generated in kernel (enabled for gradient tensors such as dY, disabled otherwise) so that FP4 quantization remain fused in a single pass. To keep this efficient, we use NVIDIA cuRANDDx[68] for device-side random number generation inside the fused CUDA quantization kernel.

随机舍入则不同，它在关键路径上提出了 kernel 层面的要求：量化 kernel 必须同时支持一条可选的随机舍入路径，随机数在 kernel 内生成（对 dY 之类的梯度张量启用，其他情况关闭），这样才能让 FP4 量化保持单趟融合。为保持高效，我们在融合的 CUDA 量化 kernel 内部使用 NVIDIA cuRANDDx [68] 做设备端随机数生成。

Supporting NVFP4 quantization for MoE layers is especially challenging due to the algorithmic complexity of the NVFP4 recipe itself. Under a full-iteration CUDA Graph requirement, the MoE quantization path must also be CUDA Graph safe: the host cannot depend on dynamic expert-token counts on the CPU, and can only rely on a device-side tokens-per-expert tensor. This means that input activation can no longer be splitted and quantized individually. We must implement grouped quantization kernels for the full NVFP4 pipeline. The memory allocation of NVFP4 output must be allocated as a whole flat buffer without knowing the shapes in between.

为 MoE 层支持 NVFP4 量化尤其困难，因为 NVFP4 配方本身的算法就很复杂。在「整迭代 CUDA Graph」的要求下，MoE 的量化路径还必须对 CUDA Graph 安全：主机侧不能依赖 CPU 上的动态专家-token 数，只能依赖设备端的「每专家 token 数」张量。这意味着输入激活再也不能被拆分后逐个量化，我们必须为整条 NVFP4 流水线实现分组量化 kernel。NVFP4 输出的显存也必须作为一整块平坦缓冲来分配，无法事先知道中间各段的形状。

A key observation is that much of the dense NVFP4 activation quantization kernel can be reused for grouped quantization, because tokens for different experts are continuously packed in memory after routing/permutation. The main differences are implementation constraints needed to preserve performance and graph safety.

一个关键观察是：稠密的 NVFP4 激活量化 kernel 大部分可以直接复用于分组量化——因为经过路由/permutation 之后，不同专家的 token 在内存中已经是连续打包的。差别主要在那些为保住性能与图安全性而必须加的实现约束。

  • 1. A quantization thread block should not span tokens from multiple experts, since that introduces significant control-flow and indexing overhead; therefore, we zero-pad each expert’s token count to an integer multiple of the thread block shape in the token dimension (typically 128).1. 一个量化线程块不应跨越多个专家的 token，否则会引入大量控制流与索引开销。因此，我们把每个专家的 token 数在 token 维上零填充到线程块形状的整数倍（通常为 128）。
  • 2. The NVFP4 transpose must be performed per expert (transpose each expert’s packed activation independently, then concatenate), which is not equivalent to transposing the entire grouped buffer as one tensor.2. NVFP4 的转置必须按专家分别进行（各专家的打包激活独立转置后再拼接），这不等价于把整个分组缓冲当作一个张量来转置。
  • 3. NVFP4 GEMM requires scale-factor swizzling: scaling factors must be padded to a 128×4-aligned shape and swizzled into the 32×16 layout before GEMM as described in the cuBLAS document[66]. This scaling factor shape constraint is applied to per-expert GEMM, which means that determining the required padding size would implicitly require CPU visibility into tokens-per-expert, which is not CUDA Graph safe. To avoid that, we enforce 128-token alignment per expert by construction.3. NVFP4 GEMM 需要 scale factor 的 swizzle：如 cuBLAS 文档 [66] 所述，scale factor 必须先填充到 128×4 对齐的形状，再在 GEMM 之前 swizzle 成 32×16 的布局。这一 scale factor 形状约束作用在「逐专家 GEMM」上，意味着确定所需 padding 大小会隐含地要求 CPU 能看到「每专家 token 数」，这对 CUDA Graph 不安全。为规避这一点，我们通过构造强制每个专家都按 128 token 对齐。

Both point 1) and point 3) imposed 128 multiple tokens-per-expert, which requires a specific zero padding kernel to satisfy. To eliminate such zero padding overhead, we fuse the per-expert zero-padding capability into the token-permute kernel, so the routed expert activations are produced in an already aligned and zero padded layout, and downstream grouped NVFP4 quantization/GEMM kernels can assume the required alignment without additional preprocessing.

第 1 点与第 3 点都要求每专家 token 数为 128 的倍数，这需要一个专门的零填充 kernel 来满足。为消除这份零填充开销，我们把「逐专家零填充」的能力融进了 token-permute kernel——这样被路由的专家激活产出时就已经是对齐且零填充好的布局，下游的分组 NVFP4 量化/GEMM kernel 可以直接假定对齐已满足，无需额外的预处理。

For the per-tensor FP32 second-level scale in the NVFP4 recipe, the per-tensor second-level scale in MoE means per-expert second-level scale instead of making every expert share the amax to preserve numerical stability during training. These amax values cannot be known ahead of time: they must be computed online from the routed tokens and generated as distinct per-expert amax values on every iteration. To address this efficiently, we leverage the 128-aligned tokens-per-expert guarantee and adapt the dense-input implementation into a CUDA-Graph-safe grouped Hadamard-amax kernel.

关于 NVFP4 配方中的 per-tensor FP32 第二级 scale：在 MoE 中，per-tensor 的第二级 scale 实际是 per-expert（逐专家）的第二级 scale，而不是让所有专家共用一个 amax——这样才能在训练中保住数值稳定性。这些 amax 无法事先得知：它们必须在每次迭代中从被路由的 token 在线算出，并生成各专家各自的 amax 值。为高效处理这一点，我们借助「每专家 128 对齐」的保证，把稠密输入的实现改造成了 CUDA-Graph 安全的分组 Hadamard-amax kernel。

6.Long-Context MoE Training长上下文 MoE 训练

The preceding sections addressed the three walls (memory, communication, and compute efficiency) under the assumption that MoE layers dominate computational cost. This assumption holds for typical training tasks with sequence lengths of 4K–8K tokens, where expert computation and all-to-all communication are the primary bottlenecks. However, the rise of reasoning models (OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1 [17], etc.) and RL-based training have created a new frontier: sequences of 16K, 64K, or even longer. At these lengths, a fundamental shift occurs in the performance characteristics of MoE training: attention dominates the computation, and the relative importance of the three walls changes accordingly. This section examines how long-context training reshapes the three walls for MoE models, and how Megatron-Core addresses the new challenges.

前面各章讨论三堵墙（显存、通信、计算效率）时，都建立在「MoE 层主导计算开销」这一假设之上。对序列长度 4K–8K token 的典型训练任务，这个假设是成立的——专家计算与 all-to-all 通信是主要瓶颈。然而，推理模型（OpenAI o1、DeepSeek-R1 [17] 等）的兴起以及基于 RL 的训练，开辟了一片新战场：序列长度 16K、64K 乃至更长。在这样的长度下，MoE 训练的性能特征会发生根本性转变：注意力主导计算，三堵墙的相对重要性也随之改变。本章考察长上下文训练如何重塑 MoE 模型的三堵墙，以及 Megatron-Core 如何应对这些新挑战。

6.1.When Attention Dominates: The Computational Shift当注意力开始主导：计算量的转移

In Section 4, we established that MoE training faces three fundamental walls: memory, communication, and compute efficiency. The optimizations presented there (activation management, dispatcher optimization, Grouped GEMM, and CUDA Graphs) target scenarios where MoE layers dominate the computational profile. Long-context training fundamentally alters this assumption. The key insight is the differing computational complexity between MoE and attention layers, as shown in figure 34:

第 4 章确立了一个前提：MoE 训练面临三堵根本性的墙——显存、通信与计算效率。那里给出的优化（激活管理、dispatcher 优化、Grouped GEMM 与 CUDA Graphs）都针对「MoE 层主导计算画像」的场景。长上下文训练从根本上改变了这个前提。关键洞察在于 MoE 层与注意力层计算复杂度的差异，如图 34 所示：

  • • MLP Components: Computational cost scales linearly with sequence length, exhibiting O⁡(s)O(s) complexity.• MLP 部分：计算开销随序列长度线性增长，复杂度为 O(s)。
  • • Attention Components: Scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) dominates the computational cost, scaling quadratically with sequence length, exhibiting O⁡(s2)O(s^{2}) complexity. This quadratic scaling has motivated extensive research into efficient attention mechanisms [6, 99].• 注意力部分：缩放点积注意力（SDPA）主导计算开销，随序列长度平方增长，复杂度为 O(s2)。正是这种平方增长，催生了大量关于高效注意力机制的研究 [6, 99]。

For example, at 64K tokens, SDPA consumes 69% of FLOPs, compared to only 10–15% in short-sequence scenarios. Attention becomes dominant in computation. Fortunately, SDPA is highly optimized in most GPU-accelerated libraries such as FlashAttention [15, 16, 80] and cuDNN (Table 9), so SDPA does not become a performance bottleneck. The optimization focus therefore shifts to memory and communication: as long as we address these two challenges without introducing excessive overhead, training performance is preserved.

举例来说，在 64K token 时，SDPA 吃掉 69% 的 FLOPs，而在短序列场景下这一比例只有 10–15%。注意力成了计算的主导。好在 SDPA 在多数 GPU 加速库（如 FlashAttention [15, 16, 80] 与 cuDNN，见表 9）中已被高度优化，因此它并不会成为性能瓶颈。优化的重心于是转移到显存与通信上：只要把这两个挑战解决好、且不引入过多额外开销，训练性能就能保住。

6.2.Managing Activation Memory Growth应对激活显存的增长

Activation memory growth with sequence length is the primary challenge in long-context training. To address this intensified memory wall, we apply a set of techniques that work together, informed by large-scale MoE workloads, including DeepSeek-V3 [19] and Qwen3 [98]. These techniques extend the memory-optimization principles introduced in Section 4.1.

激活显存随序列长度增长，是长上下文训练的首要挑战。为应对这座加剧的显存墙，我们综合运用一组互相配合的技术，其取舍经验来自 DeepSeek-V3 [19]、Qwen3 [98] 等大规模 MoE 工作负载。这些技术延续了第 4.1 节提出的显存优化原则。

Context Parallelism and Tensor Parallelism. Combining Context Parallelism (CP) and Tensor Parallelism (TP) distributes activation memory across devices, enabling sequence lengths that would otherwise exceed GPU capacity. The key principle is to keep sub-sequence length (sequence length per CP/TP shard) approximately constant, typically 4096 or 8192. Scaling CP×TP\text{CP}\times\text{TP} with sequence length keeps per-device memory near baseline levels. This makes the workload resemble short-context training, except for SDPA and TP/CP-specific communication, so most short-context optimizations remain applicable.

上下文并行与张量并行。 上下文并行（CP）与张量并行（TP）结合使用，把激活显存分散到多张卡上，从而支持原本超出单卡容量的序列长度。关键原则是让子序列长度（每个 CP/TP 分片上的序列长度）大致保持恒定，通常取 4096 或 8192。让 CP×TP 随序列长度一起扩展，就能把每卡显存维持在接近基线的水平。这样除了 SDPA 以及 TP/CP 特有的通信之外，工作负载看上去就像短上下文训练，因此大多数短上下文优化依然适用。

Optimizer CPU Offloading. Optimizer states often consume tens of gigabytes per GPU in large models. CPU offloading can reclaim this memory almost entirely, at the cost of transfer and host-side optimizer overhead. The choice is therefore a trade-off between memory headroom and throughput. For DeepSeek-V3 on 256 H100 GPUs, at around 50% MFU and sequence lengths of at least 16K, the worst-case overhead is about 2%. Although the exact trade-off depends on model size, sequence length, and cluster scale, optimizer CPU offloading is usually worthwhile for long-context training.

优化器 CPU offload。 在大模型中，优化器状态常占用每卡数十 GB。CPU offload 几乎可以把这块显存全部回收，代价是数据搬运与主机侧优化器开销。因此这是一个在显存余量与吞吐之间的取舍。对 256 张 H100 上的 DeepSeek-V3，在约 50% MFU、序列长度至少 16K 的条件下，最坏情况的开销约为 2%。具体取舍取决于模型规模、序列长度与集群规模，但对长上下文训练来说，优化器 CPU offload 通常是划算的。

Selective Recomputation. Recomputation trades compute for memory by discarding intermediate activations in forward and regenerating them in backward. The key is module-level selectivity based on memory-to-compute trade-offs. In long-context settings, SDPA dominates total computation, so recomputing SDPA (core attention recomputation in Megatron-Core) is usually too expensive. In contrast, recomputing lower-cost components such as MLP-related modules often provides better net benefit. For DeepSeek-V3 at 64K sequence length, SDPA contributes up to 72% of total compute; recomputing it adds about 18% compute overhead, causes about 16% performance loss, and saves only 9 GB memory. Recomputing non-SDPA components instead saves 89.8 GB globally with comparable or lower performance impact. We therefore recommend disabling core attention recomputation and prioritizing recomputation of other modules.

选择性重计算。 重计算用算力换显存：前向丢弃中间激活，反向再重新生成。关键在于按「显存—算力」的权衡做模块级的选择性。长上下文场景下 SDPA 主导总计算量，所以重算 SDPA（Megatron-Core 中的 core attention 重计算）通常太贵。相反，重算 MLP 相关模块这类成本较低的组件，净收益往往更好。对 64K 序列长度的 DeepSeek-V3，SDPA 占总计算量最多 72%；重算它会增加约 18% 的计算开销、造成约 16% 的性能损失，却只省下 9 GB 显存。而改为重算非 SDPA 组件，全局可省 89.8 GB，性能影响相当甚至更低。因此我们建议关闭 core attention 重计算，优先重算其他模块。

In practice, CP and TP are the primary mechanisms for long-context memory efficiency. Optimizer CPU offloading and selective recomputation then provide additional headroom, especially on memory-constrained platforms. These techniques work well together and can be combined as needed.

实践中，CP 与 TP 是长上下文显存效率的主要手段；优化器 CPU offload 与选择性重计算则提供额外的余量，在显存紧张的平台上尤其有用。这些技术配合良好，可按需组合。

6.3.Context Parallelism vs. Tensor Parallelism上下文并行 vs. 张量并行

Because CP and TP are the two most effective strategies in long-context training, the practical question is how to combine them when attention dominates computation.

CP 与 TP 是长上下文训练中最有效的两种策略，那么实际问题是：当注意力主导计算时，二者该如何搭配？

Both CP and TP reduce activation memory in long-context training, but their communication patterns and memory effects differ (Figure 35). CP partitions activations along the sequence dimension and reduces activation memory by a factor of CP. For SDPA, CP has two communication modes: point-to-point (P2P) and all-to-all. P2P CP exchanges the KV cache within the CP group in a ring-style pattern that overlaps with SDPA computation [53, 7, 37]. All-to-all CP transforms tensors from sequence-sharded to head-sharded form before SDPA, then restores sequence-sharded form afterward. TP additionally shards linear weights, reducing parameter memory but introducing extra collectives in linear layers. In both all-to-all CP and TP, SDPA runs on head-sharded tensors, which increases per-shard sub-sequence length and can improve SDPA kernel efficiency.

CP 与 TP 都能降低长上下文训练中的激活显存，但它们的通信模式与显存效果不同（图 35）。CP 沿序列维切分激活，把激活显存降低为原来的 1/CP。对 SDPA 而言，CP 有两种通信模式：点对点（P2P）与 all-to-all。P2P CP 在 CP 组内以环状方式交换 KV cache，并与 SDPA 计算重叠 [53, 7, 37]。All-to-all CP 在 SDPA 之前把张量从「按序列分片」转成「按头分片」，之后复原为按序列分片。TP 则进一步切分线性层权重，降低参数显存，但会在线性层引入额外的集合通信。在 all-to-all CP 与 TP 中，SDPA 都运行在按头分片的张量上，这拉长了每个分片上的子序列长度，可以提升 SDPA kernel 的效率。

In practice, P2P CP is the more common CP mode. Relative to TP, its main advantage is that communication overlaps naturally with computation, while TP communication is often harder to hide. TP, however, reduces dense parameter memory and can improve SDPA efficiency. As a result, TP is usually preferred within a node, where communication is fast and memory benefits are strong. Across nodes, P2P CP often becomes preferable because TP communication overhead grows while P2P overlap remains effective. All-to-all CP sits between the two: it avoids multi-step ring exchange used by P2P CP and avoids linear-weight sharding overhead introduced by TP. In practice, all-to-all CP is often combined with TP for intra-node execution when ring-style exchange is undesirable and TP communication cost is high.

实践中 P2P CP 是更常用的 CP 模式。相对 TP，它的主要优势是通信能与计算自然重叠，而 TP 的通信往往更难藏住。但 TP 能降低稠密参数显存，还能提升 SDPA 效率。因此在节点内通常更偏好 TP——那里的通信快，显存收益也实在。跨节点时，P2P CP 往往更合适，因为 TP 的通信开销会变大，而 P2P 的重叠依然有效。All-to-all CP 介于两者之间：它既避开了 P2P CP 的多步环状交换，也避开了 TP 引入的线性层权重分片开销。实践中，当环状交换不合适、且 TP 通信成本偏高时，节点内常把 all-to-all CP 与 TP 搭配使用。

Megatron-Core supports combining both CP backends as hierarchical CP, enabling topology-aware pairing with TP. A practical starting point is to use all-to-all CP with TP inside nodes to improve SDPA kernel performance and reduce parameter memory, while using P2P CP across nodes to preserve communication-computation overlap. These are guidelines rather than hard rules, but they work well as an initial configuration for TP/CP tuning.

Megatron-Core 支持把两种 CP 后端组合成层次化 CP（hierarchical CP），从而可以按拓扑与 TP 配对。一个实用的起点是：节点内用 all-to-all CP 配 TP，以提升 SDPA kernel 性能并降低参数显存；跨节点用 P2P CP，以保住通信-计算重叠。这些是指导原则而非硬性规则，但作为 TP/CP 调优的初始配置相当好用。

6.4.Packed Sequences for Variable-Length Training面向变长训练的打包序列（Packed Sequences）

The preceding subsections examined how the Three Walls (memory, communication, and compute efficiency) shift when sequence length increases. These analyses assumed fixed-length sequences within each batch. However, practical training scenarios, particularly reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, often involve variable-length sequences that introduce additional efficiency challenges.

前面几小节考察了序列长度增加时三堵墙（显存、通信、计算效率）如何改变。那些分析都假定每个 batch 内是定长序列。但实际训练场景——尤其是强化学习与监督微调——常常是变长序列，这会带来额外的效率挑战。

Traditional batching requires padding all sequences to the maximum length within each batch, leading to substantial waste when sequence lengths vary widely [45]. For instance, if a batch contains sequences of lengths 4K, 8K, and 32K tokens, all sequences must be padded to 32K, wasting ∼\sim60% of computation and memory on padding tokens. This inefficiency compounds the memory and compute challenges discussed above.

传统批处理要求把每个 batch 内所有序列都 padding 到最大长度，当序列长度差异很大时浪费严重 [45]。举例来说，若一个 batch 里含 4K、8K、32K token 的序列，所有序列都得补到 32K——约 60% 的计算与显存被浪费在 padding token 上。这种低效会叠加到前面讨论的显存与计算挑战之上。

To address this, Megatron-LM introduces packed sequences to process variable-length sequences within a single batch without padding waste. Furthermore, to address the DP imbalance and CP inefficiency caused by variable-length sequences, we introduce Dynamic Context Parallelism (Dynamic-CP), which adaptively selects the effective CP size on a per-microbatch basis, jointly with the sequence packing plan.

为此，Megatron-LM 引入了打包序列（packed sequences），可在单个 batch 内处理变长序列而不产生 padding 浪费。更进一步，针对变长序列造成的 DP 不均衡与 CP 低效，我们引入了动态上下文并行（Dynamic-CP）——它以 micro-batch 为单位自适应地选择实际生效的 CP 规模，并与序列打包方案联合决定。

6.4.1.Packed Sequence Support打包序列支持

Megatron-LM supports packed sequences, enabling multiple variable-length sequences to be concatenated and processed within a single batch without inter-sequence padding. This is achieved through the THD (Total tokens ×\times Heads ×\times Dimension) tensor format, as opposed to the conventional SBHD (Sequence ×\times Batch ×\times Heads ×\times Dimension) format. THD represents attention tensors as [total_tokens, num_heads, head_dim], where sequences from different samples are concatenated along the token dimension.

Megatron-LM 支持打包序列：多个变长序列可以拼接起来，在单个 batch 内一起处理，序列之间无需 padding。这通过 THD（Total tokens × Heads × Dimension）张量格式实现，而非传统的 SBHD（Sequence × Batch × Heads × Dimension）格式。THD 把注意力张量表示为 [total_tokens, num_heads, head_dim]，来自不同样本的序列沿 token 维拼接。

The core mechanism relies on cumulative sequence length tracking, which marks the start and end positions of each individual sequence within the packed tensor. These parameters are propagated through the attention mechanism to Transformer Engine’s fused kernels, enabling efficient SDPA and RoPE operations that respect sequence boundaries. The attention computation uses cumulative sequence lengths to ensure queries and keys from different sequences do not attend to each other, maintaining correctness while eliminating padding overhead.

核心机制依赖累积序列长度（cumulative sequence length）跟踪，它标出每个独立序列在打包张量中的起止位置。这些参数一路传到注意力机制、再到 Transformer Engine 的融合 kernel，使 SDPA 与 RoPE 操作能在尊重序列边界的前提下高效执行。注意力计算利用累积序列长度，确保不同序列的 query 与 key 之间不会互相注意，在消除 padding 开销的同时保持正确性。

The implementation in Megatron-LM supports packed sequences across multiple training scenarios:

Megatron-LM 中的实现支持在多种训练场景下使用打包序列：

  • • Reinforcement Learning: Bin-packing algorithms group variable-length trajectories into fixed-size bins, maximizing GPU utilization.• 强化学习：用装箱（bin-packing）算法把变长轨迹归入固定大小的箱子，最大化 GPU 利用率。
  • • Multimodal Training: Vision-language models with variable image token counts use packed sequences to handle heterogeneous sequence lengths from different numbers of visual patches combined with text tokens.• 多模态训练：图像 token 数可变的视觉-语言模型用打包序列来处理异构的序列长度——不同数量的视觉 patch 与文本 token 组合在一起。
  • • Context Parallelism Integration: When Context Parallelism is enabled with padding requirements, the system automatically switches to THD format and provides both padded and unpadded cumulative lengths to handle communication alignment while preserving computational efficiency.• 与上下文并行集成：当 CP 开启且存在对齐要求时，系统自动切换到 THD 格式，并同时提供带 padding 与不带 padding 的累积长度，以便在保持计算效率的同时处理通信对齐。

The benefits of packed sequence support are particularly pronounced in long-context scenarios. For RL training with thinking models, where sequence lengths can vary from hundreds to tens of thousands of tokens, packed sequences can reduce memory usage by 40–60% and improve training throughput by 1.5–2×\times compared to traditional padding-based approaches. This efficiency gain becomes increasingly critical as context lengths extend beyond 32K tokens, where padding waste would otherwise dominate memory consumption and significantly reduce effective batch sizes.

打包序列支持在长上下文场景下收益尤为明显。对带思考过程（thinking）的模型做 RL 训练时，序列长度可能从数百到数万 token 不等，相比传统的 padding 方案，打包序列可降低 40–60% 的显存占用、提升 1.5–2× 的训练吞吐。当上下文长度超过 32K token 后，这项效率收益越发关键——否则 padding 浪费会主导显存消耗，显著压缩有效 batch 大小。

6.4.2.Dynamic Context Parallelism for Packed Sequences面向打包序列的动态上下文并行

While packed sequences in THD format remove padding waste, they do not eliminate computational imbalance across data-parallel (DP) ranks. Even when packed samples have identical total token counts, their attention workload can still vary substantially due to the quadratic complexity of dot-product attention with respect to sub-sequence lengths. For example, Figure 36 shows sequences packed to equal total lengths, yet as Figure 37 reveals, their compute workloads differ significantly.

THD 格式的打包序列消除了 padding 浪费，但并未消除数据并行（DP）rank 之间的计算不均衡。即便各打包样本的总 token 数完全相同，其注意力工作负载仍可能相差悬殊——因为点积注意力的复杂度相对于子序列长度是平方级的。例如图 36 中打包后总长度相等的几个序列，如图 37 所示，其计算量差异显著。

This DP imbalance leads to GPU idling at gradient synchronization points and can further amplify pipeline-parallel bubbles. Moreover, when Context Parallelism (CP) is enabled, a static CP size is typically chosen to satisfy the memory requirement of the longest packed sample in the batch. Consequently, shorter packed samples that would fit on fewer devices are still forced to use the same CP size, incurring unnecessary CP communication. In practice, CP communication is expected to be hidden by attention computation; however, under packed sequences that consist of many short sub-sequences, the compute per CP shard may become insufficient to hide CP collectives, especially when CP spans inter-node links. We refer to this effect as CP inefficiency.

这种 DP 不均衡会导致梯度同步点上 GPU 空转，还可能进一步放大流水并行的气泡。此外，启用上下文并行（CP）时，静态的 CP 规模通常按 batch 中「最长打包样本」的显存需求来确定。结果，那些本来用更少设备就够的较短打包样本也被迫使用同样的 CP 规模，白付了 CP 通信。实践中，CP 通信本应由注意力计算遮住；但当打包序列由大量短子序列组成时，每个 CP 分片上的计算量可能不足以遮住 CP 集合通信，尤其在 CP 跨越节点间链路时更明显。我们把这一效应称为 CP 低效（CP inefficiency）。

To address both DP imbalance and CP inefficiency, we introduce Dynamic Context Parallelism (Dynamic-CP) [49], which adaptively selects the effective CP size on a per-microbatch basis, jointly with the packing plan. The key observation is that resizing CP is comparatively lightweight: it only changes how token slices are partitioned and which CP communication group is used by attention operators, without requiring any parameter redistribution or optimizer-state migration. Therefore, Dynamic-CP provides a practical form of dynamic parallelism for variable-length training with minimal framework overhead. Related work, including ByteScale [28] and WLB-LLM [96], addresses similar load-balancing challenges.

为同时应对 DP 不均衡与 CP 低效，我们引入了动态上下文并行（Dynamic-CP）[49]：它以 micro-batch 为单位自适应地选择实际生效的 CP 规模，并与打包方案联合决定。关键观察是「调整 CP 规模」相对轻量——它只改变 token 切片如何划分、以及注意力算子使用哪个 CP 通信组，不涉及任何参数重分布或优化器状态迁移。因此 Dynamic-CP 为变长训练提供了一种框架开销极小的动态并行形式。相关工作如 ByteScale [28] 与 WLB-LLM [96] 也处理了类似的负载均衡问题。

For example, consider the case in Figure 38(a) with three sequences. We assume only two GPUs are available. If we adopt the standard CP2 configuration (i.e., DP=1, CP=2), the workload is executed in two micro-batches as illustrated in Figure 38(b). In microbatch-0, the orange sequence is sufficiently long that it must be partitioned across the two GPUs. In microbatch-1, the packed blue and green sequences are also partitioned across the two GPUs. However, this introduces an unnecessary split for the blue and green sequences, since both sequences can fit on a single GPU without partitioning.

以图 38(a) 中三条序列的情形为例，假设只有两张 GPU 可用。如果采用标准的 CP2 配置（即 DP=1、CP=2），工作负载会按图 38(b) 那样分成两个 micro-batch 执行。在 micro-batch-0 中，橙色序列足够长，必须在两张 GPU 上切分；在 micro-batch-1 中，打包在一起的蓝色与绿色序列同样被切分到两张 GPU 上。但这对蓝绿两条序列来说是不必要的切分——它们各自都能完整放进一张 GPU，根本不需要分区。

As shown in Figure 38(c), with Dynamic-CP, the orange sequence in microbatch-0 still requires CP=2. In microbatch-1, we no longer need to split the blue and green sequences; instead, we let each of them run with CP=1 independently.

如图 38(c) 所示，采用 Dynamic-CP 后，micro-batch-0 里的橙色序列仍需要 CP=2；而在 micro-batch-1 里，我们不再切分蓝色与绿色序列，而是让它们各自以 CP=1 独立运行。

To make per-microbatch CP resizing practical in Megatron-Core, Dynamic-CP avoids any expensive redistribution of model states. Instead, it treats CP resizing as a lightweight runtime choice: changing only how token slices are partitioned and which CP communication group is used by attention operators. Concretely, rather than binding each rank to a single statically constructed cp_group, the framework pre-constructs multiple CP groups per rank during initialization, with candidate cp_size ranging from 1 up to dp×\timescp (restricted to powers of two). At runtime, the scheduler selects the effective cp_size for each microbatch and the corresponding pre-built cp_group, enabling Dynamic-CP without incurring the overhead of dynamically creating communication groups.

要让「按 micro-batch 调整 CP 规模」在 Megatron-Core 中真正可用，Dynamic-CP 必须避免任何昂贵的模型状态重分布。它把 CP 规模调整当作一个轻量的运行时选择：只改 token 切片的划分方式、以及注意力算子使用哪个 CP 通信组。具体做法是，框架不再把每个 rank 绑定到唯一一个静态构造的 cp_group，而是在初始化时为每个 rank 预先构造多个 CP 组，候选 cp_size 从 1 一直到 dp×cp（限取 2 的幂）。运行时，调度器为每个 micro-batch 选出实际生效的 cp_size 及对应的预建 cp_group，从而在不必动态创建通信组的前提下实现 Dynamic-CP。

Dynamic-CP is designed for the THD layout, where variable-length sequences are packed under a length constraint and the original batch/sequence dimensions collapse into a token dimension. A direct consequence is that the number of microbatches is no longer a fixed quantity derived from global_batch_size and micro_batch_size; it can vary across iterations because the number of original sequences packed into each microbatch is not constant. To minimize invasive changes to existing Megatron-Core pipeline schedulers, Dynamic-CP introduces a lightweight data_iterator_wrapper around the original data_iterator. For each global batch, the wrapper (i) reschedules and packs sequences to create balanced workloads across DP ranks, (ii) chooses an effective cp_size for each microbatch to avoid over-sharding short packed samples, and (iii) returns the effective num_microbatches for the current iteration. Because only a subset of ranks typically drives scheduling decisions under PP/VPP, the framework broadcasts the dynamic scheduling metadata (including num_microbatches, max_seqlen, and cu_seqlens) to ensure consistent execution across pipeline stages. Furthermore, PackedSeqParams is extended to carry both the selected cp_size and cp_group; all CP-dependent components (e.g., position embedding and attention) retrieve CP configuration from PackedSeqParams rather than relying on globally static CP variables.

Dynamic-CP 是为 THD 布局设计的——其中变长序列在长度约束下被打包，原本的 batch/sequence 维度塌缩成一个 token 维。一个直接后果是：micro-batch 的数量不再是由 global_batch_size 与 micro_batch_size 推出的固定值，而会随迭代变化，因为每个 micro-batch 里打包进去的原始序列条数并不固定。为把对现有 Megatron-Core 流水线调度器的侵入性改动降到最小，Dynamic-CP 在原有 data_iterator 外面套了一层轻量的 data_iterator_wrapper。对于每个 global batch，这层包装器会（i）重新调度并打包序列，使各 DP rank 的负载均衡；（ii）为每个 micro-batch 选择实际生效的 cp_size，避免把较短的打包样本过度切分；（iii）返回当前迭代实际生效的 num_microbatches。由于在 PP/VPP 下通常只有部分 rank 参与调度决策，框架会把这套动态调度元数据（包括 num_microbatches、max_seqlen 与 cu_seqlens）广播出去，保证各流水线阶段执行一致。此外，PackedSeqParams 被扩展为同时携带选定的 cp_size 与 cp_group；所有依赖 CP 的组件（如位置编码与注意力）都从 PackedSeqParams 取 CP 配置，而不再依赖全局静态的 CP 变量。

Given variable-length sequences in THD, different samples contribute different numbers of valid tokens. Therefore, loss is computed on a per-token basis to avoid bias from padding:

THD 中的变长序列意味着不同样本贡献的有效 token 数不同。因此损失按 token 逐个计算，以避免 padding 带来的偏差：

ℒ=∑t∈𝒱ℓt|𝒱|,\mathcal{L}=\frac{\sum_{t\in\mathcal{V}}\ell_{t}}{|\mathcal{V}|},

where 𝒱\mathcal{V} denotes the set of valid (non-padding) tokens in the packed representation. On the planning side, the Dynamic-CP solver jointly determines packing and per-microbatch CP sizes under GPU memory constraints. Since attention compute scales roughly as 𝒪⁡(S2)\mathcal{O}(S^{2}) with respect to sub-sequence lengths while activation memory scales closer to 𝒪⁡(S)\mathcal{O}(S), it is difficult to simultaneously balance compute and memory. Dynamic-CP therefore alternates between workload-oriented and memory-oriented decisions: microbatches whose estimated workload exceeds a target quota are assigned larger cp_size to reduce per-rank compute, after which memory becomes the dominant constraint and remaining capacity is filled by selecting less compute-heavy samples while preserving feasibility.

其中 𝒱 表示打包表示中有效（非 padding）token 的集合。在规划侧，Dynamic-CP 的求解器在 GPU 显存约束下联合确定打包方案与各 micro-batch 的 CP 规模。由于注意力计算量相对于子序列长度大致按 O(S2) 增长，而激活显存更接近 O(S)，要同时均衡「计算」与「显存」并不容易。因此 Dynamic-CP 在「面向工作负载」与「面向显存」两类决策之间交替：估计工作负载超过目标配额的 micro-batch 会被分配更大的 cp_size 以降低单 rank 计算量；此后显存成为主导约束，剩余容量则通过挑选计算较轻的样本来填满，同时保持可行性。

Finally, Dynamic-CP is engineered to keep runtime overhead negligible. Constructing a plan requires an additional pass over the global batch to probe lightweight shape and sequence-length metadata; this I/O pressure is mitigated by distributing the probing across the cluster and gathering only compact metadata. The solver itself runs asynchronously (e.g., within the data_sampler) to overlap with training iterations. To keep the search space manageable, exhaustive search is replaced by a one-dimensional grid search over the microbatch count, constrained so that all DP ranks use the same num_microbatches. This count is swept from PP×\times1 up to a small multiple of PP, capturing the trade-off between per-microbatch workload and pipeline bubbles; in practice, the search can be further narrowed by selecting the “knee” point on the workload-versus-microbatch curve and exploring only its neighborhood.

最后，Dynamic-CP 在工程上力求让运行时开销可以忽略。构造一份计划需要对 global batch 额外扫描一趟，以探测轻量的形状与序列长度元数据；这份 I/O 压力通过把探测分散到整个集群、只汇总紧凑元数据来缓解。求解器本身异步运行（例如在 data_sampler 内），与训练迭代重叠。为把搜索空间控制在可处理的规模，穷举搜索被替换为对 micro-batch 数量的一维网格搜索，并约束所有 DP rank 使用相同的 num_microbatches。该数量从 PP×1 扫到 PP 的若干倍，以捕捉「单 micro-batch 工作量」与「流水线气泡」之间的权衡；实践中还可以进一步收窄——先在「工作量- micro-batch 数」曲线上找出拐点，再只探索其邻域。

Overall, Dynamic-CP complements packed sequence training by (i) reducing synchronization stalls caused by DP imbalance and (ii) preventing unnecessary CP communication for microbatches that do not benefit from large CP sizes, thereby improving throughput in long-context variable-length training. According to the benchmark, Dynamic-CP yields a 35--60% end-to-end performance improvement in real-world scenarios with highly imbalanced sequence length distributions, such as multi-modal training. 44 4 Explore PR#2000 and PR#2959 to start training models with variable-length sequences using Megatron-Core optimizations.

总体来看，Dynamic-CP 从两方面补足了打包序列训练：（i）减少 DP 不均衡造成的同步停顿；（ii）避免为那些并不能从大 CP 规模中获益的 micro-batch 白付 CP 通信。由此提升长上下文变长训练的吞吐。根据基准测试，在序列长度分布高度不均衡的真实场景（如多模态训练）中，Dynamic-CP 带来 35–60% 的端到端性能提升。（⁴ 想用 Megatron-Core 的优化在变长序列上开始训练模型，可从 PR#2000 与 PR#2959 入手。）

6.5.Summary小结

Long-context MoE training represents a distinct optimization regime where the fundamental assumptions of Section 4 must be revisited. While the Three Walls (memory, communication, and compute efficiency) remain the fundamental barriers, their relative importance shifts substantially as sequence length increases:

长上下文 MoE 训练是一个独特的优化区间，第 4 章的基本假设必须重新审视。三堵墙（显存、通信与计算效率）仍然是根本障碍，但随着序列长度增加，它们的相对重要性发生了实质变化：

  • • Computational Shift: Attention’s O⁡(s2)O(s^{2}) complexity displaces MoE layers as the dominant computational bottleneck, consuming >> 69% of FLOPs at >> 64K tokens. The MoE-focused optimizations of Section 4.3 remain valuable but no longer address the primary bottleneck.• 计算重心转移：注意力 O(s2) 的复杂度取代 MoE 层成为主导计算瓶颈，在超过 64K token 时吃掉 > 69% 的 FLOPs。第 4.3 节那些聚焦 MoE 的优化依然有价值，但已不再是主要瓶颈所在。
  • • Memory Wall Intensified: Activation memory scales with sequence length, requiring the parallelism strategies from Section 3 (specifically CP and TP) combined with the memory techniques from Section 4.1 (recomputation, offloading) to maintain feasible memory footprints.• 显存墙加剧：激活显存随序列长度增长，需要把第 3 章的并行策略（具体是 CP 与 TP）与第 4.1 节的显存技术（重计算、offload）结合使用，才能把显存占用维持在可行范围。
  • • Communication Trade-offs: The choice between CP and TP involves nuanced trade-offs between communication overhead, memory savings, and SDPA computational efficiency, a balance distinct from the MoE-centric all-to-all optimization focus of Section 4.2.• 通信取舍变化：CP 与 TP 之间的选择，涉及通信开销、显存节省与 SDPA 计算效率之间的微妙权衡——这与第 4.2 节以 MoE 为中心、聚焦 all-to-all 优化的视角完全不同。

By combining context parallelism, tensor parallelism, selective recomputation, and optimizer offloading, Megatron-Core enables efficient training across diverse sequence lengths. Our experiments on 256 Hopper GPUs at 256K sequence length demonstrate this: DeepSeek-V3 achieves 88% of its short-context MFU using TP, optimizer CPU offloading, and selective recomputation, while Qwen3-235B-A22B reaches 129% of its short-context MFU with TP, CP, and selective recomputation (the latter exceeding 100% because SDPA kernels are highly efficient when dominating the computation at longer sequences). The packed sequence and Dynamic-CP features further extend these capabilities to variable-length workloads in RL and SFT training.

把上下文并行、张量并行、选择性重计算与优化器 offload 组合起来，Megatron-Core 就能在多种序列长度上高效训练。我们在 256 张 Hopper GPU、256K 序列长度上的实验说明了这一点：DeepSeek-V3 借助 TP、优化器 CPU offload 与选择性重计算，达到其短上下文 MFU 的 88%；Qwen3-235B-A22B 借助 TP、CP 与选择性重计算，达到短上下文 MFU 的 129%（之所以超过 100%，是因为序列变长后 SDPA 主导计算，而 SDPA kernel 本身极为高效）。打包序列与 Dynamic-CP 两项特性则把这些能力进一步延伸到 RL 与 SFT 训练中的变长工作负载。

7.Production Features生产级特性

The previous sections focused on performance optimizations that address the Three Walls. However, production MoE training also requires robustness, flexibility, and ease of use. This section describes features that address these operational requirements: load balancing to ensure stable training, shared and latent expert architectures, distributed checkpointing for flexible deployment, upcycling to use existing dense models, and integration with advanced training paradigms like multi-token prediction.

前面各章聚焦于应对三堵墙的性能优化。但生产环境的 MoE 训练还需要健壮性、灵活性与易用性。本章介绍满足这些运维需求的特性：负载均衡以保证训练稳定、共享专家与隐专家（latent expert）架构、支持灵活部署的分布式 checkpoint、复用现有稠密模型的 upcycling，以及与多 Token 预测等前沿训练范式的集成。

7.1.Load Balancing and Token Dropping负载均衡与 Token 丢弃

Dynamic routing in MoE models can lead to significant workload imbalance, where certain experts receive disproportionately more tokens than others. This causes computational inefficiency, memory bottlenecks, and degraded hardware utilization. We address these challenges with two coordinated mechanisms: load balancing and token dropping.

MoE 模型中的动态路由可能导致显著的工作负载不均——某些专家收到的 token 远多于其他专家。这会造成计算低效、显存瓶颈与硬件利用率下降。我们用两个协同的机制来应对：负载均衡与 token 丢弃。

Load Balancing. Figure 39 illustrates the load balancing strategies available in Megatron-Core MoE. We provide multiple strategies to encourage uniform token distribution. The primary approach employs an auxiliary loss [47, 25], a differentiable penalty term that discourages routing all tokens to a small subset of experts. We also support expert choice routing [102], which formulates balanced routing as an optimal transport problem, and auxiliary-loss-free balancing via learnable expert bias terms [94] that dynamically adjust routing decisions based on historical load.

负载均衡。 图 39 展示了 Megatron-Core MoE 中可用的负载均衡策略。我们提供多种策略来促成 token 的均匀分布。主要做法是采用辅助损失 [47, 25]——一个可微的惩罚项，抑制「把所有 token 都路由给一小撮专家」的倾向。我们也支持专家选择路由（expert choice routing）[102]，它把均衡路由表述为一个最优传输问题；以及基于可学习专家偏置项的无辅助损失均衡 [94]，它依据历史负载动态调整路由决策。

Token Dropping. We support two dispatch strategies with different capacity management policies. In dropless mode (the default), all routed tokens are processed without capacity constraints, maximizing model expressiveness at the cost of variable per-expert workload. In droppable mode, explicit expert capacity limits are enforced [47, 25]: when tokens assigned to an expert exceed its capacity, excess tokens are dropped and bypassed through residual connections. This provides predictable memory bounds, useful during early training when the router is poorly initialized.

Token 丢弃。 我们支持两种容量管理策略不同的派发方式。在 dropless 模式（默认）下，所有被路由的 token 都被处理，不受容量约束——模型表达能力最大化，代价是每专家工作量可变。在 droppable 模式下，会强制执行显式的专家容量上限 [47, 25]：当分配给某专家的 token 超出其容量时，多余的 token 被丢弃，并通过残差连接旁路过去。这提供了可预期的显存上界，在 router 初始化不佳的训练早期很有用。

Pad-to-Max for Static Shapes. Droppable mode also enables pad-to-max functionality, which pads all expert inputs to the same capacity limit. This converts MoE’s inherently dynamic per-expert token counts into static shapes, enabling optimizations like CUDA Graphs (Section 4.3.6) that require fixed tensor dimensions across iterations.

为静态形状做 pad-to-max。 droppable 模式还启用了 pad-to-max 功能：把所有专家的输入都 padding 到同一容量上限。这把 MoE 天生动态的「每专家 token 数」转成了静态形状，从而可以使用 CUDA Graphs（第 4.3.6 节）这类要求跨迭代张量维度固定的优化。

7.2.Shared Experts共享专家

Some MoE architectures (DeepSeek-V2/V3 [18, 19], Qwen [73]) include a shared expert that processes all tokens regardless of routing, providing consistent baseline capacity across all tokens (figure 40). When overlap is enabled (--moe-shared-expert-overlap), shared expert computation runs in parallel with the all-to-all communication and routed expert computation, hiding its latency behind the dispatch-compute-combine pipeline.

有些 MoE 架构（DeepSeek-V2/V3 [18, 19]、Qwen [73]）包含一个共享专家，它不论路由结果如何都处理所有 token，从而为每个 token 提供一致的基线容量（图 40）。开启重叠（--moe-shared-expert-overlap）后，共享专家的计算与 all-to-all 通信、被路由专家的计算并行执行，把它的延迟藏进 dispatch-compute-combine 流水线里。

7.3.Latent MoE隐空间 MoE（Latent MoE）

In standard MoE, all2all communication dispatches tokens at the full hidden dimension dd, and each expert is parameterized by weight matrices in ℝm×d\mathbb{R}^{m\times d} and ℝd×m\mathbb{R}^{d\times m}. LatentMoE [23] reduces both costs by inserting a shared down-projection W↓∈ℝℓ×dW_{\downarrow}\in\mathbb{R}^{\ell\times d} before dispatch and an up-projection W↑∈ℝd×ℓW_{\uparrow}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times\ell} after combine, where ℓ<d\ell<d is the latent dimension. Routing still operates on the full hidden dimension to preserve routing quality; each routed expert operates entirely in the compressed latent space; shared experts remain at dimension dd. The layer output becomes:

在标准 MoE 中，all2all 通信按完整的隐藏维 d 派发 token，每个专家由 ℝm×d 与 ℝd×m 的权重矩阵参数化。LatentMoE [23] 通过在 dispatch 之前插入一个共享的降维投影 W↓∈ℝℓ×d、在 combine 之后插入一个升维投影 W↑∈ℝd×ℓ（其中 ℓ<d 为隐维），把这两项开销同时降下来。路由仍在完整隐藏维上进行，以保证路由质量；每个被路由专家完全在压缩后的隐空间内运算；共享专家则保持 d 维。该层的输出变为：

output​(𝐱)=W↑⋅(∑i∈𝒯K,Epi​Ei​(W↓⋅𝐱,ℓ))+∑jEjshared​(𝐱,d).\text{output}(\mathbf{x})=W_{\uparrow}\cdot\Bigl(\sum_{i\in\mathcal{T}_{K,E}}p_{i}\,E_{i}(W_{\downarrow}\cdot\mathbf{x};\,\ell)\Bigr)+\sum_{j}E_{j}^{\text{shared}}(\mathbf{x};\,d).

The compression ratio α=d/ℓ\alpha=d/\ell reduces all2all communication volume by a factor of α\alpha (tokens are dispatched at dimension ℓ\ell instead of dd) and per-expert weight size by the same factor (expert matrices shrink from ℝm×d\mathbb{R}^{m\times d} to ℝm×ℓ\mathbb{R}^{m\times\ell}). Elango et al. [23] define two ways to exploit these savings. In ℓ​-MoEeff\ell\text{-MoE}_{\text{eff}}, the total expert count EE is scaled by α\alpha while top-KK is unchanged, preserving baseline accuracy at reduced inference cost. In ℓ​-MoEacc\ell\text{-MoE}_{\text{acc}} (recommended), both EE and top-KK are scaled by α\alpha, which restores inference cost to the standard-MoE level but exponentially expands the combinatorial space of expert selections ((α​Eα​K)≥(EK)α\binom{\alpha E}{\alpha K}\geq\binom{E}{K}^{\alpha}), yielding higher accuracy at iso-cost. At scales up to 95B parameters, ℓ​-MoEacc\ell\text{-MoE}_{\text{acc}} consistently outperforms standard MoE in accuracy per FLOP and per parameter. The architecture has been adopted by NVIDIA’s Nemotron-3 Super and Ultra models.

压缩比 α=d/ℓ 使 all2all 通信量降为原来的 1/α（token 按 ℓ 维而非 d 维派发），同时把每个专家的权重规模也按同比例缩小（专家矩阵从 ℝm×d 缩为 ℝm×ℓ）。Elango 等人 [23] 定义了利用这份节省的两种方式。在 ℓ-MoEeff 中，专家总数 E 按 α 放大而 top-K 不变，在降低推理成本的同时保持基线精度。在 ℓ-MoEacc（推荐）中，E 与 top-K 都按 α 放大，推理成本回到标准 MoE 的水平，但专家选择的组合空间呈指数级扩张（C(αE, αK)≥C(E, K)α），从而在同成本下取得更高精度。在最高 95B 参数的规模上，ℓ-MoEacc 在「每 FLOP 精度」与「每参数精度」上始终优于标准 MoE。该架构已被 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-3 Super 与 Ultra 模型采用。

Implementation. LatentMoE is enabled via --moe-latent-size, which sets ℓ\ell. The MoELayer instantiates two TELinear projections: fc1_latent_proj (down-projection in the preprocess step, after routing but before dispatch) and fc2_latent_proj (up-projection in the postprocess step, after combine). Expert backends (TEGroupedMLP, SequentialMLP) automatically adapt their input and output dimensions to ℓ\ell.

实现。 LatentMoE 通过 --moe-latent-size 启用，该参数即设定 ℓ。MoELayer 会实例化两个 TELinear 投影：fc1_latent_proj（降维投影，位于 preprocess 步骤中，在路由之后、dispatch 之前）与 fc2_latent_proj（升维投影，位于 postprocess 步骤中，在 combine 之后）。专家后端（TEGroupedMLP、SequentialMLP）会自动把输入输出维度适配到 ℓ。

7.4.Distributed Checkpoint分布式 Checkpoint

Traditional checkpointing tightly couples saved model state with the specific parallelism configuration, requiring complex offline conversion when changing TP, EP, PP, or other parallelism settings. Our distributed checkpoint library solves this through parallelism-agnostic checkpointing with automatic resharding.

传统 checkpointing 把保存下来的模型状态与特定的并行配置紧紧绑在一起，一旦改动 TP、EP、PP 或其他并行设置，就需要做复杂的离线转换。我们的分布式 checkpoint 库通过「与并行方式无关」的 checkpointing 加自动重分片（automatic resharding）解决了这个问题。

The core abstraction is the ShardedTensor descriptor, which encodes each local tensor’s global shape, offset, and sharding pattern. During saving, each rank independently writes its local shard (Fully Parallel Saving), eliminating coordinator bottlenecks. During loading, each rank determines which portions of global tensors it needs based on the new sharding specification and reads only those slices.

核心抽象是 ShardedTensor 描述符，它编码了每个本地张量的全局形状、偏移与分片模式。保存时，各 rank 各自独立写出自己的本地分片（Fully Parallel Saving），消除了协调者瓶颈。加载时，各 rank 依据新的分片规格确定自己需要全局张量的哪些部分，只读回那些切片。

This enables any-to-any parallelism reconfiguration: a checkpoint saved with TP=2\text{TP}=2, EP=4\text{EP}=4 can be loaded with TP=4\text{TP}=4, EP=8\text{EP}=8 without offline conversion. The library supports Zarr (default) and PyTorch Distributed [101] storage backends.

由此实现了任意并行的重新配置：一个以 TP=2、EP=4 保存的 checkpoint，可以直接以 TP=4、EP=8 加载，无需离线转换。该库支持 Zarr（默认）与 PyTorch Distributed [101] 两种存储后端。

7.5.Flexible Asymmetric Virtual Pipeline Parallelism灵活的非对称虚拟流水并行

Interleaved pipeline parallelism [62] divides each physical pipeline stage into multiple virtual stages with interleaved scheduling, mitigating pipeline bubbles. Traditional VPP requires uniform layer distribution (e.g., a 24-layer model with PP=4\text{PP}=4, VPP=2\text{VPP}=2 distributes layers as [6,6,6,6][6,6,6,6]). However, MoE models exhibit substantial workload heterogeneity: MoE layers, dense layers, embedding, loss, and specialized layers like MTP have significantly different computational costs.

交错流水并行 [62] 把每个物理流水阶段拆成多个虚拟阶段、以交错方式调度，从而缓解流水线气泡。传统 VPP 要求层分布均匀（例如 24 层模型在 PP=4、VPP=2 下按 [6,6,6,6] 分配）。然而 MoE 模型的工作负载存在显著异构性：MoE 层、稠密层、embedding、loss，以及 MTP 这类特殊层，计算成本差别很大。

We introduce Flexible Asymmetric VPP, which allows different numbers and types of layers per virtual stage. Consider DeepSeek-V3 with 61 decoder layers and 1 MTP layer at PP=16\text{PP}=16, VPP=2\text{VPP}=2 (Table 10). The initial rank combines the lightweight embedding with 3 dense decoders (matching the cost of 2 MoE layers). Most ranks hold 2 MoE decoders per stage. The final ranks strategically place the heavy MTP layer and lightweight loss layer to balance workload.

我们引入了灵活非对称 VPP（Flexible Asymmetric VPP），允许各虚拟阶段包含不同数量、不同类型的层。以 DeepSeek-V3 为例，它有 61 个 decoder 层加 1 个 MTP 层，取 PP=16、VPP=2（表 10）：起始 rank 把轻量的 embedding 与 3 个稠密 decoder 组合在一起（相当于 2 个 MoE 层的开销）；多数 rank 每个阶段放 2 个 MoE decoder；末尾若干 rank 则策略性地安置沉重的 MTP 层与轻量的 loss 层，以平衡负载。

This approach enables VPP for models with arbitrary layer counts, achieves true load balancing by accounting for per-layer computational costs, and provides flexible placement for specialized layers.

这一做法使任意层数的模型都能用上 VPP，通过计入逐层计算成本实现真正的负载均衡，并为特殊层提供灵活的安置方式。

This flexible asymmetric approach (figure 41) delivers several key advantages: (1) it enables VPP for models with arbitrary layer counts and compositions, removing artificial constraints on model architecture design; (2) it achieves true computational load balancing by allowing fine-grained control over layer distribution, accounting for the vast differences in computational cost between layer types; and (3) it provides flexible placement strategies for specialized layers (MTP, encoder-decoder structures, etc.), enabling diverse model architectures to fully exploit the latency-hiding benefits of pipeline parallelism. Practitioners can design layouts that distribute computationally expensive layers across ranks to avoid memory pressure and minimize pipeline bubbles.

这种灵活非对称的做法（图 41）带来几项关键优势：（1）让任意层数与任意层组成的模型都能用 VPP，解除了对模型架构设计的人为约束；（2）通过细粒度控制层分布、计入不同层类型之间巨大的计算成本差异，实现真正的计算负载均衡；（3）为特殊层（MTP、encoder-decoder 结构等）提供灵活的安置策略，使多样的模型架构都能充分享受流水并行的延迟隐藏收益。实践者可以设计布局，把计算昂贵的层分散到不同 rank 上，以避免显存压力、减少流水线气泡。

7.6.UpcyclingUpcycling

Upcycling converts a pre-trained dense model into a sparse MoE architecture, expanding model capacity without retraining from scratch [41, 32, 91]. We support virtual group initialization and expert weight scaling to enable seamless adaptation of dense checkpoints into fine-grained MoE models. The approach employs softmax-then-topK routing, which routes tokens through a selective subset of experts for increased expressivity at constant or reduced inference cost, as illustrated in figure 42.

Upcycling 把一个预训练好的稠密模型转换成稀疏 MoE 架构，从而在不从头重训的前提下扩充模型容量 [41, 32, 91]。我们支持虚拟组初始化与专家权重缩放，使稠密 checkpoint 能平滑适配成细粒度 MoE 模型。该方法采用 softmax-then-topK 路由——token 只流经一个选中的专家子集，从而在推理成本不变甚至更低的情况下提升表达能力，如图 42 所示。

7.7.Multi-Token Prediction多 Token 预测

Multi-token prediction (MTP) optimizes a model to predict multiple consecutive future tokens at each position, densifying the supervision signal [29, 19]. Unlike parallel independent predictions, MTP maintains causal dependencies between predictions through hidden state transitions, accelerating convergence and improving generation quality. During inference, the model reverts to standard single-token prediction for deployment compatibility.

多 Token 预测（MTP）让模型在每个位置同时预测后续多个 token，从而加密监督信号 [29, 19]。与并行独立的预测不同，MTP 通过隐状态转移维持各预测之间的因果依赖，加速收敛并提升生成质量。推理时，模型会退回标准的单 token 预测，以保持部署兼容性。

We integrate MTP with flexible pipeline parallelism, allowing MTP layers to be placed strategically within the VPP layout for balanced workload distribution.

我们把 MTP 与灵活流水并行集成，允许在 VPP 布局中策略性地安置 MTP 层，以实现均衡的工作负载分布。

7.8.Muon OptimizerMuon 优化器

Unlike traditional optimizers such as AdamW that perform element-wise updates, the Muon optimizer introduces a matrix-aware approach by orthogonalizing entire weight matrices [54]. This improves the conditioning of optimization trajectories and significantly reduces training steps compared to AdamW.

与 AdamW 这类逐元素更新的传统优化器不同，Muon 优化器引入了「矩阵感知」的思路——对整个权重矩阵做正交化 [54]。这改善了优化轨迹的条件数，相比 AdamW 显著减少训练步数。

Our integration provides production-ready support for large-scale distributed training with several key advantages: (1) full support for split query-key-value (QKV) weight layouts, enabling efficient orthogonalization even when attention projection matrices are stored as separate tensors; (2) seamless integration with the distributed optimizer, allowing optimizer states to be sharded across data-parallel ranks while maintaining correct orthogonalization semantics; and (3) CPU offloading for Muon’s orthogonalization buffers when GPU memory is constrained.

我们的集成提供了面向大规模分布式训练的生产级支持，有几项关键优势：（1）完整支持分离式 query-key-value（QKV）权重布局，即便注意力投影矩阵以独立张量存储，也能高效正交化；（2）与分布式优化器无缝集成，优化器状态可以分片到各数据并行 rank 上，同时保持正确的正交化语义；（3）GPU 显存紧张时，Muon 的正交化缓冲可以 CPU offload。

MuonClip. Training trillion-parameter models introduces stability challenges where query-key dot products can grow unbounded, causing attention explosions [87]. MuonClip addresses this with hardware-accelerated implementations in cuDNN, cudnn-frontend, and Transformer Engine.

MuonClip。 训练万亿参数模型会带来稳定性挑战：query-key 点积可能无界增长，导致注意力爆炸（attention explosion）[87]。MuonClip 通过在 cuDNN、cudnn-frontend 与 Transformer Engine 中提供硬件加速实现来应对这一问题。

8.Performance Evaluation性能评测

The preceding sections described Megatron-Core MoE’s architecture, parallelism strategies, and optimizations. This section validates these contributions through empirical evaluation, showing the performance of the Megatron-Core MoE stack across diverse model configurations and hardware platforms.

前面各章介绍了 Megatron-Core MoE 的架构、并行策略与优化。本章用实测评测来验证这些贡献，展示 Megatron-Core MoE 技术栈在多种模型配置与硬件平台上的性能表现。

Note Living Document. The performance results in this section represent a point-in-time snapshot based on Megatron-Core v0.16, not the upper bound of achievable performance. Active optimization efforts are ongoing, and these numbers will improve in future releases. We also plan to expand coverage to additional model architectures as they emerge in the community. For the latest performance data, please refer to the Megatron-LM and Megatron-Bridge repository.

注意 本文为动态文档（Living Document）。本节的性能数据是基於 Megatron-Core v0.16 的时点快照，并非可达性能的上界。优化工作仍在持续推进，这些数字会随版本更新而改善。我们也计划在社区出现新的模型架构时扩大覆盖范围。最新性能数据请参阅 Megatron-LM 与 Megatron-Bridge 仓库。

8.1.Experimental Setup实验设置

Benchmark Models. We evaluate Megatron-Core MoE on two state-of-the-art fine-grained MoE architectures that stress-test the framework’s capabilities: DeepSeek-V3-685B [19] and Qwen3-235B [73, 98]. Both models feature the fine-grained expert design that amplifies the Three Walls challenges: high expert counts strain memory capacity, top-k routing increases all-to-all communication volume, and smaller per-expert computations reduce GEMM efficiency. These characteristics make them demanding benchmarks for validating our optimization strategies.

基准模型。 我们在两个最先进的细粒度 MoE 架构上评测 Megatron-Core MoE，它们能对框架能力形成压力测试：DeepSeek-V3-685B [19] 与 Qwen3-235B [73, 98]。两个模型都采用细粒度专家设计，这会放大三堵墙的挑战：专家数量多，压迫显存容量；top-k 路由增大 all-to-all 通信量；每专家的计算更小，降低 GEMM 效率。这些特点使它们成为验证我们优化策略的高难度基准。

Hardware and Software Stack. Benchmarks are conducted on NVIDIA GB200 and H100 GPUs to assess performance across hardware generations. We use the dev branch of Megatron-LM55 5 https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/tree/dev with the latest TransformerEngine66 6 https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/tree/main. The full optimization stack described in Section 4 is enabled, including but not limited to:

硬件与软件栈。 基准在 NVIDIA GB200 与 H100 GPU 上运行，以评估跨硬件代际的性能。我们使用 Megatron-LM 的 dev 分支（⁵ https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/tree/dev ）以及最新的 TransformerEngine（⁶ https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/tree/main ）。第 4 章描述的完整优化栈均已启用，包括但不限于：

  • • Optimized token dispatchers: HybridEP77 7 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/tree/hybrid-ep on GB200/GB300 NVL systems exploiting Multi-Node NVLink, and DeepEP88 8 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/tree/main on H100 systems• 优化后的 token dispatcher：在 GB200/GB300 NVL 系统上使用 HybridEP（⁷ https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/tree/hybrid-ep ），以利用多节点 NVLink；在 H100 系统上使用 DeepEP（⁸ https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP/tree/main ）

  • • Kernel optimizations: Grouped GEMM, router fusion, permutation fusion, and CUDA Graphs• Kernel 优化：Grouped GEMM、router 融合、permutation 融合与 CUDA Graphs

Metrics. We report per-GPU throughput in TFLOPS and tokens processed per second per GPU. These metrics provide two views of computational efficiency and practical training throughput.

指标。 我们报告每 GPU 的吞吐（TFLOPS）与每 GPU 每秒处理的 token 数。这两个指标分别从计算效率与实际训练吞吐两个视角刻画性能。
