9.Performance Best Practices性能最佳实践

Sections 3–7 presented a comprehensive optimization arsenal for MoE training: parallel folding, optimized dispatchers, Grouped GEMM, reduced-precision training, CUDA Graphs, and more. However, having many optimization techniques does not automatically translate into high performance. Each technique addresses specific bottlenecks but introduces its own trade-offs. Reduced-precision training reduces memory but requires careful precision management. Communication overlap improves throughput but adds memory overhead. CUDA Graphs eliminate host latency but conflict with dynamic tensor shapes. The challenge is not the availability of optimizations; it is knowing which optimizations to apply, when to apply them, and how they interact with each other.

第 3–7 章给出了 MoE 训练的整套优化军火库：parallel folding、优化后的 dispatcher、Grouped GEMM、低精度训练、CUDA Graphs 等等。然而，手里有大量优化技术，并不自动等于高性能。每项技术都针对特定瓶颈，也各自带来取舍：低精度训练降低显存但需要精细的精度管理；通信重叠提升吞吐却增加显存开销；CUDA Graphs 消除主机延迟，却与动态张量形状冲突。真正的难点不是「有没有优化可用」，而是知道该用哪些、什么时候用、以及它们之间如何相互作用。

This complexity means that achieving peak performance requires a systematic methodology, not trial-and-error tuning. Through optimization of diverse MoE models (from Mixtral to DeepSeek-V3) on GB200 and H100, we developed a repeatable workflow for identifying bottlenecks and applying targeted solutions. This section distills those lessons into actionable guidance. Section 9.1 presents the methodology under the Three Walls framework with concrete examples for each phase. Section 9.2 then shows how these principles combine for DeepSeek-V3 on GB200 and H100, including why the same model requires different strategies on different hardware.

这种复杂性意味着达到峰值性能需要一套系统性的方法论，而不是反复试错地调参。通过在 GB200 与 H100 上对多种 MoE 模型（从 Mixtral 到 DeepSeek-V3）做优化，我们总结出一套可复现的工作流：先定位瓶颈，再施加针对性的解法。本章把这些经验提炼成可操作的指引。第 9.1 节以三堵墙为框架给出方法论，并为每个阶段配上具体例子；第 9.2 节展示这些原则如何组合起来服务于 GB200 与 H100 上的 DeepSeek-V3，包括同一个模型为何在不同硬件上需要不同策略。

9.1.A Systematic Optimization Workflow系统化的优化工作流

We present a three-phase workflow for MoE performance optimization. This methodology emerged from tuning Mixtral, DeepSeek-V3, and Qwen3 across GB200 and H100 platforms. The process is inherently iterative: solving one bottleneck often exposes the next, requiring continuous profiling and refinement.

我们给出一套三阶段的 MoE 性能优化工作流。这套方法论来自在 GB200 与 H100 平台上调优 Mixtral、DeepSeek-V3 与 Qwen3 的实践。整个过程本质上是迭代的：解决掉一个瓶颈，往往就暴露出下一个，因此需要持续地 profile 与打磨。

9.1.1.Phase 1: Establish Memory-Feasible Parallelism阶段一：先让并行走得通（显存可行）

Memory feasibility is the first constraint. Before optimizing for throughput, the configuration must fit in GPU memory. Table 12 summarizes how each parallelism strategy affects per-GPU memory and communication overhead.

Example. For a 685B-parameter fine-grained MoE model, BF16 activations alone can exceed 130 GB per GPU (see Table 3), immediately ruling out baseline configurations on 80 GB devices even with parallelism, and motivating the memory optimizations in Phase 3.

示例。 对一个 685B 参数的细粒度 MoE 模型，仅 BF16 激活就可能超过每卡 130 GB（见表 3），这直接排除了在 80 GB 设备上的基线配置——即使上了并行也不行，从而促使我们在阶段三做显存优化。

9.1.2.Phase 2: Select Optimal Parallelism Strategy阶段二：选出最优并行策略

Once memory-feasible configurations are identified, select the strategy that minimizes communication overhead while maintaining throughput. The optimal choice depends on model architecture, sequence length, and hardware topology.

一旦确定了显存可行的配置，就从中挑出通信开销最小、同时还能维持吞吐的那个。最优选择取决于模型架构、序列长度与硬件拓扑。

Guideline 1: Minimize Model Parallelism, Maximize Data ParallelismGuideline 1：把模型并行压到最小，把数据并行放到最大

  • • Goal: Keep TP/EP/PP/CP as small as possible while avoiding OOM.• 目标：在避免 OOM 的前提下，把 TP/EP/PP/CP 压得越小越好。
  • • Why: Model parallelism introduces communication overhead that hurts performance.• 原因：模型并行会引入通信开销，拖累性能。
  • • How: Use distributed optimizer (--use-distributed-optimizer) to shard optimizer states across DP ranks, freeing memory for larger DP size.• 做法：用分布式优化器（--use-distributed-optimizer）把优化器状态分片到各 DP rank 上，腾出显存以换取更大的 DP 规模。

Guideline 2: Keep EP and TP Communication Within NVLink DomainGuideline 2：把 EP 与 TP 的通信留在 NVLink 域内

  • • Goal: Ensure EP×\timesTP fits within the NVLink Domain (typically 8 GPUs in a single node unless Multi-Node NVLink is used).• 目标：确保 EP×TP 落在 NVLink 域之内（若未使用多节点 NVLink，通常就是一个节点内的 8 张 GPU）。
  • • Why: EP and TP are communication-intensive; NVLink provides much higher bandwidth than cross-node interconnects.• 原因：EP 与 TP 都是通信密集型，而 NVLink 的带宽远高于跨节点互联。
  • • Scaling: When scaling beyond the NVLink Domain, prefer PP over expanding TP/EP across nodes.• 扩展方式：当规模超出 NVLink 域时，优先用 PP 扩展，而不是把 TP/EP 摊到跨节点。

Note: For very large MoE models like DeepSeek-V3, EP communication volume may exceed what NVLink can hide. In this case, enable communication-computation overlap (see Section 4.2) to hide EP latency behind computation.

注意： 对 DeepSeek-V3 这样的超大 MoE 模型，EP 通信量可能超出 NVLink 能藏住的范围。此时应启用通信-计算重叠（见第 4.2 节），把 EP 延迟藏到计算后面。

Guideline 3: Use Pipeline Parallelism (PP) for Multi-Node ScalingGuideline 3：跨节点扩展交给流水并行（PP）

  • • Goal: Use PP to distribute layers across nodes while keeping EP×\timesTP within NVLink.• 目标：用 PP 把层分布到多个节点上，同时把 EP×TP 保持在 NVLink 之内。
  • • VPP: Enable Virtual Pipeline Parallelism to reduce pipeline bubbles when PP ≥2\geq 2.• VPP：当 PP ≥2 时启用虚拟流水并行，以减少流水线气泡。
  • • Config: Set --pipeline-model-parallel-layout to control Pipeline Parallelism settings (see Section 7.5). Larger VPP usually reduces pipeline bubbles but increases P2P communications; a middle value often provides the best balance. The workloads of each VPP rank should be balanced to maximize the throughput.• 配置：用 --pipeline-model-parallel-layout 控制流水并行的设置（见第 7.5 节）。VPP 越大通常气泡越少，但 P2P 通信越多；取中间值往往最平衡。各 VPP rank 的工作负载应当均衡，以最大化吞吐。

EP offers several advantages over TP for MoE layers:

对 MoE 层而言，EP 相比 TP 有几项优势：

Guideline 4: Prefer EP over TP for Expert LayersGuideline 4：专家层优先用 EP 而非 TP

  • • Better GEMM efficiency: Larger local matrix sizes improve GPU utilization.• GEMM 效率更好：本地矩阵尺寸更大，GPU 利用率更高。
  • • Lower communication: EP has less communication overhead than TP for MoE layers.• 通信更少：在 MoE 层上 EP 的通信开销低于 TP。
  • • Simpler computation graph: Easier to overlap communication with computation.• 计算图更简单：通信与计算更容易重叠。
  • • Token permutation: When EP == num_experts, local token permutation is eliminated.• Token permutation：当 EP = num_experts 时，本地 token permutation 被彻底省掉。

Example: For Mixtral-8×\times7B, EP8×\timesTP1 outperforms EP4×\timesTP2.

示例：对 Mixtral-8×7B，EP8×TP1 优于 EP4×TP2。

Guideline 5: Enable Context Parallelism (CP) for Long SequencesGuideline 5：长序列启用上下文并行（CP）

  • • When to use: Sequence length ≥\geq 8K tokens.• 何时使用：序列长度 ≥ 8K token 时。
  • • When to avoid: For sequences << 4K tokens, CP overhead typically exceeds benefits.• 何时避免：序列 < 4K token 时，CP 的开销通常超过收益。
  • • Key factor: CP efficiency depends on overlapping communication with computation.• 关键因素：CP 的效率取决于通信能否与计算重叠。
  • • Config: Set --context-parallel-size to partition sequences across GPUs.• 配置：用 --context-parallel-size 把序列切分到多张 GPU 上。

Example. Consider a 256-expert MoE model on an NVL72 system. Applying Guideline 4, Parallel Folding sets expert TP = 1 so that each expert runs on a single GPU, maximizing GEMM efficiency. With Guideline 2, EP64 fits entirely within the NVLink domain. Guideline 1 then drives the remaining choices: the available memory budget determines TP and PP for attention layers, with DP filling the rest.

示例。 考虑一个 256 专家的 MoE 模型跑在 NVL72 系统上。应用 Guideline 4，parallel folding 令专家 TP = 1，使每个专家落在单张 GPU 上，从而把 GEMM 效率拉到最高。按 Guideline 2，EP64 完全落在 NVLink 域内。Guideline 1 则决定剩下的选择：可用显存预算决定注意力层用多大的 TP 与 PP，其余由 DP 填满。

9.1.3.Phase 3: Profile and Optimize Bottlenecks阶段三：Profile 并优化瓶颈

With a working parallelism configuration established, profile the training run to identify which wall dominates. Apply targeted optimizations based on the bottleneck type.

并行配置跑通之后，对训练做 profile，看看是哪堵墙在主导。然后按瓶颈类型施加针对性的优化。

Memory Bottleneck (Memory Wall)显存瓶颈（显存墙）

Symptom: Forced to use full recomputation or excessively large parallelism degrees to avoid OOM.

症状：被迫使用全量重计算、或过大的并行度，才能避免 OOM。

Solutions: Apply memory-saving techniques (Table 13) to reduce memory consumption.

解法：施加省显存的技术（表 13）以降低显存消耗。

Communication Bottleneck (Communication Wall)通信瓶颈（通信墙）

Symptom: Profiling shows significant time spent in collective operations.

症状：profile 显示大量时间花在集合通信上。

Solutions: Identify which communication is the bottleneck and apply the corresponding optimization. (Table 14)

CPU Overhead Bottleneck (Compute Efficiency Wall)CPU 开销瓶颈（计算效率墙）

The Compute Efficiency Wall manifests in two distinct forms: CPU overhead and computation inefficiency. CPU overhead occurs when the host cannot launch GPU kernels fast enough, creating gaps in GPU execution.

计算效率墙表现为两种截然不同的形态：CPU 开销与计算低效。CPU 开销是指主机来不及发射 GPU kernel，使 GPU 执行中出现空档。

Symptom: Nsight Systems timeline shows gaps between GPU kernels where CPU cannot launch kernels fast enough.

症状：Nsight Systems 时间线上，GPU kernel 之间存在空档，因为 CPU 发射 kernel 的速度跟不上。

Solutions: Reduce host-side overhead by minimizing kernel launches and enabling CUDA Graphs (Table 15).

解法：减少 kernel 发射次数、启用 CUDA Graphs，以削减主机侧开销（表 15）。

表 15　CPU 开销瓶颈的解法。CPU overhead bottleneck solutions.

Computation Bottleneck (Compute Efficiency Wall)计算瓶颈（计算效率墙）

Computation inefficiency occurs when GPU kernels themselves underutilize hardware resources, typically due to small GEMM sizes in fine-grained MoE architectures.

计算低效是指 GPU kernel 自身没能吃满硬件资源，通常是因为细粒度 MoE 架构里 GEMM 尺寸太小。

Symptom: GPU SM utilization is low despite no communication or CPU bottlenecks.

症状：在没有通信或 CPU 瓶颈的情况下，GPU 的 SM 利用率仍然偏低。

Solutions: Improve kernel efficiency through batching, fusion, and lower precision (Table 16).

解法：通过批处理、融合与更低的精度来提升 kernel 效率（表 16）。

Example. On an NVL8 system where EP spans across nodes, profiling may reveal all-to-all communication consuming 30–50% of step time, pointing squarely at the Communication Wall. On an NVL72 system where the same EP degree stays within the NVLink domain, the dominant bottleneck after enabling FP8 often shifts to CPU overhead instead; the faster GPU computation exposes host-side launch latency. The same model on different hardware can require entirely different optimization strategies.

示例。 在一个 EP 跨节点的 NVL8 系统上，profile 可能显示 all-to-all 通信占用 30–50% 的步时，直指通信墙。而在另一个 NVL72 系统上，同样的 EP 度仍留在 NVLink 域内，启用 FP8 之后主导瓶颈往往转为 CPU 开销——更快的 GPU 计算把主机侧的发射延迟暴露了出来。同一个模型在不同硬件上，可能需要完全不同的优化策略。

9.1.4.Summary小结

The ordering of the three phases matters: memory constraints are a hard barrier that must be resolved first (Phase 1), parallelism decisions determine the communication topology (Phase 2), and only then can profiling reveal which wall to attack (Phase 3). Crucially, this process is iterative. Memory optimizations may enable smaller parallelism degrees, returning to Phase 1. Some Phase 3 optimizations have their own memory cost (EP communication overlap requires extra buffers, CUDA Graphs consume additional memory), which may require revisiting earlier decisions. Continuous profiling after each round guides the next iteration.

三个阶段的前后顺序很关键：显存约束是硬壁垒，必须首先解决（阶段一）；并行决策决定了通信拓扑（阶段二）；只有在此之后，profile 才能揭示该攻哪堵墙（阶段三）。更要紧的是，这个过程是迭代的。显存优化可能让小并行度变得可行，于是又回到阶段一；某些阶段三的优化自身带显存成本（EP 通信重叠需要额外缓冲，CUDA Graphs 会多占显存），这又可能需要重新审视前面的决策。每轮之后持续 profile，引导下一轮迭代。

9.2.Case Study: Tuning DeepSeek-V3 on GB200 and H100案例研究：在 GB200 与 H100 上调优 DeepSeek-V3

DeepSeek-V3 represents an extreme stress test for MoE training: 685B total parameters with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Multi-Latent Attention (MLA). All three walls apply: memory pressure from 256 experts, high all-to-all volume from top-8 routing, and small per-expert GEMMs. The preceding workflow (Section 9.1) showed how to approach each phase individually; this case study examines how those decisions interact to form a coherent optimization stack, and why the same model requires fundamentally different strategies on GB200 and H100.

DeepSeek-V3 是对 MoE 训练的一次极限压力测试：685B 总参数，带多 Token 预测（MTP）与多头隐注意力（MLA）。三堵墙同时成立：256 个专家带来显存压力，top-8 路由带来巨大的 all-to-all 流量，每专家的 GEMM 又很小。前面的工作流（第 9.1 节）讲的是如何逐阶段推进；本案例研究考察这些决策如何相互作用、形成一个自洽的优化栈，以及同一个模型为何在 GB200 与 H100 上需要根本不同的策略。

9.2.2.Anatomy of the Optimized Configuration优化配置剖析

Why This Parallelism Layout?为什么是这个并行布局？

Both platforms use Parallel Folding (Guideline 4) to decouple attention and expert parallelism: TP applies only to attention layers for memory reduction, while experts use EP with TP = 1 for better GEMM efficiency. EP64 is chosen so that each GPU holds exactly four of the 256 experts, eliminating local token permutation overhead.

两个平台都用 parallel folding（Guideline 4）把注意力与专家的并行解耦：TP 只作用于注意力层以降低显存，专家侧则用 EP 且 TP = 1，以获得更好的 GEMM 效率。EP 取 64，使每张 GPU 正好持有 256 个专家中的 4 个，从而消除本地 token permutation 的开销。

The key platform difference is memory capacity. GB200’s 192 GB per GPU (vs. H100’s 80 GB) allows TP1/PP4 instead of TP2/PP8, halving the pipeline depth, which reduces pipeline bubbles and simplifies workload balancing (Guideline 1). Flexible VPP then fine-tunes the pipeline: on H100, the layout Et*3|(tt|)*29m|L groups embedding with 3 transformer layers in the first stage, places MTP in a standalone stage, and separates the loss; on GB200, Et*4|(tttt|)*14tmL distributes layers across 16 virtual stages for balanced computation across the shorter pipeline. These parallelism configurations establish the foundation for all subsequent optimizations.

两个平台的关键差异在于显存容量。GB200 每卡 192 GB（H100 为 80 GB），因此可以用 TP1/PP4 而非 TP2/PP8，流水深度减半，气泡更少、负载均衡也更简单（Guideline 1）。灵活 VPP 随后对流水线做精细调节：在 H100 上，布局 Et*3|(tt|)*29m|L 把 embedding 与 3 个 transformer 层放在第一个阶段，MTP 单独成阶段，loss 也独立出来；在 GB200 上，Et*4|(tttt|)*14tmL 把层分布到 16 个虚拟阶段，使更短的流水线也能保持计算均衡。这些并行配置为后续所有优化奠定了地基。

Memory Wall显存墙

FP8 training is the first lever: it halves activation memory on both platforms, freeing GPU memory that would otherwise require aggressive recomputation. On H100, the freed memory budget is critical because it enables EP communication overlap, which requires extra buffers for pipelining dispatch and combine operations (see Communication Wall below). Fine-grained recomputation (mlp, mla_up_proj, layernorm, moe_act) trims remaining memory pressure. Memory-efficient permutation eliminates redundant activation storage, and low-precision optimizer states (BF16) provide additional headroom.

FP8 训练是第一根杠杆：它把两个平台上的激活显存减半，腾出的显存原本要靠激进重计算才能省下来。在 H100 上，这份腾出的预算是关键——它让 EP 通信重叠成为可能，而重叠需要额外缓冲来给 dispatch 与 combine 做流水（见下文「通信墙」）。细粒度重计算（mlp、mla_up_proj、layernorm、moe_act）削掉剩余的显存压力。Memory-Efficient Permutation 消除冗余的激活存储，低精度的优化器状态（BF16）再提供一些余量。

On GB200, the memory chain resolves differently. NVL72 keeps EP local, so communication overlap is not critical and its memory budget is freed entirely. GB200’s higher C2C bandwidth (NVLink-C2C) makes optimizer state offloading effective: the transfer overhead is low enough that offloading frees substantial GPU memory for activations. This in turn reduces the need for fine-grained recomputation to just mlp, far less aggressive than on H100.

在 GB200 上，显存这条链的解法不同。NVL72 让 EP 保持本地，通信重叠不再关键，其显存预算也就完全释放出来。GB200 更高的 C2C 带宽（NVLink-C2C）使优化器状态 offload 变得划算：搬运开销足够低，offload 能腾出可观的显存给激活用。于是细粒度重计算可以缩减到只剩 mlp，远不如 H100 上那么激进。

Communication Wall通信墙

On H100/B200 (NVL8), EP64 spans 8 nodes, and cross-node all-to-all latency would consume nearly 50% of step time with the standard all-to-all dispatcher. DeepEP reduces this overhead through fused permutation and optimized collective operations. Even so, EP communication overlap is essential to hide the remaining cross-node latency behind expert computation, and this overlap is only feasible because FP8 freed enough memory for the extra buffers (see Memory Wall above).

在 H100/B200（NVL8）上，EP64 跨 8 个节点；若用标准 all-to-all dispatcher，跨节点 all-to-all 的延迟会吃掉近 50% 的步时。DeepEP 通过融合 permutation 与优化的集合通信降低了这份开销。即便如此，EP 通信重叠仍必不可少，用来把剩余的跨节点延迟藏到专家计算后面——而这个重叠之所以可行，正是因为 FP8 腾出了足够显存来放额外缓冲（见上文「显存墙」）。

On GB200 (NVL72), EP64 stays entirely within the NVLink domain. HybridEP fully utilizes the 1.8 TB/s bidirectional bandwidth without requiring communication overlap. The communication wall is effectively resolved by hardware topology alone, shifting the dominant bottleneck to compute efficiency.

在 GB200（NVL72）上，EP64 完全落在 NVLink 域内。HybridEP 能充分利用 1.8 TB/s 的双向带宽，根本不需要通信重叠。通信墙仅靠硬件拓扑就被化解了，主导瓶颈于是转向计算效率。

Compute Efficiency Wall计算效率墙

FP8 accelerates GEMMs on both platforms (blockwise FP8 on H100, MXFP8 with native Blackwell Tensor Core support on GB200), but this speedup has a side effect: faster GPU computation exposes CPU overhead. On GB200, where NVL72 already eliminates the communication bottleneck, CPU overhead becomes the dominant constraint; the host cannot launch kernels fast enough to keep the GPU saturated.

FP8 在两个平台上都加速 GEMM（H100 上是 blockwise FP8，GB200 上是受 Blackwell Tensor Core 原生支持的 MXFP8），但这份提速有个副作用：更快的 GPU 计算把 CPU 开销暴露出来。在 GB200 上，NVL72 既然已经消掉了通信瓶颈，CPU 开销就成了主导约束——主机发射 kernel 的速度不足以让 GPU 跑满。

Partial CUDA Graphs address this by capturing attention, router, and MoE preprocessing into static graphs, while leaving dynamic expert computation ungraphed. Kernel fusions (router fusion, permute fusion, MLA RoPE fusion) reduce kernel launch count. CPU/NUMA binding1010 10 The bindpcie script at https://github.com/NVIDIA/mlperf-common/blob/main/client/bindpcie automatically detects GPU/NUMA topology based on local rank and uses numactl to bind each process’s CPU and memory to the NUMA node nearest its GPU. reduces host-side memory access latency.

部分 CUDA Graphs 应对此点：把注意力、router 与 MoE 预处理捕获进静态图，而把动态的专家计算留在图外。算子融合（router 融合、permute 融合、MLA RoPE 融合）减少 kernel 发射次数。CPU/NUMA 绑定（¹⁰ 脚本 https://github.com/NVIDIA/mlperf-common/blob/main/client/bindpcie 会依据 local rank 自动探测 GPU/NUMA 拓扑，并用 numactl 把每个进程的 CPU 与内存绑定到离其 GPU 最近的 NUMA 节点。）则降低主机侧显存访问延迟。

The cross-cutting nature of these optimizations is evident throughout: FP8 simultaneously reduces memory (activations halved), and improves compute throughput, but introduces quantization kernels that amplify CPU overhead. The same model arrives at fundamentally different optimization stacks on different hardware: H100’s stack centers on hiding communication latency (DeepEP + EP overlap), while GB200’s centers on eliminating CPU overhead (CUDA Graphs + kernel fusions). This contrast validates the profile-driven iterative approach from Section 9.1.

这些优化的横切性质在整条链上处处可见：FP8 同时降低显存（激活减半）并提升计算吞吐，却引入了量化 kernel，反过来加重 CPU 开销。同一个模型在不同硬件上走到了根本不同的优化栈：H100 的栈以「藏住通信延迟」为核心（DeepEP + EP 重叠），GB200 的栈以「消除 CPU 开销」为核心（CUDA Graphs + 算子融合）。这一对照正好印证了第 9.1 节那套以 profile 驱动的迭代方法。

9.2.3.Lessons Learned经验总结

Four insights generalize beyond DeepSeek-V3:

有四点洞见可以推广到 DeepSeek-V3 之外：

  • 1. Platform characteristics drive strategy: GB200’s larger memory (192GB vs 80GB) and higher C2C bandwidth enable more aggressive choices: smaller PP degree, less fine-grained recomputation, and effective optimizer offloading. H100’s NVL8 requires EP communication overlap to hide cross-node latency, while GB200’s NVL72 keeps EP64 within the NVLink domain.1. 平台特性决定策略：GB200 更大的显存（192 GB vs 80 GB）与更高的 C2C 带宽，允许更激进的取舍——更小的 PP 度、更少的细粒度重计算，以及有效的优化器 offload。H100 的 NVL8 必须靠 EP 通信重叠来藏住跨节点延迟，而 GB200 的 NVL72 把 EP64 留在了 NVLink 域内。
  • 2. Parallel Folding unlocks flexibility: Decoupling attention TP from expert EP allows independent optimization of each layer type. Combined with flexible VPP, this enables fine-grained workload balancing across pipeline stages.2. Parallel Folding 释放了灵活性：把注意力的 TP 与专家的 EP 解耦，可以让两类层各自独立优化。再配合灵活 VPP，就能在流水阶段之间做细粒度的负载均衡。
  • 3. FP8 shifts bottlenecks: FP8 training accelerates GEMMs and reduces memory, but amplifies CPU overhead as the dominant bottleneck. CUDA Graphs, kernel fusions, and CPU/NUMA binding become essential.3. FP8 会转移瓶颈：FP8 训练加速 GEMM、降低显存，但会把 CPU 开销放大为主导瓶颈。此时 CUDA Graphs、算子融合与 CPU/NUMA 绑定就成了必需品。
  • 4. Iterative optimization: The optimization process is inherently cyclical. Memory optimizations (recomputation, offloading) free GPU memory, enabling communication overlap. Communication optimizations expose compute efficiency bottlenecks. Some optimizations have cross-cutting effects: FP8 training reduces both memory and compute time but increases CPU overhead; CUDA Graphs reduce CPU overhead but consume additional memory. These interactions mean that applying one optimization may require revisiting earlier decisions. Continuous profiling after each change guides the next optimization target and helps identify when diminishing returns suggest moving to the next bottleneck.4. 优化是迭代的：这个过程本质上是循环的。显存优化（重计算、offload）腾出 GPU 显存，让通信重叠成为可能；通信优化又暴露出计算效率瓶颈。某些优化还有横切效应：FP8 训练同时降低显存与计算时间，却加重 CPU 开销；CUDA Graphs 减少 CPU 开销，却多占显存。这些相互作用意味着，施加一项优化可能需要回头重审之前的决策。每次改动之后持续 profile，既能指引下一个优化目标，也能帮助判断何时收益递减、该转向下一个瓶颈。

10.Megatron-Core MoE in Reinforcement Learning强化学习中的 Megatron-Core MoE

Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become a critical paradigm following OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1 [17]. Many leading RL-trained models are MoE architectures (DeepSeek-R1, Kimi-K2, etc.), and RL workloads introduce challenges that amplify the MoE-specific issues discussed throughout this report: highly variable sequence lengths stress the Memory Wall, interleaved inference and training phases demand rapid memory offloading, and routing discrepancies between inference and training engines threaten stability. To achieve high training throughput at scale, RL frameworks run Megatron-Core inside Ray workers as the distributed training backend, and use Megatron-Bridge for bidirectional Hugging Face to Megatron checkpoint conversion.

自 OpenAI o1 与 DeepSeek-R1 [17] 之后，强化学习（RL）后训练已成为一个关键范式。许多领先的 RL 训练模型都是 MoE 架构（DeepSeek-R1、Kimi-K2 等），而 RL 负载引入的挑战会放大本报告通篇讨论的 MoE 特有问题：高度可变的序列长度压迫显存墙；推理与训练阶段交替进行，要求快速搬运显存；推理引擎与训练引擎之间的路由差异则威胁训练稳定性。为了在规模上取得高训练吞吐，RL 框架把 Megatron-Core 跑在 Ray worker 内作为分布式训练后端，并用 Megatron-Bridge 做 Hugging Face 与 Megatron checkpoint 之间的双向转换。

10.1.Challenges for RL Post-TrainingRL 后训练面临的挑战

RL post-training differs from pre-training in ways that impose new requirements on the training engine:

RL 后训练与预训练的差异，给训练引擎提出了新的要求：

  • 1. Variable-length sequences. Pre-training typically operates on fixed-length sequences (e.g., 4K tokens). RL workloads, by contrast, produce highly variable sequence lengths: the maximum may reach 128K or even 1M tokens, while the mean within a mini-batch is often one-half to one-quarter of the maximum. This long-tailed distribution makes it difficult to balance compute efficiency against peak memory consumption.1. 变长序列。 预训练通常使用定长序列（如 4K token）。RL 负载则产生高度可变的序列长度：最长可达 128K 甚至 1M token，而一个小 batch 内的均值往往只有最大值的二分之一到四分之一。这种长尾分布使「计算效率」与「峰值显存」难以兼顾。
  • 2. Memory offloading. RL frameworks typically co-locate a training engine and an inference engine on the same GPUs, offloading one engine’s state while the other is active. This requires both engines to release and restore their full memory footprint quickly and completely—a non-trivial requirement when optimizer states, activations, and KV caches must all be managed.2. 显存 offload。 RL 框架通常把训练引擎与推理引擎部署在同一批 GPU 上，一个引擎活跃时把另一个的状态 offload 出去。这要求两个引擎都能快速、完整地释放并恢复各自的全部显存占用——当优化器状态、激活与 KV cache 都要管起来时，这并非易事。
  • 3. Online weight export. The inference engine must be updated with the latest parameters after each training step. This requires the training engine to export weights rapidly in a format the inference engine can load, across diverse model architectures.3. 在线权重导出。 每个训练步之后，推理引擎都必须更新为最新参数。这要求训练引擎能快速把权重导出成推理引擎可加载的格式，并且要跨多种模型架构都能做到。
  • 4. Training stability. Standard RL algorithms assume that sampled responses come from the current policy distribution. In practice, however, the inference and training engines use different optimized kernels, producing slightly different token probabilities even with identical parameters—effectively introducing off-policy bias. For MoE models, this problem is compounded: tokens from the same sequence may be routed to different experts in the inference and training engines, amplifying the discrepancy.4. 训练稳定性。 标准 RL 算法假定采样得到的回答来自当前策略分布。但实践中，推理引擎与训练引擎使用的是不同的优化 kernel，即便参数完全相同，产出的 token 概率也会有细微差异——这实际上引入了 off-policy 偏差。对 MoE 模型，这个问题被进一步放大：同一条序列中的 token，在推理引擎与训练引擎里可能被路由到不同的专家，偏差因此加剧。

10.2.Megatron-BridgeMegatron-Bridge

A typical RL workflow starts from a pretrained Hugging Face model and fine-tunes it in an RL framework. At scale, these frameworks often run Megatron-Core inside Ray workers for distributed training, while rollout commonly uses an inference stack that expects Hugging Face-format checkpoints. This creates two integration needs: mapping model definitions to Megatron-Core modules, and converting checkpoints between Hugging Face and Megatron formats efficiently. Megatron-Bridge addresses the checkpoint interoperability layer, enabling fast HF-to-Megatron conversion for initialization, training, and export. This pattern is used across multiple RL frameworks, including veRL [84], Slime [103], and NeMo RL.

典型的 RL 工作流从一个预训练好的 Hugging Face 模型出发，在 RL 框架中微调。到了规模化阶段，这些框架往往把 Megatron-Core 跑在 Ray worker 内做分布式训练，而 rollout 通常使用一套期待 Hugging Face 格式 checkpoint 的推理栈。这就产生了两处集成需求：把模型定义映射到 Megatron-Core 模块，以及在 Hugging Face 与 Megatron 格式之间高效互转 checkpoint。Megatron-Bridge 负责的正是 checkpoint 互操作这一层，为初始化、训练与导出提供快速的 HF→Megatron 转换。这一模式已被多个 RL 框架采用，包括 veRL [84]、Slime [103] 与 NeMo RL。

10.3.Megatron-Core Optimization for Reinforcement Learning面向强化学习的 Megatron-Core 优化

Packed Sequence Support. As discussed in Section 6.4.1, we can pack sequences to remove the padding from a batch of variable sequence lengths. Building on packed sequence support, on the RL framework side, we recommend using a packing-aware dynamic batch size, which ensures that every batch has a similar total number of effective tokens. Moreover, we introduce an additional load–balancing strategy that explicitly accounts for the heterogeneous computational cost of the transformer blocks. Because the attention module scales quadratically with sequence length (O⁡(L2)O(L^{2})) whereas the feed-forward network (FFN) scales linearly (O⁡(L)O(L)), a batch that is well balanced in terms of token count can still be highly unbalanced in wall-clock time. To mitigate this issue, we first compute, for every sample in the batch, the square of its sequence length and take the sum within the mini-batch. We then sort micro-batches according to this “attention cost” metric and schedule them in a small-to-large-to-small pattern (i.e., increasing order followed by decreasing order). This serpentine ordering delivers two benefits. (i) For data parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism, it reduces synchronization bubbles because consecutive micro-batches have comparable attention workloads. (ii) Within pipeline parallelism, the warm-up and cool-down phases, where stages are traditionally under-utilized, observe shorter idle periods, as lighter micro-batches arrive earlier and later in the schedule.

打包序列支持。 如第 6.4.1 节所述，我们可以把一批变长序列打包，从而去掉 padding。在打包序列支持的基础上，RL 框架侧我们建议使用「感知打包的动态 batch 大小」，确保每个 batch 的有效 token 总数相近。此外我们引入了一种额外的负载均衡策略，显式考虑 transformer 块计算成本的异构性。注意力模块随序列长度平方增长（O(L2)），而前馈网络（FFN）线性增长（O(L)），因此一个在 token 数上很均衡的 batch，在实际耗时上仍可能极不均衡。为缓解这一点，我们先为 batch 中每个样本计算其序列长度的平方，再在小 batch 内求和；然后按这个「注意力成本」指标对各 micro-batch 排序，以「小-大-小」的模式调度（即先递增、后递减）。这种蛇形（serpentine）排序带来两个好处：（i）对数据并行、流水并行与专家并行而言，由于相邻 micro-batch 的注意力工作量相当，同步气泡减少；（ii）在流水并行内部，传统上利用率偏低的预热（warm-up）与冷却（cool-down）阶段空转时间变短，因为较轻的 micro-batch 被安排在调度的头尾。

Dynamic Context Parallelism. As discussed in Section 6.4.2, conventional training setups must pick a fixed context-parallel (CP) degree that guarantees the longest sequence in the workload will not trigger out-of-memory (OOM) failures. This conservative choice forces the majority of shorter sequences, whose memory footprints are far smaller, to run with an unnecessarily large CP degree, thereby wasting cross-device bandwidth and reducing overall throughput. Dynamic CP removes this one-size-fits-all restriction by selecting the CP degree adaptively on a per-micro-batch basis. At runtime we bucket incoming sequences by length, choose the minimal CP degree that keeps each bucket within the device memory budget, and dispatch micro-batches accordingly. Long sequences receive a higher CP degree to stay memory-safe, whereas short sequences are executed with a lower CP degree that maximizes arithmetic intensity and reduces communication volume.

动态上下文并行。 如第 6.4.2 节所述，常规训练设置必须选定一个固定的上下文并行（CP）度，以保证负载中最长的序列不会触发 OOM。这种保守选择迫使占多数的短序列——它们显存占用小得多——也以不必要的大 CP 度运行，白白浪费跨设备带宽、拉低整体吞吐。动态 CP 取消了这种「一刀切」的限制，改为按 micro-batch 自适应地选择 CP 度。运行时，我们按长度对接入的序列分桶，为每个桶选出能装进设备显存预算的最小 CP 度，据此派发 micro-batch。长序列获得更高的 CP 度以保证显存安全，短序列则以更低的 CP 度执行，从而最大化算术强度、减少通信量。

CPU Optimizer Offloading. To further relieve GPU memory pressure, we offload the optimizer states to host DRAM during the forward and backward passes, loading them back onto the GPU only for the parameter-update step. Because optimizer tensors can occupy multiple times the size of model parameters, temporarily evicting them frees a substantial amount of high-bandwidth GPU memory that can instead be used to cache activations or accommodate longer sequences.

优化器 CPU offload。 为进一步缓解 GPU 显存压力，我们在前向与反向过程中把优化器状态 offload 到主机 DRAM，只在参数更新这一步才加载回 GPU。由于优化器张量的体积可能是模型参数的好几倍，把它们暂时换出可以腾出大量高带宽 GPU 显存，改用于缓存激活或容纳更长的序列。

FP16 Training Support. Although bfloat16 (BF16) is widely adopted for pre-training large language models, several studies have observed that, during reinforcement-learning training, half-precision floating-point (FP16) can deliver greater numerical stability under certain hyper-parameter choices. Megatron-Core MoE implementation therefore offers a fully-featured FP16 path, including loss scaling and mixed-precision optimizer kernels, enabling practitioners to select the precision mode that best aligns with their stability requirements without sacrificing throughput.

FP16 训练支持。 尽管 bfloat16（BF16）在大语言模型预训练中被广泛采用，但已有若干研究发现，在强化学习训练中，半精度浮点（FP16）在某些超参选择下能带来更好的数值稳定性。因此 Megatron-Core MoE 的实现提供了一条功能完整的 FP16 路径，包括 loss scaling 与混合精度优化器 kernel，使实践者能在不牺牲吞吐的前提下，选择最契合自身稳定性要求的精度模式。

Router Replay. Recent work [24] shows that capturing the routing decisions produced by the MoE router during inference and replaying them in subsequent training phases can improve convergence consistency. Thanks to a community-contributed patch, Megatron-Core MoE now supports this feature: the inference engine logs each token’s expert assignment, and the training stack can ingest and enforce the same routing pattern. This mechanism decouples routing variability from weight updates, leading to more stable optimization trajectories, especially in RL settings where on-policy data distribution shifts are frequent.

Router Replay。 近期工作 [24] 表明，把 MoE router 在推理时产生的路由决策记录下来、并在后续训练阶段重放，可以提升收敛的一致性。借助社区贡献的补丁，Megatron-Core MoE 现已支持这一特性：推理引擎记录每个 token 的专家分配，训练栈则可以接收并强制采用同一套路由模式。这一机制把「路由的波动」与「权重的更新」解耦，使优化轨迹更稳定——在 on-policy 数据分布频繁漂移的 RL 场景中尤其如此。

11.Conclusion结论

This report presented Megatron-Core MoE, an open-source stack for training large-scale Mixture-of-Experts models. MoE sparsity introduces two fundamental challenges: a parameter-compute mismatch that manifests as the Three Walls (Memory, Communication, and Compute Efficiency), and a dense-sparse mismatch that requires decoupled parallelism for attention and MoE layers. By combining integrated solutions across these challenges, Megatron-Core MoE enables efficient trillion-parameter-scale training.

本报告介绍了 Megatron-Core MoE——一套用于训练大规模混合专家模型的开源技术栈。MoE 的稀疏性带来两个根本挑战：一是「参数-计算失配」，表现为三堵墙（显存、通信与计算效率）；二是「稠密-稀疏失配」，要求对注意力层与 MoE 层采用解耦的并行方式。通过在这两个挑战上给出成套的整合方案，Megatron-Core MoE 使万亿参数规模的训练变得高效可行。

The key technical contributions include:

关键技术贡献包括：

  • • Multi-Dimensional Parallelism and Parallel Folding. Expert Parallelism integrates seamlessly with tensor, pipeline, context, and data parallelism. MoE Parallel Folding decouples attention and MoE layer configurations, breaking the restrictive EP≤DP\text{EP}\leq\text{DP} constraint and enabling flexible parallelism mapping tailored to model architecture and hardware topology.• 多维并行与 Parallel Folding。 专家并行与张量并行、流水并行、上下文并行、数据并行无缝集成。MoE Parallel Folding 将注意力层与 MoE 层的配置解耦，打破了 EP≤DP 这一限制性约束，使并行映射可以按模型架构与硬件拓扑灵活定制。
  • • Memory Optimization. Fine-grained activation recomputation, memory-efficient permutation, precision-aware optimizers with BF16 moments, and CPU activation offloading reduce memory footprint from 199.5 GB to under 80 GB per GPU for DeepSeek-V3, making trillion-parameter training feasible on current hardware.• 显存优化。 细粒度激活重计算、memory-efficient permutation、带 BF16 矩的精度感知优化器，以及 CPU 激活 offload，把 DeepSeek-V3 每卡显存需求从 199.5 GB 降到 80 GB 以下，使万亿参数训练在当前硬件上成为可能。
  • • Communication Optimization. High-performance token dispatchers (DeepEP and HybridEP), and communication-computation overlap transform all-to-all from a bottleneck into a background operation hidden behind expert computation.• 通信优化。 高性能 token dispatcher（DeepEP 与 HybridEP）加上通信-计算重叠，把 all-to-all 从瓶颈变成藏在专家计算背后的后台操作。
  • • Compute Efficiency. Grouped GEMM kernels batch expert computations for better hardware utilization, kernel fusion consolidates routing and permutation operations, CUDA Graphs reduce launch overhead, and sync-free execution eliminates host-device synchronization for dropless MoE.• 计算效率。 Grouped GEMM kernel 把专家计算批量化以提高硬件利用率；算子融合合并路由与 permutation 操作；CUDA Graphs 减少发射开销；无同步执行则为 dropless MoE 消除了主机-设备同步。
  • • FP8 Training. Full FP8 support with selective precision, protecting numerically sensitive components (router, embeddings, optimizer states) while aggressively quantizing bulk computation, provides benefits across all three walls simultaneously.• FP8 训练。 完整支持带选择性精度的 FP8：保护数值敏感的组件（router、embedding、优化器状态），同时对大宗计算施以激进量化，从而同时惠及三堵墙。
  • • Long-Context Training. Context Parallelism and Tensor Parallelism scaling maintain constant sub-sequence lengths per device, enabling training at 16K to 64K+ token sequences where attention computation dominates.• 长上下文训练。 上下文并行与张量并行的扩展方式让每台设备上的子序列长度保持恒定，从而支持 16K 至 64K 以上、注意力计算占主导的序列长度。
  • • Production Features. Load balancing strategies and token dropping ensure stable training, distributed checkpointing enables parallelism-agnostic resharding, upcycling initializes MoE models from dense checkpoints, and multi-token prediction integration supports advanced training objectives.• 生产级特性。 负载均衡策略与 token 丢弃保证训练稳定；分布式 checkpointing 支持与并行方式无关的重分片；upcycling 可以从稠密 checkpoint 初始化 MoE 模型；多 Token 预测的集成则支持更先进的训练目标。
  • • Reinforcement Learning Support. Megatron Core and Megatron-Bridge provide seamless integration with popular RL frameworks, while packed sequence support, dynamic context parallelism, and router replay address the unique challenges of RL post-training workloads.• 强化学习支持。 Megatron Core 与 Megatron-Bridge 可与主流 RL 框架无缝集成，而打包序列支持、动态上下文并行与 router replay 则应对 RL 后训练负载的独有挑战。

These optimizations enable Megatron-Core MoE to achieve strong training throughput: DeepSeek-V3 (685B parameters, 256 experts) trains at 1,233/1,048 TFLOPS per GPU on 256 GB300/GB200s and 368 TFLOPS per GPU on 1,024 H100s; Qwen3-235B achieves 974/919 TFLOPS on GB300/GB200 and 320 TFLOPS on H100. The GB300 and GB200 platforms deliver approximately 3×\times higher token throughput compared to H100, demonstrating the framework’s ability to exploit next-generation hardware.

这些优化使 Megatron-Core MoE 取得了很强的训练吞吐：DeepSeek-V3（685B 参数、256 专家）在 256 张 GB300/GB200 上达到每 GPU 1,233/1,048 TFLOPS，在 1,024 张 H100 上达到每 GPU 368 TFLOPS；Qwen3-235B 在 GB300/GB200 上达到 974/919 TFLOPS，在 H100 上达到 320 TFLOPS。相比 H100，GB300 与 GB200 平台提供的 token 吞吐约为 3×，显示出该框架挖掘下一代硬件的能力。

By open-sourcing these capabilities, Megatron-Core MoE provides researchers and practitioners with production-grade tools for MoE experimentation and deployment at scale. The modular architecture enables rapid prototyping while the full optimization stack supports training from research prototypes to trillion-parameter production models.

通过把这些能力开源，Megatron-Core MoE 为研究者与实践者提供了可用于规模化 MoE 实验与部署的生产级工具。其模块化架构支持快速原型验证，而完整的优化栈则能支撑从研究原型一直到万亿参数生产模型的训练。

B.2. Key OptimizationsB.2. 关键优化

This section summarizes the configuration of the most performance-critical optimization features used in our benchmark runs. Although the full optimization space is larger, these features consistently have first-order impact on throughput and are configured differently across workloads and platforms.

本节汇总我们基准运行中所用的、对性能最关键的优化特性的配置。虽然完整的优化空间更大，但这些特性对吞吐一贯具有一阶影响，且在不同负载与平台上配置各异。

DeepSeek-V3

DeepSeek-V3

  • • Dispatcher: HybridEP on GB300/GB200; DeepEP on H100.• Dispatcher：GB300/GB200 上用 HybridEP；H100 上用 DeepEP。
  • • Recompute: None on GB300; mlp on GB200; up_proj, mlp on H100.• 重计算：GB300 上不重算；GB200 上重算 mlp；H100 上重算 up_proj、mlp。
  • • 1F1B overlap: ON for GB300 and H100; OFF for GB200.• 1F1B 重叠：GB300 与 H100 开启；GB200 关闭。
  • • CUDA Graphs: attn, moe_router, moe_preprocess on GB300/GB200; OFF on H100.• CUDA Graphs：GB300/GB200 上启用 attn、moe_router、moe_preprocess；H100 上关闭。

These settings are chosen to balance memory headroom, communication overhead, and kernel efficiency for maximum sustained throughput on each platform.

这些设置的选取，是为了在各平台上平衡显存余量、通信开销与 kernel 效率，以获得最高的持续吞吐。

Qwen3-235B

Qwen3-235B

  • • Dispatcher: HybridEP on GB300/GB200; DeepEP on H100.• Dispatcher：GB300/GB200 上用 HybridEP；H100 上用 DeepEP。
  • • Recompute: moe_act, layernorm on GB200 and H100.• 重计算：GB200 与 H100 上重算 moe_act、layernorm。
  • • 1F1B overlap: OFF for GB300; ON for GB200 and H100.• 1F1B 重叠：GB300 关闭；GB200 与 H100 开启。
  • • CUDA Graphs: attn, moe_router, moe_preprocess.• CUDA Graphs：启用 attn、moe_router、moe_preprocess。

The resulting configuration pattern reflects a throughput-first tuning strategy under model- and hardware-specific constraints.

由此形成的配置模式，体现出一种在模型与硬件特定约束下「吞吐优先」的调优策略。

B.3. ReproducibilityB.3. 可复现性

The benchmark numbers in Table 11 can be reproduced through two supported workflows. First, users can run end-to-end training with Megatron-Bridge 1111 11 https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/tree/main/scripts/performance, which provides a higher-level interface for model, parallelism, and optimization configuration. Second, users can launch training directly with Megatron-Core (MCore) using model-specific scripts in Megatron-MoE-ModelZoo 1212 12 https://github.com/yanring/Megatron-MoE-ModelZoo/tree/main/best_practice/readme.md, which exposes the full set of low-level launch flags for performance tuning. In both workflows, start from Table 20 and adjust only a few cluster-specific runtime settings (for example, hostfile, environment modules, and job scheduler options).

表 11 的基准数据可通过两种受支持的工作流复现。其一，用 Megatron-Bridge（¹¹ https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/tree/main/scripts/performance ）跑端到端训练，它提供了面向模型、并行与优化配置的更高层接口。其二，用 Megatron-Core（MCore）直接启动训练，使用 Megatron-MoE-ModelZoo 中的模型专用脚本（¹² https://github.com/yanring/Megatron-MoE-ModelZoo/tree/main/best_practice/readme.md ），它暴露了全部底层启动参数供性能调优。两种工作流都从表 20 出发，只需调整少量与集群相关运行时设置（例如 hostfile、环境模块与作业调度器选项）。
